topic: The Pink Stuff - The Miracle All Purpose Cleaning Paste… (Foam Spray)
texts: Very pleased with Pink Stuff as a gentle abrasive household cleaner. Too bad the container arrived cracked and leaking. I contacted the seller and didn't hear back. As for the product, it works better at removing stubborn soap scum on my old ceramic tub than anything I have tried, and rinsed clean much easily without leaving invisible remnants of slippery residue (old house people know what I mean!)
You use more elbow grease to get things clean then the actual product cleans. May as well use a lemon and salt for all the scrubbing that you have to do
The pink stuff is great for everyday cleaning. You still have to put your arm into it and work at it to achieve that deep cleaning. But overall still a good outcome.

The key to this stuff is to spread like butter it on the caked on stuff in the oven and let it sit for a few minutes. After that use like a paper towel or something that has texture. DO NOT USE ANYTHING DAMP YET! That is the key. Don't use a damp cloth until after you have used the paper towel or textured rag. Also make sure when you are done to completely wipe the whole oven down or it will smell funny the first time you use it. Works on other stains to but the key is Paper towel first them a damp rag.

The smell is completely overpowering and awful. The foam is difficult to cover a big area through this sprayer (like a tub). It worked “okay” but after all the great reviews, I expected it to be better. Above all - if it didn’t smell as awful as it does, I may use it again.

My boyfriend’s roommates hardly ever do any deep cleaning so their bar sink and their stove had so much cooked-on grease and grime. The Pink Stuff took it right off. It did take a little work on the stove, but it made a world of difference! Even the roommate who doesn’t like me gave me a nod of approval! Definitely recommend!

My wife hates having to touch anything in the bathroom and especially having to touch the toilet seat every time when flushing the commode was a grind on her psyche. This tiny piece of plastic helped alleviate that stress and made life that much better for the two of us. Thank you tiny toilet plastic

Purchased these for my friends house and cabin whom has been a bachelor for awhile. I was tired of going over there and putting the seat down when ever I had to use it. The thought of touching the seat with no gloves blahhhh. It works good just doesn’t look the best
I love the convenience of this handle, only issue is how thick the adhesive strips are. I had to put strips on other points of the toilet seat to balance it out, otherwise it was lopsided.

topic: Avon SKIN-SO-SOFT Bug Guard PLUS IR3535® Insect Repellent Moisturizing Lotion - SPF 30 Gentle Breeze, 4 oz
texts: My kids were constantly getting bitten by mosquitos. Once I used the lotion they have not gotten bitten once. In addition, the smell of the lotion is nice. It is also a benefit that the lotion has and SPF of 30. Great product!!! And the price was great too!
Great product and I ordered it over a week ago and paying a fortune for the expedited shipping and I didn't get it on time so I went on my trip without it.

The little no see ums and mosquitoes just love to bite me, but by using this product and Amazon's Bug Bands, I am safe! If I don't wear these two products I feel the itchy, painful results. The Avon Bug Guard is not oily and smells pleasant. It is very effective!

I used this in Cambodia & Vietnam - it wasn't especially effective against the mosquitoes. It was also much greasier than I expected and (possibly due to the heat/humidity there) the product separated and no amount of shaking could mix it up again - I would get white cream and oil coming out of the container separately. In the end, I gave up & threw it out.
I have used this product for several years. I have on occasion ran out and tried other products. I keep coming back to skin so soft. It does what you want and doesn't have an oder.

I have heard for years that this was the best for repelling mosquitos. Sadly I put it on, only to see a nice mosquito land on my arm and pay no heed to the idea of repellent. Secondarily and the worst for me at the present time is that I broke out in a rash. I have only seen a few others mention this so I may be in the minority. That being said,I won't be using it again. Rash on both arms and on neck and back and ears where I applied it .

Have been using this product for the past two summers, and I keep reaching for it again and again! I cannot stress enough how great this product is. I have sensitive skin, so having a lotion that works for me is very important. The most important feature for me, however, is the bug repellent feature. In general, I am the one person who gets bitten the most in a group of people. With Avon, I can usually leave unscathed (or have just one bug bite because I forgot to apply the sunscreen on my ankle)! And as an added bonus, the Avon has a gentle scent compared to other sunscreens.
I wore this in 80 degree sunny whether while sitting at a hotel pool, and walking along a marina. I reapplied after 80 minutes and got the worst sunburn I have had in years. Not impressed!

topic: Quick Fix Glucose Tablet Key Chain
texts: ***UPDATE*** Pretty crappy. The tablets rattle around like a clapper in a bell & make way too much noise. They cause a lot of frustration while trying to remove the tablets & as we all know, dexterity & patience are the first things to leave us during an acute low. It would be a good item for a caregiver to carry, though. Much flatter than the 10 count sleeves I have. Even carrying. Time will tell how durable these are. I am a type-1 since 1977. I carry my “Scooby-snacks” in my shirt pocket at work. They ride much better.

We ordered two of these glucose tablet holder keychains for our son who has type 1. He was really looking forward to the "cool" keychain. There are two design flaws that make this product useless: 1. Of the two we ordered, neither one shuts properly. The tablets fall out. 2. The compartment is not sized large enough to fit most glucose tablets. We had to purchase three different brands of tablets before finding one small enough to fit in the keychain. Do not waste your money.
Great idea but did not last more than 2 months. Tops broke off and tablets fall out. They need to make a more durable one to last as this would be a great thing to have.

I got these for my Type 1 Diabetic son to keep glucose tabs in and then keep them on his bags and jackets. They are way too hard to open, especially if he was feeling low. They are even hard for an adult to open.
I like them, but they hinge is plastic than bends, not a hinge as expected. My work fine, but time will tell. They are well made and hold 6 tablets... I am happy I have them...

We purchased this for our son that has T1D. So far it is holding up well. We attached it to his pump spy belt for when he is running in cross country. It ha not popped open unexpectedly as some reviewers have said. Would recommend it.

I have non-diabetic hypoglycemia (low blood glucose). I purchased this from my local Walgreens. I LOVE it. I use the ReliOn Gluecose tablets and they fit perfectly, on both sides. Unlike the other reviewer, I do not have any issues with them opening or closing spontaneously. The lids snap closed and are fairly secure. In fact, on the other side, I put my vitamins. These are perfect for my needs. This being said, however, $8+ for shipping for two of them? Seriously? They empty, thin plastic for God's sake.

Love the idea, but higher in cost relative to what you can find just going to walmart. Unlike some reviewers, I have not had a problem finding glucose tabs to fit. I have used both Dex4 and Relion brands without issue.

Charge it to my age. I thought I was purchasing little tiny HARD soap for my bathroom display. Instead it was more of a wet napkin feel. Nevertheless, it was package very pretty and it makes a nice display.

This little gadget is fabulous! I have an older shower in one bathroom and here in the old West we have horrible water. But with this spin brush and it's horse power along with cleanser, I have no more water spots, calcium deposits nor aching arms on fiberglass shower walls! It's worth every penny!

The only reason I didn't give this product 5 stars is because when I was cleaning the floor of my shower it seemed as if the motor was not consistent. I like this product and I really like not having to scrub it all by hand.

DIDN'T LIKE IT. THE CONCEPT IS GREAT, BUT IT DIDN'T HOLD A CHARGE WELLL AND YOU HAD TO USE A LIGHT TOUCH OR IT WOULD SLOW WAY DOWN. I WOULD LIKE IT IF THE BRISTLES WERE HARDER TO CAUSE A BIT MORE ABRASION TO GET THE TOUGH JOBS DONE...LIKE BATHTUBS WITH WELL WATER.

Easy to work with, high quality single number that meets my expectations for an inflatable baloon. This one has good thickness and doesn’t tear easily as I have had ones that tore very easily when working with them to inflate.

Bought for our daughters second birthday pictures. It had a hole in it upon inflation. We still tried to get the requisite 2nd birthday pictures but the balloon was so limp and disappointing we didn't use the pictures.

topic: Meshiqui | Reusable Makeup Remover Pads | 100% Premium Organic Natural Bamboo Cotton Rounds | 20 Pack Washable Eco-Friendly Cotton
texts: I bought these a while ago, and am just getting around to writing this review. I used them to take off a full face of makeup, and clean with toner for about 2 days. Decided to do a test trial and wash them immediately afterwards. The makeup stained the cotton pads and would not wash out, no matter how many cycles in the washing machine I put them through. As for the toner, the pads soaked up most of what I poured, so that ensured more product was being wasted. I would not buy these, unless you wear minimal makeup and don’t mind spending extra to replace toner quicker. Other than that, the bamboo holder was very pretty and durable.
I like this item. Very effective in removing makeup and I use them to apply toner. I use to use cotton balls but these are washable and reusable. Very cost effective And better for the environment.

I got these because I want to not use fewer disposable things and these are really nice. This has a container for them, which keeps them nicely on the counter, and even a bag so they won’t get lost in the wash. Makes it a little easier to green my beauty routine.
First time washing them they curl up into balls and won't lay flat again. So now they don't fit in the container. Great concept, but this design is a fail.

This product works great until it comes time to wash it. I followed the instructions provided with them and then some but no matter what I did my make up did not come off of them. I will be returning these since I do not want to use permanently stained wipes that will only get worse with each use.

Package was perfect. The bambo holder looks nice on the counter and the washing bag makes it easy to keep everything organized. I was amazed at how much dirt was on the pad with my face wash! Disposable cotton rounds didn't work that well not to mention they fall apart. If you use cotton rounds for face care, TRY THESE! I am very impressed!

I have found these extremely hard to clean and to dry especially and after putting the pads back in the bamboo holder once when they were almost-but-not-quite dry the whole bamboo container molded horribly and some of the pads molded as well.

Great holder and mesh bag, not as soft as I thought. I do feel like I’m using more product since it gets absorbed and doesn’t come out as easily. However, still some of the best reusable pads I’ve used

texts: The threaded tip broke off while using the pole with the saw attachment but the company sent a replacement even though the Amazon return period had expired. Very satisfied with prompt and courteous customer service.

I love the pole and how high you can reach and it still is functional!! I did have an issue here and there with the pole sliding down and not stay in place. I think I have to tighten one of the screws.

I ordered this with a brush and received a microfiber duster head! Went 5 rounds with the worst customer service in the Western hemisphere! I would definately not suggest anyone buy this product or even take it for free!

I unboxed today and was very pleasantly surprised. The pole is lightweight but sturdy aluminum, the clasps to extend are very solid. The brushes and attachments are plastic but feel sturdy. Although I am Sure they won't survive if you treat them like metal professional pieces. Can't eait to use this tomorrow.

With the exceptionally rainy weather we have had this year, mossy algae is growing all over the vinyl siding on my house. In past years I have clung to a ladder to scrub, even pressure wash, the stuff off. This new extension pole and brush are perfect for the job, well-made & sturdy, and adjustable to the different heights I need. Now I can do the job without the acrobatics of the ladder or the inconvenience of the mess dripping off my elbows. (Product arrived as advertised, securely packaged, and at a very reasonable price.)

I received something totally different than what I ordered! Extremely dissatisfied with this purchase! I ordered the brush and got some kind of flimsy dusters that is totally useless and as soon as it got wet it bent and was a waste of my time!

WARNING -- NOT AS ADVERTISED! The item is described as a 6-24 Foot ***Soft Bristle Scrub Brush*** Extension Pole, but I got a feather duster attachment to the pole. This is definitely NOT a soft Bristle Scrub Brush as advertised and shown in the images!!

Your brush was installed wrong making it mostly unusable, unless you just use it as a straight pole , it is unusable as I received it. No return label or instructions of any kind. Pole looks good.... brush is totally useless!!

texts: These are 4gal bags stated as Tall kitchen trash bags. The diameter at the top does not even fit over my small can rectangular bathroom can. I have always used 4gal small can bags for that and these are smaller. What a waste!

I was really hoping for these bags to be a good value. But 90% of them are defective as in half the size. At first I thought it was just at the beginning of each roll (there are 3), but after unrolling more than 10 bags on each roll, it seems to be that they put one or two full 4 gallon bags in between the defective ones. This is a very slick way to pass off bad bags instead of quality control rejecting them. I am returning them and will just spend the extra money on Hefty's. I never ever in my life got a too short or wrong size trash bag before. This company should be ashamed!

These are designed and made well. However, they are too narrow for any of my small trash cans. The opening does not fold over the top of the can because their opening is too narrow. Great idea, but they need to make them with a larger opening so they are more universal.

These 4-gallon trash bags are very good quality, it's very suitable for small trash cans, I use for small trash on my room and bathroom as well, it's thick and very strong, it's not easy to be broken and leak, it's easy to tie and it's convenient trash bag with drawstring. This product is worth for this price. Highly recommend.

I’m always looking for the small trash bags with lower price, but even on Amazon the options not so much. There’s great deal on 13 gallons bags but not for 4 gallons or 8 gallons. This bag is very worth of money! Great price great quality. With strings easily collect. Love it

Great product~ strong and hefty~ perfect product for health care caregivers who need to secure adult briefs daily and quickly & neatly dispose! I love these bags! Best 4 gallon bags I’ve used as of yet.

The bags do appear to be a tiny bit heavier weight than my old bags but the 4 gal bags don't fit my 3 gal waste basket, while my old 4 gal bags do. In the photos you can see both bags, one atop the other. The old bag on the bottom with a red drawstring and the All Clean bag on top with a black drawstring. All clean is not as tall or as wide as the old bags. I cannot attest to their durability because I can't use them.

The quality of this garbage bag is very good. The bag is also very strong and will not break. Can hold a lot of garbage. Very practical. There is a handle at the opening of the bag, which is also very convenient. When throwing out trash, you can lift it up and throw it away. No soiling of hands, no bacteria or viruses. Very recommended to buy

texts: These worked well on dry cracked heels, as nothing else did. I tried to adhere some of the torn ones at the instep but it did not work. I still wear the torn ones and wash at each wearing. The sock holds them in place well. Nothing like foot pain to create a bad review, but these do pretty good for a while. I wear them with no show socks and Keen sandals.

Crap product without manufacturer name, production date and lot number , I believe it was made by the underground plant somewhere on earth. Also I have slippery problem during the first day to use it.
Within less than an hour my feet were covered in hives - red, swollen with a red rash under the product. Took a few days to return to normal. I really wanted these to work.

I've tried two of the pairs. The first time, the silicone socks kept moving and rolling up my heel. I would push it back into place for it to slide up again. The second time, as some as I put them on, they ripped open.

I have very dry heels. These have been a game changer. They keep moisture in and in just a couple of days, my heels are looking much better. I teach and often have foot pain but with school going online due to covid-19, I can't speak for that yet. I can say they are very comfortable and i forget Im wearing them.
These didnot work. They tear easily the first one i put one torn. I return them back and didn't even receive my refund. Will not order from this seller again.

I would recommend these heel cups for anyone who has heel spurs. I received them 4 days ago and automatically put them on. Noticed a difference right off. Slept in them one night they stick to my blanket sheets but managed to sleep. Day 1- I had slight pain in my left heel. Day 2- very little pain. Day 3- no pain until I wore them with a gel insole and ended up taking that out and pain went away. I had xrays in November with heel spur on left foot and also one on back of same heel. So far with this product it has made pain go away and heels is smoother.
I wish it was a bit thicker, easy to wear, I wish it had come with care instructions, like how many times can you wear it, can they be washed,?

topic: Non-Toxic Temporary Hair Pastel Chalk Beauty Kit - Mix Color Variety Beauty Design, 24pc
texts: These are really fun to use when you want to add a pop of color. The only thing that I would caution about is that is doesn't always come out of blonde hair easily. It permanently tinted my daughters hair light pink. Doh!

I have never worked with chalk before and didn't know what it was going to do to my daughter's hair. I should have expected that this product leaves your hair chalky and dry. You are better off buying other non chalk items to color your hair, like any of the demi permanent colors at Hot Topic.

I had bought this because it had a variety of colors, and for the price I really couldn't pass it up. Or so I thought. I have tried it both wet and dry and it just doesn't transfer onto the hair. My daughters were so disappointed and now this pack of hair chalk just sits in the closet

I used the pink on my blonde hair on Halloween and one month later it still hasn't washed out. The packaging says it will last longer if you wet it and use a straightening iron. When I asked the manufacturer, they implied that "longer" could mean over a month, but that is not the common use of the word "longer" when referring to temporary color. I went to the salon and they said I should decide if I want my hair to be cut short, all dyed pink, or dyed really dark. They couldn't get it out even with bleach. I do not recommend this for blonde's AT ALL.

this hair chalk was fun! I have ombre hair so the colors looked a lot brighter on the blonde ends of my hair, but certain colors looked bright on the dark brown parts. it is pretty messy, but its messy when u dye ur hair and this isn't permanent. its also cool to try out different colors before actually dying your hair! I would recommend this, especially for younger teens and children.

I have tried this hair chalk now 3 times. Each time has been a disappointment. I wet hair lightly.. rubbed on chalk and flat ironed.. The color did not stay for even an hr. It just sits.. its a waste.

Great colors, and works as promised -- if you know how to use them. I've tried them dry on dry hair, wet on wet hair, etc. Best results were achieved with the pastels quickly dipped in water (wear disposable gloves) then applied to dry strands. Hair can be styled afterwards, and, especially if you're wearing light-colored shirts - "fix" the color with hairspray. Also -- I've managed to keep the dye off my clothes and surroundings by only applying this to the top part of my hair (and never to the underside of it) - as well as fading the colors off "on purpose" towards the ends, which helped a lot.

Some colors look nice and pretty. The others look ugly and sticky. Can not explain why. Overall, my teen daughter is happy and uses it once in a while. The colors stay on hair until they are washed out.

I can’t tell if it works on my white subway tile but no major issues. I feel like I need to use a lot after each shower to be effective. Glad it comes with two.

The smell is awesome, not at all overpowering like regular bathroom cleaner. Works very well at keeping the tub clean with no scrubbing! Just make sure to take 10 seconds and rinse the walls of any soap or residue before getting out - other wise the cleaner won't be able to get to the actual shower wall.

helping someone who is unable to get the drops in her eye without the dropper touching her eye. This works fantastic with the single dose dropper and she was able to administer the drops herself. It worked so well I ordered a second one for myself.

They are passive plugs -- obstruct sound waves from entering the ear canal. There is no active noise cancellation.
