i bought this for my 2.5 yr old who suffers from motion sickness. from the start it was a struggle to get it on, he kept tugging on it and said it was hurting him. we barely made it to the car and the area looked like it was swelling, the band is just too tight and hes a skinny child. very disappointed this didnt work out for us.
The band while convenient and easy to wear did not have much of an impact on my kids. While they complained that it was tight but they still wore it but they were still feeling nauseous.
I suffer from vicious motion sickness. If it moves, it makes me nauseous. Wore these on a plane, car and boat and didn't get motion sick once. Never leaving home without them again!

No scientific evidence to prove that these actually work, but it matters not to me if it’s just the placebo effect! These have made road trips complaint and puke-free for my kid. They appear to fit a bit tight, but are apparently comfortable and unbothersome.

These are so great! The seasick patch may be convenient, but these bands are all natural and works just as well! My whole family used the bands on our cruise and none of us got sick. My 10 year old has the worst motion sickness, so he wears them whenever he's in the car and he doesn't get sick any more!

topic: Baby Nasal Aspirator Nose Cleaner and Snot Sucker - Adjustable Settings and Reusable Tips with LCD Screen
texts: [[VIDEOID:a0f7fad8debb9cc4bc27808e7cbbf545]] My daughter has allergies and she is constantly stuffy. I feel like she can't breath when she sleeps so I bought this to get it all out every night because I'm traumatizing her doing it with a manual aspirator! This has a variety of suction strengthens and different tips so I can maneuver properly when needed. She still isn't very happy but it's a much faster process and does a much better job...very satisfied!

This is a wonderful product. It's so hard to use the ones you squeeze with your hand while trying to bold down baby with the other hand. You get way better leverage to get the job done quickly and easily. Baby seemed more amused by the sound then getting upset with the fact if getting mad from sucking its nose. It's very easy to use and also works very well! I wish they made these back when my kids were little. Everything seems so much easier with my grandkids with technology today! Haha

I don’t know how this product has any stars. I gave it a chance for a week and I just couldn’t understand why it wasn’t getting any booger’s from infants nose. I even tried it on myself and it only sucked up about 1/4, if that! there are no instructions for use or for how to clean it. I can’t even find this product online for more info; Which makes me uneasy with using. I would return this product, but I’ve used it and that’s kinda gross, so unfortunately it just ended up a big waste of money.
Nasal Aspirator (Nose Cleaner) works great for newborns or any age of kids. It's very soft on the top so it will not damage somehow the nose of your baby. Truly recommend. Excellent quality.

This is a must for kids! Easy to use and clean the suction heads. So much easier then a bulb syringe or frida! Rechargeable and holds a battery for a long time between uses, lighted end makes it easy to see your target!

This was purchased as a gift from my registry. My baby seems to like this better than the traditional suction. However, after six months of use, the power port fell into the device. It already doesn't come with a power adapter. It's simply not worth $22.
What is this?!?!? How can it have decent reviews.??? It has no suction power !!!!!! None whatsoever. The nose Frida with me doing it has 1000 % more suction.. returned immediately

I got fooled by fake reviews. I have tried to use this on my baby multiple times and only once did I get a booger into this device. All the other times it would either do nothing or loosen but not remove snot. Several times it just ended up pushing the boogers further up her nose. The suction power isn't bad but I just hsve not found this useful. I finally caved and ordered a manual snot sucker.

topic: Lemon Balm Leaf Cut & Sifted Organic - Melissa officinalis, 4 Oz
texts: There really wasn't anything wrong with the tea but it did negatively react with my blood pressure and anxiety medications. I just felt horrible for about 3 weeks until I did some research and found out that it might cause side effects. Had to stop drinking it.
There is Zero lemon scent or flavor in fact it tastes like old black tea in so disappointed! The listing says it's origin is Bulgaria my bag of herbs says Italy.
There are a LOT of stems in this product. And a good amount of powder at the bottom of the bag. It will work for tinctures, not sure if it will be useful for teas.
This tea reminds me when I was younger. The aroma is amazing. The quality of the tea is pretty awesome. I love making it every evening and the price is a great.

Disappointed when I received this—it’s totally absent the wonderful lemon-balm aroma! This is dried and has only a faint herbal smell. Tried adding a bit to my jasmine green tea; it did add a nice touch of lemon flavor. I’ve read lemon balm has various health benefits and it’s supposed to be calming, as well. Think I’ll buy some seeds and grow my own lemon balm plants for the wonderful aroma I’ve experienced with this herb.
I Love Starwest Botanicals for a variety of reasons, but their lemon balm leaf is the best I have had from any distributor. It is fresh, tasty, and fragrant. I am very happy with this product.

The product picture on Amazon lists that the origin of this tea is Bulgaria, yet the package I received lists Egypt as origin. I purchased this specifically for the fact that the herb was from Bulgaria, and am really disappointed that’s not what I got. Flavor is not the same as the one from Bulgaria, so I do not know if that is lemon balm at all. It’s impossible to return or reorder. I feel cheated out.

I bought this bulk herb to make tea. It seems to be a fine quality, but it contains so many stems that get in the way when you are making loose tea. The stems are also not as flavorful or medicinal as the leaves of the plant, so I wasn’t expecting to see any stems. I got a small handful of stems in just a half ounce of the herb.

topic: Johnson's Baby Lotion, Moisturizer For Sensitive Skin, 27 Fl. Oz.
texts: I know there are more expensive, fancier and more touted moisturizers... yet this works for me. Simply wonderful. My hands and body love this stuff. Also, much easier to use with the pump version.:) I may refill if such a thing exists.

Johnson's product are a waste of money you literally just pay for the name. Being an African family with dry skin it's like rubbing scented water on. I have to reapply on my babies multiple times a day. So now I use Vaseline Intensive Care Cocoa Butter lotion for the whole family ages 1m - 25yrs.

Order this baby lotion because the pic showed that it was the old formula and ended up receiving new formula, which is crap and it cannot be returned. Do not buy from this seller if you are looking for the old version of the lotion. Very misrepresented!

I was expecting the ORIGINAL J&J Baby Lotion but instead got fobbed off with the «new & improved» version which is a limp imitation ofn the original and, to boot, instead of a pleasant «baby» scent, now smells like grandma's musty hopechest.

I'm not using this on a baby but my husband and I, both sneaking up on 70 years of age, like using this after washing dishes or our hands. The scent takes us both back to those times when we had a houseful of kids all under the age of 5.
Do not buy from this site. Very disappointed. The one they advertise is different in smell and moisturizing. The one they sent can be bought for the fracture of the price.

After reading so many reviews raving about this, I decided to give it a try. I use it on my adult dry skin. It definitely doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. However, it doesn't do much for moisturizing either. The fragrance was also stronger than expected and can see it causing problems for people who are more sensitive to fragrances. That said, it does smell good and is undetectable within an hour if you'd like to pair it with a different perfume or cologne. For the price, this is a great deal who don't have dry skin issues. I've yet to find a better lotion for the price.

Johnson's baby lotion in the pink bottle is the original. The one with the classic baby powder scent. It is paraban free , hypoallergenic and does not have a greasy feel. I love the baby powder scent and it is not irritating to my sensitive skin. I also love that the lotion is a light pink color.

topic: GentleJetSpa Mastex Luxury Bath Spa Oxygen-Ion Whirlpool Jet Spa
texts: Love it! It moves the water nicely making tons of bubbles. Adheres to tub very well with suction cups. I have no problems with it! Using it 1-2 times per week.

this is the second time i tried this product. had to return the first because it stopped working after first use. bought it again, thinking it was just a defective unit, same thing; worked once, but then never worked again. not going to be trying it a third time; done!

Not really effective in a bathtub for me....too much water (avg 40+ gallons in a standard tub)....and jets are not strong enough to get a "true" spa like experience....but....I did buy a 10 gallon plastic clear storage container, it attaches perfectly with a little water on the suction cups (very strong hold to a plastic container)........added warm water, Epson salt, tea tree oil and two plastic foot massagers.....wonderful foot spa with a jet stronger then most inexpensive home foot baths and deep enough to cover my calf as well......much needed after a long day at work...It's also VERRRY quiet.....
I bought this despite the mixed reviews and I can say I'm glad I did. It may not be a whirlpool tub but it does move the water around nicely and is very relaxing.

I did not expect much from a unit like this but it has lots of power and really moves the water vigorously... I would recommend for anyone who likes baths... Suction cups work well and cord is plenty long for a small bathroom... only down side is very little bubbles and can't tell a difference between bubbles off and bubbles on.. regardless, its a great pump

I purchased this as a gift for my wife for Valentine’s Day. When it came in the mail and out of the box, the suction cups weren’t clear but instead brown. Appeared the device had been sitting in storage for 20+ years. It worked once along with the switch for no bubbles not working. Returned it and got another one. The suction cups this time were worst and had mold on them. It smelled like it was moldy too. Do not by this product.
Used the device 1 time for about 30 minutes. Today I tried to use it and it ran for a few minutes and stopped. Checked plug, wire, unit itself and no reason why it wont work.

This is the fourth time I've bought one of these, the fourth time it has quit working within a month. It's absolutely wonderful when it works. WHEN it works. That's why I keep giving it a shot. This will be the fourth time I have to return one of these.

topic: 4 Pcs Silver Tone Blackhead Acne Remover Needle Tool Stainless Steel
texts: I'm not sure why there are so many high reviews for this one. Many of the different heads were the same thing (size, depth) and while it does have a nice weight, I find them to be too much for my skin often making it worse. I know someone that bought a different set on Amazon, one with a carrying case, and those were much better. If I saw this kit in person I wouldn't have bought it. I may use them as sculpting tools so it's not all gone to waste.
Pieces of crap. Silver painted plastic or plastic with a very thin coating of metal. Either way these suck. The product picture is misleading because they look made of metal.
Not a fan. The loop ends are small and straight. An instrument where the end is more of an oval and curved works much better. Very small, difficult to grasp.

Great tools. Awesome double ended tools. The smaller hoop ends are perfect for pimples or clogged pore extraction. The needle ends are tough & helpful for pulling out clogged pores or ingrown hairs. Invaluable tools for skincare use. My husband and I are addicted to using them. Excellent buy. Pleased!

A friend gave me these and when my daughter lost them she was devastated. So we bought them again.They help pop zits without marring your skin like fingernails do because it equally pressured around the pimple.

these don't work at all. 1. they are hard to hold 2. you can't align over the spot because the hole is too small. 3. if it doesn't work, your left with a donut like shape on your face. 4. they simply don't work 5. the ones with a pointy edge is very pointy, and the tube cover they give you, falls off easily. go with a professional one.

Perfect set. I got these for my face due to small blackheads on my nose. Ive tried everything from home remedies to store bought strips and scrubs. I finally decided to try something new and I am thankful for my venture. I found this set and it shipped fast. I take a really hot towel put it over my nose to open pores once skin is dampened and pores are open I chose the tool with the loop at the end and slowly scrape it over my affected area applying pressure to really bring the blackheads up. May take a few scrapes in each area but really works. The nest thing to do is watch extraction for blackheads on YouTube.
I love these! The one with the little circle works so well in getting rid of blackheads and clogged pores. Tip: put a hot towel over face for five minutes then use

I love these glasses! I don't know how I've gotten by for so long without them. I have a chronic illness, so I am in a lot of pain every day. I can now lie flat and read or watch television when I'm unable to sit up. They are well constructed and very easy to get used to.

I can't believe I bought these. They seem to be manufactured just fine-sturdy and weighty. They come with two nice storage cases. But the eyestrain! You won't be able to wear them for more than a few minutes. It's hard to coordinate your hands on a screen you're using with them on, but you can do it. They do make everything smaller, so I doubt you could use this for a device mobile phone-sized. I was trying to use them for neck strain, but I can deal with neck strain easier than eye strain. These should not be marketed as anything other than gag gifts and movie props.

My friend has these glasses. They are great. So I ordered them and I got a bait and switch. I got something more like the $11 model, but in the same red color. That other model is much larger, but the worst part is the angle is wrong. I have to put it on the end of my nose to use it. Look very carefully if you get this that it looks like the photo. If it doesn't, then return it. If you find this helpful,please click saying so, that way others can be warned.
These are the handiest and most useful items in the world. I have to elevate my legs on the bed for several hours. I can watch TV without contorting my neck by using these prism bed spectacles.

This is a great idea. These glasses were recommended to me by my boss for my back pain issues so I can lay down flat and still work. I will always thank him for that. They are really cool, and I showed them around a bit when I got them, and they got quite an applaud. It would be nice however that the side mirror reflection would not be there, as you almost feel like you are seeing everything time and half.
field of vision is narrower then the last pair ordered sides of the prizm are white instead of black causing a distorted view i would not order this one again
These work perfectly! I love them! Its also awesome to try to walk around with them. Just make sure you don't hit stuff or walk into walls. That may be painful.
They are not that great for wearing on top of other glasses. Other than that they do what they are supposed to do. I wish they were a bit bigger.

topic: ACEVIVI Water flosser Oral Irrigator for Teeth with 4 Jet tips Cordless Rechargeable Portable Power Dental Flosser 180ml, Black
texts: I have been using this for one week.. nothing to complain. Hope this can help me with my gingivitis. really deep cleaning. can see the food come out of his mouth, makes me feel teeth so clean.

I am very pleased with this water flosser. It works exactaly as described and does wonders in my month. I can not compare to anything else since it’s my first time to use this kind of product but it does exactly what I need.

I bought this water flosser because my tooth pretty sensitive, use this to clean my tooth and flush out all residual and with soft setting it’s not hurt. After I got it I start to use it and haven’t charge it yet. So far beening great like it a lot. Only the charger plug seems very special, if I lost it it will be very hard to find another one.
This worked OK at first but then lost power after about a year. Would not pump as strongly even after a full charge. Had to get another brand that works much better.

Worked great....at first. I charged it before using it for the first time. It worked wonderfully and I absolutely loved it until I charged it for a second time. After charging it a second time, the machine completely quit working.

Worked well for the first 4 months. Loved the compact size. was able to store conveniently inside the medicine cabinet. However, after only 4 months, it would no longer hold a charge. Totally useless now.

I purchased this product less than 2.5 months ago and it has already stopped working. I contacted Amazon for returns and they said it was outside of their return policy and to contact the manufacturer for claim. I filled out a complaint form on their site and sent them an email and no one has responded.

I bought this product because I have braces. So it’s easier to floss. However it is messy and Spary’s out so I have to clean the mirro often. Charges very fast and I love I can change the modes. I also enjoy this for traveling because it’s easy to pack.

Everyone is different, perhaps it is just me. I cannot tolerate the taste of this. I had bariatric surgery and it makes a lot of people's taste buds very sensitive. It certainly did mine. So, it is probably just fine for people who did not have that surgery.
Dis-gusting! Horrible vitamin-y after taste and not great at all. Very disappointed in the lack of honest reviews. I've had a half serving and will have to throw the rest away.... It's that bad.
I have used almost all the flavors of Syntrax Nectars in the past and loved almost all of them. This vanilla formula has been changed and is SUPER SWEET! NOT A FAN of this vanilla. :(

This was my go to protein powder. The flavor used to be great. The new bag has no zip or seal, they provide a clip with the scoop and you fold the bag over to close. It does not keep air or moisture out and the clip has already fallen off the bag. I won’t be buying this again
I love it because it is easy to use and taste great. I'm not a milk drinker and it helps be get the milk I need. I make it after my workouts.

I use the natural vanilla and have mixed it with a variety of bases. It blends 100% with no grit or residue, and the taste is great. The most important aspect for me has been the hunger satisfaction. I make a light shake for breakfast and dinner and I am NOT hungry. I've been using it for 2 weeks now and have had a steady weight loss, and I don't feel tired. I would recommend this for any one trying to reduce their dietary/carb intake.
This stuff is great. Very orange tasting, pretty close to Tang when mixed with water. I throw in a couple shots of orange Mio to give it a little more flavor.
Love this powder. All protein powders are expensive but this one is worth it. It tastes great in smoothies or even just in a shaker with almond milk! Already about time to order another jar!

topic: Prestige Medical S8-OCM Stethoscope Domed Id Tag, Owls Cream
texts: I put this on my new stethoscope and within 5 minutes it had fallen off. It's got a cute panda on it, but that's about all I can say about this product. I had to keep trying to stick the ends together, and still it kept falling off. It was a cute idea though.

I bought this as a gift for my daughter who starts nursing school at Loma Linda University next week. She has loved pandas since she was a small girl, so it is very appropriate for her. As I knew she would, she loves it and can't wait to start using it.

Love it! Very cute! Fits on my littmann III. The adhesive is pretty weak but no biggie I just can crazy glue it to ensure no one can take it off. The writing can rub off over time even with sharpie but I always have a sharpie on hand and can write it back on.

This is a cute name tag. I was worried that since it had adhesive, it would end up grabbing my hair like other name tags I’ve used, but it hasn’t at all. I’ve been using it for many months and am still happy with it.

Tape that is used to hold this together on my stethoscope came unglued after only 2 weeks. Tried putting it back on but it keeps coming off. Also kept getting stuck on my hair. Thought it was the snap on kind....

Whenever you attach it to your stethoscope, it doesn't stay. The adhesive on the tag is very cheap; I was planning on using superglue to glue it together so it would stay... but I ended up not even using it.
I like my ID tag with the panda on it. I only wish it didn't slide down to the end all the time. It's very cute and I get plenty of comments about it. Well worth the money.

I love the color and design but it does not stay on. I applied it by following the simple instructions, I even clamped it and did not use my stethoscope for 24 hrs. It still just pops off. So its in a drawer until I find some glue, maybe I can glue it on.

topic: AMANDEAN Premium Gelatin Powder XL. Grass-Fed Beef Collagen Protein Supplement. Unflavored. Healthy Skin, Hair, Nails, & Gut. Paleo Friendly Cooking
texts: We absolutely love this brand. We saw results in as little as 3 days! We have 4 dogs with hip and spine issues. The oldest dog (14) with hip issues is running and playing like a puppy. A friend with painful tendonitis is now using his arm with no pain. And thats just a few of the health benefits. Definitely the best brand out there!

I am no doctor, but I swear this is helping me with a concussion I sustained after running into an Elk in my SUV. Both Gelatin and Bone Broth contain the amino acids in them that help a body make Glutathione which is essential in Brain Health and in my case it is working!

it does not breakdown enough it sticks to cup and spoon I can only imagine what its doing to my intestines. If i could return i would there seems no way of dong so I just used it today when I finished my other product and used only 2 tablespoon and a third of it is in the cup and spoon soaking it and its really stuck.
It's hard to write about a product that has no taste. But it seems to be a very good, trustworthy product of high quality. We use this daily. We will definitely keep buying.

Not what I expected. I am trying to use this in my morning coffee. All I seem to get is a bunch of blobs of slimy goo which will not dissolve. I use water first to try to dissolve it but haven't had any luck. I was hoping it would help my back pain.

Does not bloom like other more expensive brands I've used. Starts to smell pretty bad once its been blooming for about 5 minutes. Seller does not allow returns. Smells so bad after it blooms I can no longer use it. It literally smells like cow craps

The product mixes well and has no taste. I haven't used this product long enough to know how well it works. The five star rating is for the order process - I received my order promptly and with no problem.

I've taken gelatin for many years, but this stuff won't come off the spoon, the cup, your fingers which gets on tge counter and paper towels and us impossible to get off your skin on your fingers. So you won't want to use it!

topic: Silicone Breast Pump 2 Pack, Manual Breast Pump with Protective lid, Portable Milk Saver for Breast Feeding, 100% Food Grade
texts: These are awesome! Wish I had them for my first child. I put one on the opposite side while I breastfeed during the night. I have an “extra” bottle in the morning without any pumping.

Man I wish I would have bought these sooner! I collect 1-3 ounces EVERY TIME I nurse thanks to the silicone breast pump. The pump part of the tittle is a little deceiving. You literally just suction it to your breast and let the suction do all the work! What a great product!

My partner loves these. She said they work as well as the Haakaa and these are much cheaper. She loves having 2 or these for less frequent cleaning or to use both at once when she wakes up in the morning before our daughter. These have great suction and are super easy to clean. Highly recommend!
Got this pump due to suction loss in my motorized breast pump and was hoping this would be better. It has absolutely no suction to empty milk I would NOT recommend this product

I’ve been using these the last couple of days and they do not stay on. I’ve tried different positions and ways to get them to stick and they just don’t. Normally I’m able to collect 3oz from the opposite side but because this product doesn’t suction properly I’m maybe getting half an ounce.

These don’t stay on like other name brands. They’re so flimsy that it doesn’t stay suctioned onto the breast. Had to use a pumping bra with them just so they didn’t fall off from losing so much suction. Just buy a Hakka. Don’t waste your money.
I wanted so badly for these to be like the original, but they are not. They do not have nearly the suction the original does. They are hard to keep on. Splurge and get the original.

Absolutely favorite breastfeeding essential. Great for moms who want to store milk without the hassle of pumping. It's my favorite gift to take new moms immediately after birth! I recommend watching videos on YouTube to know exactly how to work it.

topic: 1 Gallon Reflection Fish Bubble Deluxe Mirrored Wall Mounted Aquarium Tank
texts: I was really excited when I received this as a gift, but upon seeing how it mounted on the wall, i was a little nervous. It's only a nail and a hole in the back. Well, I guess something wasn't straight or even, because my new tank just fell off the wall and exploded, leaving us scrambling to save our fish and the wood floor. If you are going to buy this - i would suggest being a little more creative in securing it to the wall.

I had to get creative with this ,due to damage on the reflected mirror after peeling the sticky protective paper that comes on it. It was cracked and stained in places. I would have returned it ,but had no time it was for a gift. So i went and bought some glitter foam stickers and added my Grand daughters name and some fish and reefs to it came out very nice after I got creative with it.

I ordered this about 3 days ago, and it was at my house this morning! I cant put it up, yet because its for my new house. But im so excited about it!! Its going in my guest bathroom, because it is an under the sea theme. I am just going to change the background of it so it matches the theme. Which is still really cool, that you can put a background of whatever you like. OVERALL, I LOVE IT!!!!!!!!! So cool, i mean not a lot of people have this!
This item has not fallen and it perfect for my betta to swim around in. I bought gemstones vs the rocks in fear of them cutting up Triton, but it is a great piece

Not suitable for bettas. Need a heater in there, and 1 gallon is not ideal; would have to do water changes every day, which I am sure would be hard on a wall mount tank. Also, the open space could mean your fish may jump to it's death; bettas do that. Needs a lid. Very, very bad choice for bettas. Might be good for plants but please don't put a fish in it. It will most likely die.
The product met all of my expectations. I am very pleased with the quality and ease of use and set up. I’m sure these will be a hit with my guests.

Cute for the wall. I wouldn't put a fish in it - cleaning it would be a pain. I tried to put a plant but that was a disaster - the hole at the top is no big enough to put your hand in, so whatever goes in gets dropped or squished. It's a regular fish bubble with a cheap plastic mirror frame around it, but the frame does dress it up and it's cute hanging on the wall. I think I will eventually spray paint the frame a color - will probably hide the cheap part a little better! But it's cute for decor.

Got the product. Thought it was a bigger bowl for my fishy. Requested a return. I was delayed just a bit on returning product because of health reasons. Yet still have not received my refund. Been over a month now. Looks like a nice product but just not as big as I needed or wanted.

topic: 32 inch FDA Registered(3010288069) GrabRunner Reacher Grabber Tool with Strong Magnetic (Purple)
texts: Love this! I got this bc After having my baby it has been extremely hard on my back to bend down and pick up toys/trash while holding the baby and I needed something To make it easier. well this certainly did the trick. It's great quality, the ridges and rubbery material on the end make it easy to grip even the smallest things, it's perfect height for me but I imagine someone taller might struggle with still having to bend over with this. I haven't had it for very long but so far enjoy it very much. If that changes I will update.

For all those things that fall behind the washer or all the things that are too high up to get without a chair. This has come in handy. I don't know why I waited so long to purchase one. Easy to use!! Recommend

After very happy experiences with grabbers purchased from Tack Life & Saymento sellers, regrettably, I purchased this product. It has much narrower grab jaws than either of my other grabbers & within two weeks of the 30 day return window, this model broke, beyond repair, just above where the jaws attach to the shaft. Having learned my lesson, I’ve reordered them Saymento product that I paid considerably less for & it has a 2 year warranty.

When I start to eat too many cookies and fling the package away from me so I can't eat any more, I just use my GrabRunner Reacher Grabber to retrieve it and I don't even have to get up! Oh - it's also useful when I drop something, as bending is difficult for me. And it's red. I like red.

one star only because zero isn't an option. poor design; cheap material; sloppy assembly; complete failure of quality control. it simply fails to work; squeezing the handle does not engage the gripper fingers at all -- so, completely useless.

It's a great device after surgery, like a knee replacement, or a hip. I recently had a hip replaced, but I've always been active. If you don't keep moving , it get's harder to move. So, I got a walker, and a grabber and I get around just fine. Go for it!
All other grabbers are wide enough to pick up a tennis ball, my #1 use for these. But not this brand. It's WAY to narrow so useless for my needs. I tossed it out.

Not sturdy at all and really short. It claims at has a strong magnet lol it doesn't. It weak and will barely pick up any just like the grabber itself . It is definitely not worth the money I paid for just one of these and I need a nice one badly I am really upset with this purchase.

topic: Monrocco 2pcs Female Mannequin Hand Heave Duty Jewelry Display Holder Bracelet Necklace Ring Stand
texts: Not good quality! This is the second time I have to return the item. I’m getting a refund instead of replacement. The black hand again came in scratched and since I’m using these for photos with my hand made jewelry for my website, the scratches show up in the pictures and is unprofessional.

The white is not white, but off-white or ivory and it shows in photographs. Not what I wanted. Also, the base of these is so wide that if you pull an elastic bracelet over them to get a picture of the bracelet on the wrist part, you're stretching that elastic more than you would putting it on your wrist, and then you have to take it off of course, so you do it twice. These are lightweight. I suggest resin, which I have since bought. Yes they get little marks on them. Get a paint pen.
These are magnificent buys. I love the dual colored products that offer me the best colors to display rings according to their metals/colors and designs. Would highly recommend and will buy again!

When I got the product the white hand had red stains on it. I thought I could wipe it off and can’t. I am now looking for somewhere else to buy a clean hand. They are nice but I just don’t like that it came stained.

I bought these as props for photographing jewelry I sell. They are a great size...they fit average size rings and bracelets and display them well. These do not look cheap, and having them in 2 colors will really offset the jewelry.

Great quality while struggling with BDO this has helped so much. With the lack of hand eye coordination and thumbs these have served as a amazing fix. Went from losing pvp fights 100% of the time down to 90% of the time 10/10 would recommend. Sending a pair to my boy KingCe

Really disappointed when I opened the package. As you can see in the photos, the black mannequin hand had scratches, dents, and smudges around the whole thing. The white mannequin hand came with a defect on the bottom, again, as you can see in the photos, the bottom of the hand is warped so it doesn’t stand up straight, it wobbles. Just seems like there’s no quality assurance at this company, and the hands aren’t glossy like they seem in the product photos, they’re like a dull matte shine (at best) in person. Ya get what ya pay for I guess, definitely retuning these though. Wouldn’t recommend.

I read the reviews before buying and was scared to get it because I thought my rings wouldn’t fit on the fingers but they actually did. I still do wish the fingers were a little skinnier but great product overall and would buy again. I’m a size 6/7

topic: OptiWand - Soft Contact lens insertion & removal device
texts: For me, completely useless. The contacts just cling to the cup and won't come off. Much easier to do by hand. Too bad. It would have been nice not to have to touch them with fingers.

I read the reviews on this product but didn't believe ...dont waste your money on this its so difficult to use to insert or remove directions very vague.... i threw it in the garbage... trust me its not good.

This product restored my faith in wearing contact lens. I was about to give up on wearing them. It was taking way to much time it put into eyes every morning. I was getting up a extra hour in the morning just so I had enough time to insert lenses. But now I am sleeping long and can put both lenses in fast.
took a little getting used to but I have very thick fingers and this helped tremendously being able to see through it to line up my lenses great time saver.

The product fell short of my expectations. I was not able to successfully apply contacts using this device. I do not wear contacts regularly so I was hoping to find a product that would help with application. I found that the concave area was bigger than the contacts and just suctioned to my eyeball. Not a pleasant experience.

It did not work. I needed contacts of the right size. The first md prescribed me contacts that were too small. We fixed that and now I don't need anything other than my fingers. Remember dry finger, wet eye. It must be very dry, your finger. Your eye must be wet enough. Get the contact to stick to your eye more than your finger and then blink to get the contact to set.

This product is worth every penny. I had problems with the contacts sticking to my finger every time I tried to put them in. This worked for me the very first time I used it. I would definitely recommend this product if you're having problems putting your contacts in.

I am an old guy, new to soft contact lenses. I struggled mightily putting my lense in (I only need to use one) with my fingers, with success on only a couple of occasions. I started using the OptiWand 5 days ago and found it to be very easy and speedy to use and have enjoyed 100% success with it. I use it only to insert the lense (the hard part!), but continue to use my fingers to remove it. (That's easy!) I had dreaded the time to put my lense in. Now, no problem, nor worry at all.

topic: Chem-Dry Professional Strength Spot Remover 20 Oz (2 Pack)
texts: The best carpet cleaner I have every used and we have pets. Never failed! Used on coffee, spilled mascara and all sorts of carpet stains. We recently moved and the carpet shows every little stain - I do not know what I would do without this product. The carpet is an aqua (hate it); but can't replace it yet and it works without taking any of the ugly color out.

Chem Dry Spot Remover works very well with a particular dispenser: the blue trigger dispenser one. I specifically chose this item because the picture showed the blue trigger dispenser. I received cans with a white push button dispenser. This push button does not work at all well. It does not release the cleaner effectively. Be aware that you will not be receiving the product you think you ordered if you purchase your item from this seller.

I have used this product for many years and always purchased it from the company that cleaned the rugs in my home. Recently I moved, knew I would not be using the same rug cleaning company and finally ran out of the product. I was thrilled to find it available on Amazon. It cleans everything; food spills, tracked in dirt and even accidents by my dog. There is never a trace left. It takes me years to use one 20 ounce can so I'll probably gift the second one. Highly recommend this product.

I have always liked Chem Dry products, but I have ordered 4 of the Spot Remover Professional Strength and they spray maybe 2 or 3 times, and then that's it. The last 3 cans have had 1/2 or more left in the can that will not spray out. So disappointing and quite a WASTE of my money to say the least!!!

Im also a long term Chem-Dry user and fan but I've become victim like so many on here that bought the product only to get 3 sprays of use out of it. then it stops dispensing the fluid. All I get is bubbles and malfunctioning button with a full bottle of product remaining. Since this is not the first time this issue is being reported, we can only assume that Chem Dry is selling their worst product to Amazon. Dont buy it. Never ever again. Chem Dry has lost its remarkable reputation.

This stuff is so professional that the can should have a suit and tie painted on it. It’s a great product that is honestly in a class of its own. No detergent cleaners can work as well, nor keep carpets cleaner longer. This stuff doesn’t attract new dirt like soaps do. That’s Mr. Chem-Dry, to you…

It ruined my carpet leaving it yellow. A spot I did not try this on I used Resolve and it worked great. Of course Amazon will not return the money. I am out $50 plus I will have to replace the carpet. DO NOT BUY this product!!

WOW! Chem-Dry professional carpet cleaner is a miracle in a spray can. I have used it for years to remove spots on the carpets, nothing else cleans as well. (I did buy special carpet cleaner for puppy urine because Chem-Dry couldn't get all of the odor out.) Otherwise, that's the only carpet spotting it didn't completely remove. You gotta try Chem-Dry!

topic: 10 Stage Plus Water Filter Replacement Cartridge 1 Unit
texts: My husband and I have tried several water filtering systems through the years. RO, Ph Alkaline, etc. Which were all very good. We wanted a filter that was economical and still kept the healthy minerals needed in water. we have used this water filter system for a 7+ years.

I've used the 10 Stage New Wave Enviro for years, but this new style of cartridge is totally useless. It didn't even filter out the chlorine, you could still smell it in the "filtered" water. Couldn't return it, so threw it out and re-installed the old one. Now I'm looking for another of the old style of filter.
This is my first replacement filter cartridge for the water filter. I had a question about installation and the person I spoke with detailed it perfectly. Great filter, great customer service!
This filter system is the best price / quality option I have found. It lasts up to a year and removes all of the hazardous materials found in water that we are concerned with.

The unit works extremely well and produces a good stream of well-filtered water. Unfortunately, the replacement cartridge can be impossible to replace. Yes, I've soaked the unit in hot water and vinegar. I've even used rubber straps to gain purchase and leverage. The company says I should just pack it up and send it back, and they will be happy to repair it for me. That's nice, but I would be much happier if the company had designed a better product in the first place.

I've purchased several 10 Stage Water Filter over the years and have replaced the filter many times. For some reason, this replacement unit doesn't seem to be filtering out the chlorine taste. I am returning it for a replacement.

we got ours last year, and it has beed a saver, I use only that water, we used to buy galons and bottled water every week and special water for my baby, since that no more expensive water, now I just need to open it to chage cartridge, does anyone knows?

I had used this water filter system for years and it worked perfectly, but when I got this OEM replacement filter, apparently a new version, it was awful. The water had a weird after taste it didn't have before. I have switched to a different brand and my water now tastes great again. The price was also almost double what I paid for the previous replacemnt filter. This has me wondering if this was really an OEM filter.

topic: Sminiker Professional Version Electric Razor 4 in 1 Rechargeable Ladies Cordless Electric Shaver with Body Hair Bikini Trimmer Facial Cleansing
texts: The first day I got it, I tried to change the tops (blades) and because the pieces don’t fit properly I had to wiggle it with so Much force It Ended up breaking. So I figure it was my fault but then keep Reading reviews on how the top parts don’t fit properly. One of the blades doesn’t shave my Legs at all and the other one cuts my skin and pulls my hair. And now come January (bought in October) it doesn’t hold a charge. I don’t know if I can return but I’m gonna try. What a waste!

After 2 years with this it recently would not shut off after use. Took many pushes of the button for it to shut off. And now it randomly turns on my itself. Last night was the last straw, it woke me up 3 times in the middle of rhe night, turned itself on. No joke. No battery can be removed to stop this. I need to take a hammer to it and throw it away.

This is a versatile set. It has a leg shaver, bikini line trimmer, and a facial cleansing head. I like that I can use it in the shower. The facial scrub head really gets my face clean. The manicure set in the compact pink case was a nice addition.

This shaver is easy to use and I love that the blades are simply push and pull, (no buttons on the side to push in while trying to get the blade off.) I have problems using a razor in the shower and just HATED shaving, now I can go back to wearing shorts. Provided a close, clean shave.

I bought this for my wife as a gift, this is her thoughts on it... I haven’t owned an electric razor in over 20 years, and I’m so glad I have this one! I wanted a dependable, affordable, and chemical free alternative to my standard razor, and this one has impressed so far. The 3-in-1 blade was gentle on my legs and easily removed hair without excess pressure. The small trimmer was the perfect size for the bikini line and didn’t result in ingrown hairs or burn. I’m going to use this for a long time to come!

I liked this razor okay until it quit charging after just a few months of use. It never did shave very close. The price seems enough that the razor should last more than just a few months. I would not purchase again.
Have had it since April.. Used it twice and now the motor isn't working properly 🙁. Haven't dropped it and kept it charged but not over charge. Would have gave it five stars if not for this.

I am really happy I tried this based on the other reviews. It's just as shown and I especially love the base and plug options. I'm most excited about the brush add-on as it's unexpected, and it has the perfect softness for my face. Great value for money here. Update: This product holds a charge a lot longer than expected and I am still happy that I bought it, having now used the face cleaning brush as well as the shaver/trimmer.

topic: Rapid Remover Vinyl Letter Remover 32 oz. Bottle with Sprayer Adhesive Remover for Vinyl Wraps Graphics Decals Stripes
texts: The reviews and photos make you think it will work perfect, but it doesnt. Removed side molding from a 2014 vehicle, use the 3M magic eraser to get rid of the adhesive, and then used this stuff to remove the rest; didn't work.

Removed the 13 year old stripes off my Mustang. There was some good spots of adhesive left. Finally got the time to research products and found this stuff. Worked great in concert with some plastic razor blades. Followed directions and pretty much 95% came off with first application. Second application got the rest. Immediately washed the car with Simple Green through the pressure washer. All traces of adhesive and adhesive remover are gone. Car looks great.

Works well had it before. Ran out ordered more . Still waiting for it been like 3 or 4 weeks.. when I ordered it.. it said a date to arrive. Still waiting like I said 3 or 4 weeks out .. sux waiting for something I ordered

I had overspray on the hood of my car from spray painting in my garage. I did some research and this was used by many car detailing business so I ordered it and have no regrets. It took a 3 different wipe and spray of this product but all the overspray paint came off and my car is back to its shiny self.

I tried everything to remove the adhesive residue from a 7 year old clear bra on my car but nothing worked. I must have wasted 50 dollars and 8 hours of labor. I asked a professional detailer and he recommended this product. I sprayed it on the adhesive and let it sit for 60 seconds. I then used a plastic razor to scrap off the adhesive which came off like hot butter. So amazed. Looking at morons leaving reviews about it not being able to remove stickers. Use a heat gun to remove stickers then use this stuff to remove the adhesive.
This stuff is awesome and the price is really great. I do recommend this. I used this to remove adhesive window film it really works great easy clean up. Thank you 10 Stars

We buy many good products thru Amazon but they should be ashamed to sell this one. Does NOT work at all! No way to return for a credit and not cheap. Warm water works better! Don't waste your money! Buyer beware. DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT!!!!
Too expensive for an adhesive remover. I have to remove the vinyl letters with a heat gun, then use this to remove the adhesive that remains. Not what I thought I was buying!!

topic: (Official) Dentitox Pro for Gums, for Men and Women, Gum and Teeth Liquid DentitoxPro Drops
texts: I have only been using this for approximately a week. My gums aren’t bad but this product seems to make my gums feel better. I’ll keep using as a part of my daily routine.

I bought this product because I have receding gums and I wanted my gums/teeth to be healthier. I applied the liquid to my gums last night and this morning am experiencing burning/throbbing sensation of the gums. Additionally, the taste is horrible! This morning, the medicinal taste in my mouth still lingers. I will stop using the product and return to Seller: Vitalina Nutrition. I hope my gums and teeth will not have long term repercussions. Has any one else had an adverse reaction with this product?
Looks like my gums could be growing back. I see my dentist next week I’ll be interested to see if he notices. My teeth do seem whiter. And I absolutely have less pain on gumline

I have been using Dentitox Pro for a little over 10 days.. I have been using it for swollen gums and bleeding gums. Although my gum issues are not completely healed, they are much healthier..the swelling has come down, and the gums are not bleeding, I highly recommend you give this product a chance..it is working much better than anything I have tried in the past

I watched the video claiming this very sour liquid was how the people of rural Africa kept their teeth and gums healthy, with no access to dentists. The very expensive bottle that arrived contains a sweet, cinnamon tasting liquid with a glycerine/syrup like consistency. SCAM SCAM SCAM SCAM SCAM!

The label is poorly printed. The “manufacturer’s” website does not list this as one of their products. The price is too good to be true. I believe that the bottle I received is a knockoff, so I’m not going to open and use it. To label this as “(official)” is absurd.
This made my gums that weren’t bleeding before start bleeding. Made my breath have a smell. And my teeth more sensitive. Did exactly the opposite of what it should do
I’m always skeptical this project is a miracle worker I love this, I strongly suggest that if you don’t have money for the dentist this is the little miracle worker in a bottle hands down!!

topic: Sunroom Webster Microfiber Cobweb Hand Duster Telescoping 48"
texts: I expected this to be stiffer. I thought the picture shows a round spherical head. However, it looks more like a toilet bowl scrubber. It is a looped wire inside, not a spherical bristle shape. It is floppy fibers. It does work, I was just thinking it was something else.

I have had this product for sometime now. Although it’s easy to use, I’m not able to figure out how to clean it. The cleaning head Cannot be detached from the shaft so you can’t really reuse or replace. It’s one time use only kinda product

Not what I expected. Will not last long and just after 3 cleaning the brush was really dusty. I tried cleaning it by washing off the dust but it doesn't seem to be working. After 3 cleanings I was trying to clean the windows with this and the handle got bent and almost broke off. I recommend getting one of those ikea dusters instead.
This thing came in the mail, opened the package looks like toilet bowl cleaner, tested the item out, left strands on ceiling, went to H Depot, got the real deal Cobweb brush a stick. Returned item

It's hard to tell from the photos, but the fibers on the dusting head are actually in a loop--it's not a globe. The dimensions of the head are 5.5" W x 5" H x 3.25" D, and the wand extends to 45". The head's supposed to be bendable but I can only bend it a very small distance. They say it's washable but I can't find any way to detach the head from the wand, so I guess you wash it by placing the head under water without immersing the wand.

Works fine. Extends to reach ceiling corners where cobwebs tend to gather. Duster itself is not as big as I wanted, (my fault for not reading description carefully) but it's very soft and does the job well.

Somewhat disappointing. The head is quite small, and not particularly full or fluffy. There is no way to remove the head to wash it and put it back on the instrument. At some point, I will have to hand wash just the head in the sink I guess. Very inconvenient. I would have expected a higher quality product at this price point. I will turn to a janitorial supply resource.

This duster is better than expected. The telescopic is awesome for those high places and the dust does not fly around. It cleans as easy as a shake outside. This is better than using furniture spray and a cloth.

topic: Dentitox Pro Drops for Teeth and Gums (3 Bottles. 6oz)
texts: I purchased this on their company website and paid way too much to find out it’s on Amazon and a whole lot less expensive. Not the same taste or flavor. Would not purchase again.

I had a horrible toothache and the dentist found nothing wrong. I used and have been using this product after I brush twice or three times a day and the pain is 100% gone!! I will keep using for sure!!

So i have ordered this product before and been happy with it. Normally, it is thick, almost oily and has a strong but not unpleasant, taste. I was super disappointed when a few days ago i received three bottles of watery stuff with hardly any flavor at all. Dont know if its the company, a distributor, the seller or who, but someone is trying to rip people off. I hate it when they do that!! Buyer beware!

I bought this product originally from the actual site promoting it. When I got the refills from Amazon, the bottles were so watered down I'm pretty sure they were just water. Seriously just water. Total rip off. Might want to check your inventory or supplier on these.

This product was ordered for my husband. I was skeptical but he was insistent that it works. He has been using the product for about a year and I cannot deny the results when his hygienist said to him, "Whatever you are using, keep it up." "You are doing a great job on your teeth."

The advertisements say it will grow a tooth back but it doesn't. I used three bottles of it and thought I was done but after a few months I could tell that my teeth were not as strong as when I was using this stuff so I bought some more. It's one of those things that you can't tell how good it is until you stop using it.
I had a tumor on my gum and a broken tooth as well nerve pain. The tumor disappeared and the nerve pain is tremendously reduced. I will continue until it is truly healed

This is the second time I have bought this type of product. This one is in larger bottles and it taste as if it is watered down because of the larger bottbles it taste mainly like water. I would not reccommend this to anyone ???

topic: FRK Digital Body Weight Bathroom Scale, High accuracy with Tempered Glass Platform, Smart Step-on Technology, Batteries Included
texts: The scale looks great, seems accurate. My big complaint is the poor quality of the directions enclosed. No diagram of battery placement,little information or diagram of changing from pounds to kilos. I finally got it working, but have no idea of how I did it. It took me quite a long time to get it working properly when it should have taken only a few minute!
Received in record time. Seller is a great communicator. It is actually an elegant looking scale. So far, so good. It might be a little small for someone with big feet, but it is perfect for me.
Low profile. Sleek. Easy to read. Appears to be reliable and accurate after having it for a few months. I would recommend this as a good product for a very reasonable price.

Nice style .The scale functions well as far as reading weight goes. It eats batteries. We have had to replace batteries after two weeks repeatedly. We do not even use it on a daily basis. Perhaps the one we got is defective but there is nothing to indicate it is turning on randomly or staying on excessively long. Caveat emptor.
It took a while for this scale to work, it kept saying I weighed 7 lbs. I fiddled with it and now it works and it's accurate. Sigh, time to diet.

First let me say the the scale looks good, works good and seems to be accurate. When I first received it eleven months ago it required battery (3 AAA) replacement after about six weeks. Each replacement came a little sooner until the latest (and last) required replacement after only four (4) days of once-a-day use. It is advertised with a two year satisfaction guaranteed or replacement or money back warranty. We will see about that.
I doesn't say the same weight twice. You step on and get one reading then you give it a minute and try again and you get a whole different reading. Very upsetting.

Worked great for about 5 months, then it started malfunctioning. Now it is highly variable in weight when I am standing still and is completely inaccurate in the weight (as in multiple hundreds of pounds inaccurate) or just gives an "Err" message. Changed the batteries, toggled back and forth between kg and lbs, the issue would not correct.

topic: BHU Keto Bites – Variety Pack (3 Bags)
texts: Love the taste, and love that they tried to make a healthier alternative to sugary treats. Unfortunately, it has palm oil, which has been linked to cancer in animal studies. The research has not been conducted in humans yet and is limited in its scope, so decide for yourself if it's worth the small risk. I decided it wasn't worth it for me. I also contacted the company support, and they confirmed that they have no plans to change their formula anytime soon.

I only tried a tiny bite of the chocolate one, I had a huge stomach ache and bloating ,felt awful . I never get bloating or stomach problems any more unless there are the bad sweeteners . The flavor was not there for me either. I bought mine at whole foods i am a prime member and it is in my past purchase history and for some reason i was unable to write a review there.
The flavors come through, but the texture needs improvement. It's moist but at the same time still dry? Like pasty, I'm not sure how to describe it, all I know is that I don't like it.

I have been buying these on and off for a few years- usually after having a baby and trying to eat healthy. These are my go to treat and I LOVE THEM! If someone gives them a bad review, they are crazy!!! They are a little pricey but well worth the money for a special treat now and again!
These were melted so not a winner. If you order them make sure they come straight from the manufacturer and they’ll be fresh. I was disappointed with this one bc it was all separated

These are absolutely delicious. My top favourite is the White Chocolate Macadamia, largely because it's so rare to enjoy sugar-free white chocolate treats. All flavours are great, though! My order was shipped faster than I expected, packed thoughtfully with insulation and an ice pack, and I received a nice hand-written note from the sellers which was a thoughtful touch. (As a note for future orders, for those of us who live in a hot state, during spring and summer that small of an insulation/ice pack won't do very much good without rapid shipping. Hoping the sellers can take this into account.) I will definitely be ordering more of Bhu's products!

I should’ve read the reviews before I ordered! I usually do, but I figured I know this brand and it’s usually fine. Didn’t realize these were one of their products that needs to be refrigerated. The packaging even says to keep below 72 degrees, so not sure why these are being sold to only then be shipped without anything to keep them at the correct temperature. Colossal waste of money bc not like I can return them since I obviously opened one of the packages. Don’t order these!
My only issue is the flavors are arbitrary in the 3-pack. I wish I had the option of choosing the flavors I wanted. But they are consistently fresh and good.

THIS IS NOT WORTH BUYING IT'S HUGH AND DID NOT FIT IN ANY OF MY SIZE 6 SHOES, I TRYED CUTTING ONE AND IT LOOKS HIDEOUS AND I SHOULDN'T HAVE TO CUT IT. DO JOT BUY UNLESS YOU HAVE HUGH FOOT AND HOPE IT FITS. I WISH I COULD GET A FULL REFUND BACK FROM THE SELLER IF I COULD REACH THEM
Horrible China poor cheap quality. These don’t last more than 2 weeks. Entire family tried them. Not worth the money. I would not pay more than 50 cent for a pair.
Love these! They give me additional cushion that I was looking for. They made my shoes so much more comfortable, I have already placed another order for my other shoes.
Thick and comfortable when they come out of the package. I use mine in a medical boot because it is so hot and the inserts are flat with no cushion (and I doubled up) after 2 days.

topic: Apalus Hair Straightening Brush, Fast Natural Straight Hair Styling, Anion Hair Care, Anti Scald, Massage Straightening Irons, Detangling Hair Brush
texts: Straightening hair brushes have come a long way since they were first introduced. I bought one of the very first brands when they first came out and it was clunky and hard to handle with a plug that kept falling out of the wall. Such a contrast to this brush! This brush has a sleek ergonomic handle and it doesn't feel clunky in my hands when I'm styling my hair. Plus it's very light weight which makes styling so much easier. Not to mention that it works great! No frizz styling and straightens like a champ. I use this brush every day now and I'm so glad to have it!

I don't get why people are giving 5-star reviews on this product! Okay I bought this because I was fooled by the reviews. I don't like giving negative reviews to items but I'll have to give it a 0-star! When you turn it on and it's heating up it smells like canned jalapeños and the smell never goes away! I take way longer trying to straighten my hair with this thing than with a regular hair straightener. Just use a regular hair straightener! Using this is super weird and it just doesn't do the job of a regular hair straightener! Avoid it and save your money! Don't be fooled by the reviews like I was!
This brush works very well. I have super thick hair so it is hard to get it super smooth and straight but it does a good job. I'm happy with it.

Paid for 2 day shipping and received the package on time. Everything was intact the brush was brand new and in new packaging. I purchased this for my daughter and myself. We are both natural and I wanted something to take the curl out of our hair with ease for styles that didn't require curls. The brush did just that. It by no means made our hair bone straight but it straightened it enough for me. If you're looking for a flat iron replacement and you have thick natural hair then this product is not for you because you will still need to pull out your flat iron.

Nope. This thing takes forever to warm up and doesnt even come close to a hot iron. I have the brazilian blowout so my hair is straight but since its a bob it requires some heat to shape it. This thing didnt even give me a nice "tousled" look
Great product! I have very thick curly hair and was able to straighten it within 15 minutes whereas it usually takes 30-40. Let some friends try it and they ordered one each as well!!

Not worth your money. Doesn't do well on naturally curly hair. Would be better off getting a steam infused flat iron. This brush will take you hours to get your hair straight. Will probably work very well on fine hair. It just wasn't the correct purchase for my needs.

This product just does not work. I have curly hair and use a flat iron. I thought this would help save me some time. But instead it wastes my time and I never get the silky straight hair that I usually get from my flat iron.

topic: Safe Shower Arm Suction Hose Holder for Hand-held Shower Heads
texts: Bought this when I changed out my dual shower head and have never used it... because it won't stick to my tiles at all. By that I mean it won't hold it's own weight, let alone my heavy handheld shower head. The thing may (repeat MAYBE) stick to glass or new slick tiles but not to my tiles. Bummer.

We have been using this item for several months and are very pleased with it. We recently moved to a rental that has only a walk-in shower stall with smooth walls. The shower head was detachable but the bracket was too high for our young children to reach. This has been a very useful item, easily holding the shower head in place while they shower. I would recommend this to anyone needing a safe, easy way to hold a handheld shower head.

This is crap, it doesn't stay on any surface, cleaned or smooth, wet or dry. It doesn't stay on for more than five minutes by itself and less than that holding a shower head. Great idea, but don't waste your money.
I read the reviews that said this would only stick to glass but I thought for sure it would stick to my mostly flat ceramic tile. Nope. It doesn't. Listen to the others, don't waste your money!

I had originally purchased one of these from another website and after 4 years it fell and broke. Thanks to Amazon I was able to replace it. The suction is superior to a few of the other knockoffs (grey color). I like how easily the arm rotates the shower head and holds it at just the right height & angle needed for my little ones.
The shower head holder is a bit smaller than the shower head I have, but it holds it anyway, as long as I've got the right angle. It's cheap and it works.

We have purchased several of these and they seem compatible with all different handheld shower heads. The suction is quite substantial and you won't need to readjust this as it will stick for weeks. We've used it on fiberglass and smooth tile and it sticks amazingly well, much better than you would think, and provides a very stable shower mount. They last a long time, but will wear out where the shower head handle fits into this "C" base part. the repeated in and out will cause the "C" base part to crack over time. This isn't really a problem and the same thing happens to the regular shower head's "C" base part.
