texts: This Flosser worked for about 3 months. Then the tooth brush quit working. The Flosser still works but not as strong as when I purchased it. I would not suggest to purchase this item. I’ve contact the seller but doesn’t seem to want to do anything about this defect.

I have dental implants that were giving me problems. Flossing implants is a real disaster. Since I started using my new toothbrush/water flosser my gums are much improved. My mouth feels so clean. Since I travel a lot, having both the toothbrush and flosser in one is just great. I brush, quickly switch to the flosser head and I'm done.

Very easy to use - ready to go right out of the box. It comes with several different heads for different uses. I primarily use the flossing head and love how clean my teeth feel. I bought this because I hate traditional flossing and wanted an alternative way to take care of my teeth - I was not disappointed!

Great product for a great price my son has braces and he loves the WaterPik portion it cleans out his braces very well, we highly recommend this product if you have braces were you looking to get a really good clean on your teeth

I purchased this toothbrush/water pic in May. The window to return has ended which is extremely disappointing because it's stuck on waterpic mode and I no longer have an electric toothbrush. The button to change the mode from toothbrush to waterpic never worked properly and took several tries to get what you wanted. Now it's completely broken & useless. Super annoying! Do not buy!

Ok so yes this is a great toothbrush. The down side is having to use the water hose to sit on something big that holds water. Other than that after using the toothbrush my teeth feel like I just left my dentist after they cleaned my teeth! I use the normal setting. Strong water pressure when using the water flosser. Love running my tongue over my teeth & feel that smooth, clean feeling.

1st electric toothbrush. My only issue is the timer. I don’t think the extended timer works. That being said I LOVE the water pic and I am very happy with the toothbrush. I ended up buying one for everyone in the house

The best of all the pack! Just when you've had a good deal! It gets better with this particular deal! Good product good thinking!! Cost efficient, pocket friendly indeed. Purchase more and send to my children overseas!

topic: FitJoy Mini Protein Bars, Chocolate Peanut Butter, Gluten Free, Grain Free, Low Carb, .67 Ounce, 16 Pack
texts: Wow, these hit the spot! Always looking for sweets that are low carb and low fat. I loved all the sample flavors. Will definitely purchase again and I highly recomend this tasty treats!
I truly enjoyed my first box of FitJoy Bars. The small sizes were great for a before or after workout bite. I'll be getting more of them and I highly recommend them.

These bars are the perfect size for a snack bar, but after reading other reviews I was a little disappointed in the taste. I have had 3 in two weeks, the flavor gets a little better, but I don't think I would go with the chocolate peanut butter again.

FitJoy is a great product. It’s just enough chocolaty goodness to get away with; without feeling guilty. The amount of protein with low carbs is great for us attempting to make better food choices each day.
I like that it is a healthy treat, low calorie, low sugar and high portein. It also satisfies my sweet tooth . I enjoy it with a cup of coffee .

They don't have alot of peanut butter flavor but, they're tasty. Considering the carb count and the amount of protein, I definitely would buy them again, perhaps the lemon bar flavor. They have a good lemon taste.

To say these are small and overpriced is a huge understatement! These are 2 bite sized and not anywhere worth what they are charging. They taste like the full size bars so I gave it 2 stars but know what you are getting before you decide to try.

These bars are very tasty and do keep me satisfied for quite a long time. I have been following WW so the point value of 2 is great. However, the bars are small. I understand there is a larger version (4 points). A bit pricey but worth it to have a low point "sweet" snack.

topic: Maternity Belt - Pregnancy Support Belly Brace, - One Size
texts: I purchased this and at 22 weeks. I have an anterior placenta and my lower back has been extremely sore. This band took a lot of pressure off my lower back. It didn't come with instructions or wash instructions, other than that it's been a great purchase

For the price, it is a great belt. After a few days, it seems like decent quality especially for the price. I can tell that my lower back feels more supportive. I like how it's adjustable in the front with extra adjustment for the back support. I already recommended it to a pregnant friend.

I am 6 months pregnant and wore this once. Unfortunately I did not like it because it didnt stay on comfortably. It would roll up and felt so uncomfortable on me. I had to undo and redo it the entire time I wore it.

This maternity belt helped lessen my back ache immediately. I am really petite so I have to tighten quite a bit but it's adjustable so that is no issue. The only thing I didn't like was that you have to take it off to use the restroom; being 7 months pregnant that hapoens quite a bit. All in all I really like it and would recommend this product.
Very nice, super soft support. It is comfortable for me, need to adjust when I sit or stand but if you are on your feet for a long time works well.

I didn't have extremely high expectations for this product. My pregnancy is almost over so I didn't want to spend an arm and a leg on a name brand band. I would have been happy with ANY relief but after only wearing it about an hour my back felt worse. I wouldn't recommend it at all.

I purchased this belt because my pregnancy activated my sciatica and I felt perhaps using the belt during my work hours would help. I think perhaps my lil belly at 4 months isn't a good match for a belt now however, I did use it a couple of times and it's soft and supportive and I am excited to wear it when I am further along.

This was perfect and much needed for me to make it through my pregnancy comfortably. I had a little guy who loved to be low and this relieved the pressure on my pelvis and lower back. I highly recommend for any mamas having issues.

bought these for my brother in law who recently has had to rest more in bed. We loved the concept and were excited to try them after reading the great reviews! Maybe we didn't try them for long enought, but they were really tough to use. Instantly felt cross-eyed and a bit dizzy from using them.
These are great! I read a lot lying down, so these work very well. They are surprising clear, no distortion at all. I got a pair for my daughter. We'll see if she likes them.

I was put off when the glasses arrive in a package mostly in oriental thinking they were lower quality but I was mistaken. I've already ordered a second pair. They are very clear. They work for me and my 15 year old daughter that knits for hours. You can work on your tablet or watch tv. We did not experience the nausea others reported.

I bought another pair of these and the picture shows them to be the same as my first pair (which I gifted away). These are decidedly different and of poorer design. The prisms are set far apart and leave a 3" blind spot in the middle of your field of view. Additionally, that field of view is much narrower than most prism specs (think 12" wide at arm's length). Additionally the fit is loose and they constantly struggle with falling off. The picture here is not what you get; there's not a word of English anywhere on the box you receive, though the stock photo is the same. I will be returning these.

I bought as pair of these glasses several years ago when I had a neck injury and couldn't find a comfortable position in bed to watch TV. They were a Godsend! That pair finally gave out and these seem to be much more substantial than the original ones so I look forward to enjoying them for a long time. Thank you for such quick shipping.
These work, but you have to want to like them. :) They are quite heavy. I will definitely keep them on hand for when a back flare up prevents me from watching TV in bed at an odd angle.

My wife could not sit up in bed to watch our bedroom TV. With these she can lie flat and see the TV on the opposite wall. They do not fit over Rx glasses, so that is a disadvantage, but they do what was advertised.

I first bought these a bit skeptical that they would work and that they would be comfortable to wear. I use them now daily with my tablet, computer, or phone in bed. Only con I can think of is if you already wear glasses already these won't work to well.

topic: Pure Hydration Coconut Water Drops, 30 Servings, 1oz, Pack of 2 (Packaging May Vary)
texts: I get concentrated benefits of green tea without having to deal with the caffeine in green tea which irritates my nervous system. I love the peach flavor and add it to my teas or just to my water and it tastes great and gives me a subtle energy boost. The only downside is that it is pricy. I also wonder why it is sold by cosmeticians...But as I have not found other formulas that deliver high concentrations of beneficial green tea extract, I am happy with this one.
This is a great product but does make the water seem a little oily and heavy and does give me gas. It has a great taste of raspberry and adds that extra kick to your water.

Personally I find this delicious. I first discovered it at a spa where they had various flavors, and this one was my favorite. Supposed to have some good health benefits, and the bottle lasted me a few months of me using it multiple times per day every work day!
I love this stuff. However the box was open when I received it today and there is a hole in the dropper and it's leaking. So I guess I will not be buying this again.

My first experience with this product was at a spa when offered to me to hydrate. I have purchased the product on my own since that time. I enjoy the coconut flavor......every sip of my water is very refreshing.
I love this stuff. They serve it at the spa that I go to, which is how I first found out about it. Love the taste it adds to my water.

I’m obsessed with this stuff and can no longer drink plain water. The only drawbacks are the price-it isn’t cheap- and you need to add a fair amount to get it to taste like it does in the spa. Otherwise it’s freaking awesome.
I got this product based on the reviews but the taste is off.. It's sweet but no sour or fruity tones at all.. Maybe it's expired? I think the price is crazy for this thing??

topic: Phonak Tv Connector for Marvel and Paradise Hearing aids
texts: Have had one for almost three months. Hooks up to hearing aid automatically almost all the time, if not, smart phone app enables you to do it manually. I have the tv sound coupled thru the computer enabling me to either hear the TV[[ASIN:B079DW35QQ TV Connector (Black)]], or the computer. Mine will transmit thru two walls, it even stays coupled when I exit the house. I have my sound processed thru a creative sound card so I can adjust the different frequency's and have automatic sound volume. Am looking to purchase another for the garage, tired of moving from the house. I can hear the Blu Ray player over the tool noise.
I like everything about this connector. I can hear the TV without it being turned up to the point people tht hear well are asking me to turn it down. Worked perfectly right out of the box.

This was for friend with Phonak hearing aids who was dependent on reading captions when watching television. This contraption worked like a miracle. After years of not being able to hear TV, suddenly the sound was crystal clear. Had tried other, cheaper Bluetooth receivers prior this but they were not seamlessly integrated into the Phonak hearing aids the way this one is and were ungainly to use. Well worth the higher price for the ease with which it works and the pleasure it gives to the user.

The range of this bluetooth extender for Phonak hearing aids is very poor. It only goes 30 to 50 feet line of sight. Signal is blocked by most types of walls. As you move away from the device and your hearing aids loose the signal, you then have to go back to within 12 feet of the device to regain the signal. As long as you stay close to the device, it works fine and sounds very good. Works either with fiber optic or 1/8" plug analog connection (comes with cables for both).
This is the worst thing that I have ever bought. The seller was not cooperative with my telling him that it quit working after a few weeks. A lesson learned the hard, expensive way.

Super easy to install. The TV sound is great!! I was taking out my hearing aids at night and wearing bluetooth headphones at night to watch TV. The Phonic TV connector definitely has a better sound, plus I don't have to wear those headphones at night. I felt this was pricey, but now that I am using these, I don't regret the purchase.

I have 2 sony home theaters, found that the tv connectors are very difficult to hook up. Phonak advised me on some hardware that I needed to buy. Still didn't work. Confusion about what component to connect. The tv itself or the receiver. Not to worry neither worked, gave up.

Confusion on product shown/delivered necessitated a call to Phonak support. Delivered item supposedly the upgraded version. Works but volume needs to be modified with Phonak phone app . Cost high due to chip shortage but I could have waited. Works well with app. Knowing all after the purchase I'm still keeping it.

topic: Anti Fog Cleaning Cloth for Glasses & Lens, 5 Pieces Cloth Reusable for 1500 Times, Great for Eyeglasses, Lenses, Goggles
texts: Been looking for a product like this for a while now. I play sports with a mask/gaiter, and had issues with fogging. Used a couple different sprays, but they didn’t last long. This product works as advertised, is easy to use and is super convenient!

Well, masks are a pain for those with glasses, this products HELPS keep the fog from forming. If you stick your head in front of an open oven door - it doesn't help. But minor breathing and minor temperature changes or humidity - it helps. I'd buy again. But they do last a long time if you keep them in the bag zippy. Batman lost his zip bag and it didn't last as long for him.

Five in a pack is super generous considering these cloths are thick, damp, and incredibly useful and reusable (just keep them in the foil packet to retain freshness!) They work in any condition and of course especially helpful when wearing a mask which fogs up glasses almost all the time. This is the answer! Thank you Telepure! You’ve come to the rescue!

I have tried other brands, but this beats them all. They all worked to some degree, but not even close to this. When I'm working out in the gym or out in the cold with a face mask. If there is ever an extreme situation, which does make the glasses fog, it only lasts for a few seconds. It has only occurred a couple of times. I make sure to clean my glasses with only this cleaning cloth daily, or every other day at least. I've let a couple of friends & sister try it, and they are now buying their own box.
It didn’t work rubbing the glasses as instructed, didn’t work if rubbed shorter or longer. Sent back 10 days ago & still no refund and yes it was a prime item!!!!

Prior to finding these cloths I had stopped wearing my glasses out due to them fogging so badly while wearing my masks. These cloths work very well. After wiping my glasses with the Telepure cloths my glasses stay fog free for several hours, even with me breathing heavy. I liked them enough where I gave some to my coworkers and they all loved them also.

This cloth is much like a camera lens cleaning cloth but has a chemical substance on the surface. Easy to”clean” eyeglasses with it then fold and restore in original packaging or a small resealable plastic bag. Really helps keep glasses fog free when wearing a masks

Definitely not fog free for 48 hours. I was excited to receive these & the material of the cloth was nice. It has an odd odor to it which I did not like. Unfortunately the product does not meet what is promised. It cleans my lenses very well & was able to have fog free glasses for a short period of time & after that my glasses were foggy a few hours later (maybe 1-2). I followed instructions just as advised also. Wish I could return and get my money back but I already threw one cloth away.

topic: DSHOW PRO Nano Gold Ceramic Curling Iron with Adjustable Heat Control Extra Long Barrel, 1.25 Inch
texts: Works well. No complaints regarding the product. It isn't very comfortable for me to use, because the barrel is bigger in diameter that I thought it was (my mistake). I will probably replace one day with a smaller curling iron.

Well I baught this because it was supposed to be good for long hair. Well it did a lot more burning than curling, either your hair or yourself trying to manuver it’s clunkiness. Going in the giveaway box.

I really like this curling iron. It heats up super fast. I find that my curls will last all day long, so no re-curling is necessary. I think the price is fine compare to similar product. I can never curl my hair perfectly, this was easy to use and gave me nice curls! I can even ask my husband to help me. My tips are: if I want waves, I only hold it for about 4-5 seconds and if I want more tight curls, I hold it for about 8-10 seconds.

I have to turn the heat all the way to the hottest setting for it to be hot enough which is something I didn't have to do with my previous iron. Also the cord is very bulky, like twice the size of a normal curling iron, and doesn't have a ring on it to hang it like my previous one did. The bulky cord makes it more difficult to use and gets in the way.

Bought this for my daughter for Christmas and she loves it. I've used it and also really like it so I'm going to get me one. It heats quickly and I don't seem to hit the off button like I do on my current curling iron.
I really really like this iron. First off it’s pretty! But also the heat on it is perfect. It has several options, I have long hair so I chose the 1.5 inch and high heat. Very impressed with it.

I like this curling iron so much. It not only can curl hair, but also can straighten hair, a dual-use product, and very convenient. The workmanship is very fine, as described in the introduction. The quality is also very perfect. The most important thing is that the price is suitable. The heat transfer is fast, convenient and not hot. The shaping effect is also very long, the hair curled out is also very natural, the overall performance and price ratio is very high. The extrinsic feature of this curling iron is also beautiful, not clumsy, and easy to carry. I'm going to take it with me for a trip.

This is a beautiful looking product for leave out in my bathroom, but I can't use it because you can totally fry yourself on it if you aren't really careful. I wish I would have heeded the warnings before purchasing it! Also, the cord is way too long. Does a good job if you don't mind getting really badly burnt in the process, but at least your hair will have great curls(:

topic: Posture Corrector for Women and Men – Back Brace with Premium Support for Better Work Posture and Lower Back Pain
texts: I am constantly on my laptop sitting at a desk & have been experiencing shoulder & neck pains. I was referred to this product by my friend and have been wearing it daily since I purchased it. It definitely see an improvement and I’m going to continue using it on a regular basis. So glad I tried it.

I've known I needed a back brace for quite some time now, my posture really isn't that​great! I'm glad I picked this one because the straps are super well padded, so I can wear it for long periods of time It's very comfortable and I love the fact that they went for good quality materials​. So glad I finally got around to ordering one.👍

I was desperate to help myself so I tried this. The design is bad. If they fixed that, possible a second strap around the top pf the ribs under your breasts, it'd probably be much better. As it is, you are changing one pain for another. Upper back pain or major arm and shoulder pain. You choose, I chose not to continue using it. Thanks
It's not a bad product, the only thing I don't like about this product is , it causes rash around your underarms if you don't use a long sleeve shirt.
Ultra comfortable indeed! Easy to use. Perfect for everyone who spends hours “hunched” in front of a computer. I could feel my posture improving immediately giving me added energy! A must have!

I really like this Posture Brace. I was in a bad horseback riding accident. I injured my shoulder. After 3 surgeries and long periods shoulder immobilization, my shoulder and scapula muscles were really weak and I still have shoulder pain issues. My shoulder needs help to hold it in a good position while I continue to rehab. I find this brace helpful, well made, easy to use, and reasonably priced.

Thank you. After LOTS of searching eventually a good posture corrector, it took 3 tries!!! Finally, non-bulky, comfortable to wear, posture corrector and feel the difference with less slouching already. Quality feels strong, love the velcro, soft and easy to adjust. A BIG THANK YOU for answering all my questions. I'm honestly happy! 👍

I don’t ever write reviews, but had a change of heart this time round. I received a personal hand written thank you card from the company, which I thought was so nice. They wanted to make sure I loved the product and if I had any questions, to not hesitate to ask. The product itself is amazing. It’s uncomfortable at first because you are training yourself to have better posture. I started out a few hours a day and slowly increased my time. The Velcro is really strong and does not slip at all which I thought it would from putting it on and off again. I would highly recommend.

topic: Apex Large Pocket Pill Squeeze (3 pack assorted colors)
texts: I ordered these for travel so I wouldn't have to carry around a large pill bottle. They stay closed even though I just threw it in the bottom of my purse.

I take a large quantity of nutritional supplements and need to keep them in my pocket at work to take throughout the day- these little things are so great- and they truly hold about 15 large vitamins...... keeps them clean and ready to take- I gave one of these to my son and he loves it as well. A great investment!!!

They come in a package of 3 and the first one I opened split apart right away. The other two are still holding together for now but they are pretty difficult to open, and I have non-arthritic, fully functional hands

Disappointed in the quality. I bought these to replace a squeeze I got at a drug store a few years ago. It is made from a much stiffer material so it is uncomfortable to squeeze open. It does not close completely either as my former one did.

Don't know about carrying pills, but I use these to pack some nicorette gum in my pocket. They only hold about 12 pieces. I wish they were just a bit bigger, and had stiffer rubber so that they don't squish so easily.

Love these. Slim profile means I can get them to fit in small places. I have had one in my purse for months now and have had no issues with it popping open or otherwise spilling my pills. You can easily fit 20+ Excedrin migraine pills in one of these. Very happy with my purchase!

The price is great, but these are flawed. Without modification (e.g. sharpie), it's almost impossible to quickly tell which way is up. Inevitably, you end squeezing it open when it is exactly upside down - pills everywhere. Otherwise, they are stiff and seal well.

These are great for carrying pills on the go. They are very convenient and lightweight. My boyfriend loves them. After some usage it doesn't close all the way. They're still good though. I would buy these again if I need it.

topic: Starlite Smile Gum Disease Light, 32 LED Red & Blue Light Gum Light That Also Helps with Teeth Whitening at
texts: What I like: it's small, fits ok into the mouth (not real comfy for moi but that's ok), whitens my teeth, and helps my overall dental health. what I don't like: it goes on too easily and the lights are bad for your eyes. Not designed well. Charging it is a hassle because the connection isn't great and then the awful lights flash on continuously while charging. Aside from that, I relax in bed until its beeper wakes me up. Rinse it, put it away and rest knowing I did the extra thing to keep my teeth healthy. This is on top of the brushing, natural toothpaste, a great floss, etc.

After using this for two nights straight I noticed I don't wake up with morning breath anymore! After about a week I noticed my gums did not look red/irritated anymore. I really love love love the results! Here is what I would like to see on this product's redesign: 1) An easier way to clean mouthpiece (maybe make the whole unit waterproof and/or redesign power "button" which is very sensitive to touch). 2) Include a more energy dense battery. My unit lasts about 3 - 4 uses per charge and would like to see 6 - 8. This thing has a lot of potential! Looking forward to the redesign/improvement. ❤️🦷

I am still skeptical but it appeared to work. I had a infection in my mouth, it did not heal for a long time. I did some other things with this at the same time but it appear to work. That is all I can tell you.

Can't conclude if it has had benefit yet, but after three weeks of use, I'd say it's easy to use, easy to charge, and seems reliable so far. Technically, it should have an effect, and complement regular oral hygiene.
This thing turning itself on all the time even I do not touch the start button or the white part. This thing is fixing teeth and damaging eyes. Horrible technology.

I have been using for 1 week and already see a major difference in my gums. I have periodontal problems and have for a few years, have had several deep root scale cleanings, but truly this photodynamic tool works better than even those do. I suggest doing one blue light treatment and then one red/blue every day. HIGHLY RECOMMEND! photodynamic therapy works!
I had such bad gum disease I ended up with raw ulcerated gums, they hurt so bad. I used this every day twice for a week and my gums are SOOOO MUCH BETTER!
Worked great but only got to use it 2 or 3 times before it stopped charging. Didn’t work long enough for me to really notice a difference. Very disappointed, I really wanted to love this!

topic: Nerdwax Stop Slipping Glasses as Seen on Shark Tank
texts: This stuff really works great. I've worn glasses for years and have never come across a product like this. Keeps glasses (especially ones without nose pads in place, even when perspiring. The only suggestion I would make is that rather than come in a "chap stick" type container, I think a flatter, round one would be better so that you could rub some on your finger and then apply to your glasses. The current tube shape is hard to apply in the right place. So, for me, I prefer using my finger.
This product did help keep my sunglasses on, but it also caused an itchy, red, swollen rash on the bridge of my nose where the pads rest. I hope there's a hypo-allergenic version in the future.
I had really high hopes for this after reading many reviews! Unfortunately, it did not work as promised. I have extremely oily skin... so I don’t believe it is the product for me.

After using this Nerdwax for a few weeks and then misplacing it :( I have to say I was impressed with how well it worked and how much I loved using it. I just found it this week and look forward to continue using it! This is a very useful product and it works great! Just remember to wipe your nose off if you sweat or have greasy skin.
This is very effective at preventing my glasses from slipping. I do have to reapply it daily, but that is ok with me. I also plan to try it to prevent sandal and shoulder straps from slipping.

Living on the humid Gulf Coast I assumed there was no solution for slipping glasses. Over a year ago I saw the product on Shark Tank and I remember thinking it was a clever idea but thought it was more of a gimmick than a real product. After going back to wearing glasses daily I remembered Nerdwax. I have come to grips with paying $10.99 for 0.5 ounces of wax (that's over $350/lb). The product works well and I am at peace with the purchase.

My glasses have been slipping more frequently this year and was in need of a product like this. I have only had it for 3 weeks but so far it works great. You do have to clean your glasses 1st and the bridge of your nose to be more effective. If you put stuff(Vaseline) on your nose you might have to reapply more. I am HIGHLY allergic to bees and was concerned about having a reaction to this product but I have not had a reaction at all. I would recommend this to anyone who wears glasses! :)

I use this in concert with ear hook sleeves and it works well. This is very sticky and one application has lasted for a few days, for me. My only real complaint is that it irritated my skin a little at first. I'm unsure if it was just the added friction or that my application was a little uneven and left some rough spots on my nose pieces; whatever the issue may have been after a while I found I no longer noticed the irritation. I have yet to use this product in a particularly warm environment and will be interested in seeing what the added sweat and oil will do to the product.

topic: Apalus Hair Straightening Brush, Ceramic Hair Straightener, Straight Hair Styling
texts: I love this brush. It's so much easier than the straightening iron and a lot faster. I have gotten a lot of compliments and my friends all want one. I lead them to this brand. It comes with a glove, which I rarely use. While the temperature on the brush goes as high as 450 degrees, the tips of the bristles don't get hot. I have not burned myself at all. It heats up quickly and in done in 5 minutes.

I did like the product. Being that I have gone natural, it is hard to find products to straighten my hair. It met my expectations, I did not get a completely bone straight hair. But it did relax my natural curls well enough for me to brush my hair into a really flat ponytail or a smooth updo. I would suggest flat ironing after if you wanted that really sleek straight hair.

This will not straighten your hair as well as flat iron does. I love it it is perfect fro me. It smooths and straightens without making my hair super straight. It is also easier to use and not quite as damaging to your hair

African American hair don't know my curl pattern. My hair is thin in comparison to other black women hair. Straightens nicely. The heat is not so direct which makes it great for healthy hair. Not good for styling I had to use my flat iron (direct heat) but I didn't have to use my flat iron as much which helps to decrease the amount of heat on my hair. The Apalus brush is difficult to clean.

I was so excited when I got this in the mail after reading the good reviews. Of course, like every other miracle cure I've ever tried, it didn't work on my hair. I have pretty thick hair, so whenever I brush it out, it gets very puffy. I was hoping once I brushed it with the apalus, it would take away at least some of the puffiness and frizz. It didn't. It did straighten my hair somewhat, but it just looked like a big somewhat straight frizzy puffy mess. Maybe it would work better on someone whose hair was thinner, but not for thick hair
Apalus is the best customer service. My brush stopped working after 6 weeks but customer service responded within a day and a new one is already on its way. It worked great until it didn't.

The brush works as it says it does. Honestly I don't like the end result it produces as much as my good flat iron BUT right now I have shorter hair (above shoulder length). I'm thinking it will work great on my daughter's longer hair and when I grow my hair out.

My first one never turned on. This second one turned on once and now it doesn't turn on. I am extremely disappointed. I was really hoping to have found something for my daughter's hair. **Update** Third one seems to be working better. Let's see if it lasts more than one use!

topic: Aunt Fannie’s Ant Spray for Indoor Use (6-Pack)
texts: Wasn’t a fan overall, kills them but that’s all isn’t really a deterrent at all and unless you spray them directly and as close as possible if you have a real ant problem don’t waste your money on this, try tea tree oil instead

I was very surprised when this product killed the line of ants in my house directly, all within five seconds. The spray has a pleasing citrus smell, and washes off easily. While this product works effectively at killing the ants, it has not yet helped me wipe them out. The ants I have simply go around the area I sprayed, sometimes climbing the wall four feet to get around the area. I am hoping with repeated applications (or winter) that they go away for good. In the meantime, I will keep using this product to keep the population in my house as low as I can.
smells great. kills on contact. seems to kill ants lasting over about 2 weeks. before they appear again. I really like this stuff. I dont feel like I'm killing me and my kids too.. just ants. :)

I live in the South where there is always something flying or crawling by! Tried this for black ants and fruitflies in the window where my cat loves to watch the birds thru the screen. Have to apply fairly often but it works great and is safe for the kitty. Just discovered that it works nicely on drainflies and the occasional spider as well. Love that is does NOT have a chemical smell.

It didn’t kill the ants, they just ran around wet. There’s enough oil in it that it made my floor slippery to the point where I slipped and fell after having wiped up the excess liquid that I sprayed. On the bright side, it smells good and I felt safe trying out this product without worrying about my cat
This works well in the short term, but won't prevent the ants from coming back in a day or two. Also watch out because it makes hardwood floors very slippery!
Used it once so far on big ant infestation. At first it drew even more ants and I was pissed off. but then all the ants were gone and have not come back. so far so good!
I keep a bottle on my table, and although I haven't seen any ants in a while, I'm ready. I used a combination of this product and diatomaceous earth to solve my ant problem. Seems to be working.

topic: ASNME Facial Cleansing Brush with Stand-Silicone Face Scrubber for Women Rechargeable-Waterproof Sonic Face Cleansing Brush with Case for Cleansing and
texts: I have only had this for a short time, but so far I am impressed with how clean and fresh my face looks and feels. Buying another one for my sister in law to use the heating and cooling features. She has migraines and I believe this could help her relieve some of the discomfort she experiences.

I have tried TWO. The first one had to be returned because water got inside and it kept turning off and on by itself. Now the second one won’t even turn on and I’ve only have only had it two weeks! Don’t waste your money. They won’t make it right still and it won’t turn on still…
Love this so far!!! I have only used a few times so I can’t see a huge difference yet. But the way it suds up your cleanser you use is amazing! Something your hands cannot do.

This is actually pretty great! The bristles are soft and feel really nice. It has a lot of vibration settings. The top button heats up the back metal part and the bottom button makes it nice and cool. I suffer from cystic acne and let me tell you.... that cold felt really nice on my face.

Wife loves it. Says face feels super clean and vibrant after using. Soft bristles that don’t hurt but do an amazing job cleansing. Multiple settings and vibrations so easy find one that matches your need or preference. Easy to clean and Charge. Great deal.
Battery was supposed to hold charge For 30 days and didn’t… before a month in it completely stopped working. While it worked i loved it but once it died… trash

[[VIDEOID:bf9cf78d61798310895aff892651bdb1]] Really soft , value for money and it's easy to use. Just move it around in a circular motion. For me it's not to use everyday tho , once or twice a week is good enough for me. I don't need to exfoliate my face everyday. Ensure u fully charge it before using it.

I really like the face cleanser. It’s the first one I’ve tried so I don’t know how effective it is a deep cleaning. But my face feels great afterwards. I love the hot/cold feature. My only complaint is there are no instructions and the charging port was difficult to find.

topic: Whey Protein Powder Sample Pack: PROMIX Standard 100 Percent All Natural Grass Fed ­ Best for Optimum Fitness Nutrition, Energy
texts: This is the best tasting protein powder on the market. It tastes great. Great. Not good or very good; it is excellent. Not chalky. The peanut butter tastes like peanut butter, vanilla tastes like vanilla, etc. Smooth. I like the diversity in flavors because I get bored with the same ole flavor (I make a lot o smoothies.). I feel full and a smoothie with this ProMix powder will hold me down until lunch if I have it for breakfast. I will be a regular ProMix customer. I workout regularly, as in HIIT workouts, Zumba, etc. If you are unsure about this purchase buy one folder then the sampler like I did. You'll be glad you did.

Currently using this to do a clean transformation. I tried the sample pack; the vanilla is great for adding fruit. The chocolate peanut butter and peanut butter flavors are must haves. I love the clean ingredients just wish if possible the company would make a clean strawberry flavor. I truly appreciate the fact it is stevia free I really detest stevia in protein powder.
I am very picky when it comes to protein powder. And to this day I have yet to find another protein powder that tastes as good as shakeology. This protein powder is tolerable but just not my taste
I'm sure this stuff is good, and good for me, but it tastes like crap. Super weak, very watery, and I only mixed it with 8oz of water. I'll stick with Optimum Nutrition from now on.
All the flavors where good, but the peanut butter flavor was killer. Better than others I've tried, but PROMIX is more expensive than average. So that's a bit of a downer.

I have been on the hunt for a good tasting protein shake mix. I am loving Promix! For one, I love that they let you get a sample pack before you spend money on buying a huge tub of it, I didn't find many other brands that did that. I ended up liking every single one actually but eventually decided on the peanut butter chocolate flavor to order my big tub. I am a month into my big tub and loving it still! I add 1 tbsp stevia to mine to slightly sweeten it up more and a little cocoa powder if I want it extra chocolately.

Great sample pack to try PROMIX protein. The protein is a bit expensive so being able to try before you buy was great. I ended up buying a 5lb of the Raw Chocolate protein, but also really enjoyed the Vanilla flavor. Because I loved the protein so much, I also purchased the BCAAs and PROMIX Performance sports drink mix. I'm a fan of this company!

Nice clean protein with light flavor. The only negative is that it's so expensive but If you're looking for for pure quality protein this is a great one. This is probably best suited for someone who doesn't use a whole lot of sweeteners or eat a lot of sweets.

topic: Skout’s Honor: Professional Strength Laundry Booster - Stain and Odor Removal Additive - 3x Concentrated Solution For Laundry Use -
texts: I really like this product, I have tried so many different products and this one seems to really work and take the dog smell and the sour smell out of clothing and linens. I also really like that it is safe with no chemicals and is made in the USA!
I wash all my blankets and dog bedding with this odor eliminator and regular detergent. It seems to work great and even gets out the super stinky dog smell from soiled materials.

I was having a difficult time removing the urine odor from my Guinea Pig's fleece cage liners. They are 2 years old so they are well used. I tried this product and FINALLY the smell is gone. I put it directly on the fleece liners and let is soak for 5 mins. Then started the washer. The smell was gone! I have tried everything and this is the only thing to work so far. Now I just add a bit in with the regular washing detergent and it works perfectly. Highly recommend!
I've bought several bottles of this stuff and it is really great. It only takes a fourth of a cup and it gets rid of all the odor in the blankets that my dogs sleep on

My bf's clothes have been stinky from diesel fuel, dirt, sweat, anything a hard working mechanic gets into. I've tried several different products and nothing worked. The stinky odors made his armoire smell. Well this work!! I ❤ luv that it's cruelty free and they donate to pets. Will be purchasing this from now on.
It smells very good and quickly takes away the doggy odor but is not overwhelming. It doesn’t stain anything and doesn’t take much. I like their laundry booster and their odor removing spray.

I love this product. I have a doxie and he has times when he does not smell very good. It's not his fault, but not mine, either! When I have to wash blankets (he fancies himself a lap dog) I use this. Sometimes I may have to wash things 2x, but the resulting lack of nasty dog stink is far preferable to whatever objection some may have for the smell of the product. I thought I would have to throw out some blankets because my laundry soap did not touch the dogstink. Scouts Honor saved my blankets and does a great job on the dog'd bedding, as well. I recomend Scouts Honor to all my friends with dogs!

Well my guinea pig cage liner still reeks after washing with the recommended amount. I normally use bleach which works better getting the stink out but wanted to try something made for pet odors. I'm really disappointed

topic: Mini Thin | Two-Way Action Caffeine Pills - High Speed Energy and Enhanced Stamina* - 205mg Caffeine; 25mg Ephedrizine (Yohimbe,
texts: I started taking them in late 90s !Then couldn’t find them for years !I was excited to find them on Amazon recently!! They are an asset to anyone looking to lose weight!!

Times I drive many long hours or work many long hours, sometimes just 1/2 a tab works. I feel no jitters...no side effect...no crashes. I just simply feel more alert to manage my days. I only take when i really need the extra energy. My son works the oil rigs and he and his coworkers swear by them! As with anything use responsibly.

A friend on the job recommended trying these. Another friend stated the ones she gets Amazon was sold out because they were discontinued. They are small in size so I split them. Just enough to get me thru the day along with an early coffee. So the bottle for me last longer and the value is great!

I was excited to try these after all the glowing reviews. Not sure if I got a dud or what but these did nothing. Literally just sugar pills. Be cautious if you decide to buy them. Waste of money on my end.

I took them in my glove box and pop one if I feel a little sluggish. I haven't noticed any taste to them. I just swallow it with a swig of water. No gitters and it helps me on those days I didn't get a lot of sleep the night before. I'll keep a bottle in stock for the future.

I bought this in an effort to control my appetite. It made me jittery and nauseous. I took it once but never again! I used to take this back in the 90's and it kept my weight under control but now I guess my body has built resistance to it. I discovered going to the diet Dr and being prescribed phentermine is way better and safer.

I’ve been taking these since I couldn’t take my adderall during my treatment and wow I can’t believe I’m saying this but honestly I prefer these over my adderall. I’ve noticed a huge boost of energy and stamina from taking these daily and I’m still able to sleep at night. Idk if this makes sense to anyone but me, but this kind of upper feels cleaner to me when I take it vs my meds. These are great. Definitely stocking up just in case

Ive tried many nootropics/caffeine pills (as an over-the-counter alternative for treating my ADD), and these are definitely the best ones I’ve found. They give me a noticeable boost, but don't make me feel jittery/dizzy like most caffeine pills do. I also don't feel any comedown (like I usually do with my adderal). Very glad I gave them a shot!

topic: Purbolics Aminos | Supports Muscle Recovery & Growth | 4g of Free-Form Amino Acids, Beta-Alanine, 0 Calories & 60 Servings
texts: My review is for the new Sour Rainbow Candy flavor. I am definitely liking the flavor. Almost like sour skittles. What I like most is one scoop in my 24 oz shaker is plenty of flavor. So I get more water in by doing two scoops a day. Definite thumbs up for this flavor. Would recommend.

Do not buy this if you are looking for something that you can drink while intermittent fasting. This has sucralose will which will illicit an insulin-response - which will break a fast!! I gained 5 lbs using this for a week before I figured it out!!! It tastes good and otherwise is nice, but you cannot drink it during a fast.

Great taste and mixes well with water. I use a couple scoops in my gallon of alkaline water that I sip on starting early in the morning while at the gym and throughout the day. Keeps me going while on my feet for 8 hours at work and adds a yummy taste to boring plain water.

I have used purbolics for a while and am not sure how much it actually helps recovery as I don’t really notice a difference. Love the sour rainbow candy taste...it’s more like the orange sour skittles. I do think that I prefer the regular rainbow candy over the sour rainbow candy. Purbolics flavor is much better than other workout water enhancers I’ve tried.

I absolutely love this pre-workout! I have it before I work out every singe time and it helps me perform so much better. It gives me so much energy and that extra push. A staple for me, and it tastes amazing! Surprised that it has 0 grams of sugar.

I love this product and have bought it several times. They know what they are doing at purbolics. I drink a lot of water through the day, this makes is so much easier to chug. I love the flavor, my favorite so far.

I was very excited to try my product after hearing good things about it online. However when I opened my package I found that my bag of BCAA was open. The package was not sealed so the bag opened on transit. I attached pictures showing the bag is intact, and not ripped, but still open.
It’s too early to say weather or not it works. I will say it blends well and the taste is fantastic. I thought the small bag was a bit expensive however you get 60 servings .i did purchase more

topic: Noise Cancelling Ear Plugs by EarJoy - for Swimming Sleeping Musicians. Reusable. for Shooting Swim Concerts Sleep. Earplugs Sound Blocking.
texts: Just sticks out. Difficult to turn around when sleeping. If you sleep lying in one position (face up or down), u can get it but otherwise, don't bother. It's very uncomfortable

Good Earplugs, especially for the price. They give you multiple kinds to ensure that the one you need fits you. There were a few that didn't work great with me, but I have more than enough to see what kind does and what kind I would like in the future.

My wife is a very light sleeper. Our dog wines very early in the morning around 4:30am and has difficulty going back to sleep after that. She was surprised at the comfort of these ear plugs, specifically the blue ones, and can sleep right through the early morning noises. Would buy again!

Was looking for a nice pair of ear plugs since I was tired of the foam ones you roll up falling out all the time. I bought these primarily to use when riding my motorcycle and they work great. I used the blue ones while sleeping and the gray and orange ones while riding my bike at the track. They stay in your ears really well and it’s really nice having different levels of protection. I like the gray the most for use while riding the track, good protection but not too much where I couldn’t hear bikes around me.

I've only had the chance to use 2 of these sets the sleep o es and the regular job/range ones. The red/orange ones work nice for target shooting and are fairly comfortable. Small but for me they are a good fit. My husband didnt like them because they were too small for his ears and did t have a string attached. For work he has to have a cord attached . The night time o es fit me the best and though I do t need them for sleeping worked good for sound reduction like weed eating. Over all I think they are good quality but a size option might be good.

Maybe its because I have big fingers but seriously I didnt push them in any further than necessary and I couldnt get them back out, not easy to grip in the slightest. Don't buy these without a pair of pliers nearby! jfc

Honestly, I could see this whole set going for $20. The silicone earplugs are extremely comfortable and don't have any weird smells like other silicone items. The blue earplugs are very soft and comfortable but still seem to dig in quite deep. The orange ones are not very comfortable for me, they seem to case a sharp feeling in my ear, however, they are the best for sound blocking. Lastly, the grey earplugs are the most comfortable for me! They don't go in as deep as the others but they're extremely easy to sleep with.

Great ear plugs. They come in hard plastic traveling cases that fit my range bag easily and far surpassed other brands that I have used while at an indoor shooting range. The white ones are preferred because I feel that they expand in the ear better, but I’ll use the other ones for other tasks such as cutting the grass. Great product at an inexpensive price.

I bought this clock to help ease the transition during the darker winter mornings. Overall, I am glad I did. It is much more soothing to wake up to the gradually increasing light than to the jolt of an alarm, even one set to the radio. Most morninsg I wake up just before the sounds come on and feel like I just woke up on my own. On those particularly tough mornings, the sound of gentle waves awakens me. This is a much nicer way to start your day!

I have not yet been able to figure out how to have the light come on at the time that I want it to. I have been through the poor instruction book that came with it, but can't figure out how to program the @&## thing to work. The display light is a bit too bright for when the lights are off, and the nature sounds are annoying. I think you need to keep looking if you are looking for a lamp that slowly lights up in the a.m.

Please help... can someone give me some feedback! there is no sound coming on ... I have the volume all the way up and I can barely hear the beeping, there is no radio sound at all and the light is not coming on... The light works, but not with the alarm. I followed the directions and tried 4 times... is the radio supposed to come on when you are setting it, because it did not... I tried to turn on the radio, but I couldn't hear anything at all... there is no info on the manufacturer, either... no other instructions to, videos??? about ready to return it!

I got this clock for my son who had trouble getting up at 5:30AM in the darkness. He liked it but in his sleep would set the 10 minute snooze and would wake up puzzled that he over slept. It is a great idea and did gently wake him but I think the 10 minute snooze should be harder to set. You currently just wave your hand by the sensor.

I bought this as I am light sensitive. Morning light blasts were particularly annoying. This slow lightening radio is exactly what I wanted. I am glad the bulb is easily accessible too. Some of the many functions I may not use but I recommend Good Morning Sunrise Wake-up clock~

After having used this for two months, I would not go back to a standard alarm clock again. The light helps me to gradually awaken in the morning, and helps me not feel so groggy when I do finally get out of bed. As has been mentioned in previous reviews, it is a little complicated to set it (which is why I am not giving 5 stars), but once you figure it out, it really is not that difficult. I love it.

This alarm clock works not only as an alarm that gradually lights up, but has a wonderful motion activated sensor for it's snooze function. The alarm clock also operates as a radio and lamp, serving multiple function within one device. I am very happy with the overall product. One change I would make is to soften the transitions between each of the light level changes. I would definitely recommend this product!

I have found this alarm clock to be a much gentler way to wake up than with a typical buzzer or radio station. It is a pleasant change to wake and not be startled. Some of the other light alarm clocks only offer buzzers for the alarm. I think a buzzer would ruin the calm of a gentle light awakening, so I prefer to use one of the nature sounds instead. The lamp can be used as a dimmable lamp, so it is nice to also have a dimmable bedside lamp now. There are quite a few configuration options, so you will probably need to keep the instruction sheet nearby for a couple days.

topic: Verilux Original Natural Spectrum Deluxe Floor Lamp, Ivory
texts: A really beautiful practical lamp that is just right for reading next to one of our recliner chairs. Would recommend this lamp for anyone who likes to relax and read.

I just love this light, I'm an aesthetics professional which mean i do facials and all over body waxing and some other things. Need good light that bends and this light is everthing i ecpected and more! love the natural light you can see the hair so much better

The lamp gives off a good, clear light that is perfect for reading or sewing. It was a little difficult to assemble; you will need two people to attach the stem to the base because it is heavy and unwieldy.

Seems to be good quality and this is the second light I purchased like this. Wonderful light for an older person that is having reading problems and needs more quality light. I would buy it again!! if that helps....
Love it. We have two in the house. We bought the first ones over 15 years ago. I went out, and that is when we replaced it with this one. Highly recommend if you do a lot of reading or accounting.

I work alot with my hands and with small items. I always ended up with headaches when I did alot. Now with this lamp, it is so much easier to see. My eyes do not hurt after hours and no more headaches. UPDATE: after 3 months of use, the bulb in the lamp started blinking rapidly. I rechecked the connections, tried different outlets and nothing worked. Got a $30 replacement bulb from the company and the bulb still flashes rapidly. Lamp is a completed waste. Will have to return to company for a new lamp which is a pain it the butt!

THE LAMP EMITS A VERY GOOD LIGHT AS LONG AS IT WORKS. MY LAMP LASTED BARELY OVER 30 DAYS. AFTER THE HASSLE OF REPACKAGING AND SPENDING ANOTHER $35 FOR SHIPPING I RETURNED THE LAMP AND IT WAS REPLACED. THE REPLACEMENT LAMP LASTED ABOUT 3 MONTHS AND IT SUDDENLY QUIT. I CANNOT RECOMMEND THIS PRODUCT. I HAVE DISCARDED THE LAMP AS I DO NOT WISH TO ENCOUNTER ANY FURTHER HASSLES. I HAVE LIMITED VISION AND AM QUITE DISAPPOINTED THAT THE PRODUCT IS INFERIOR. JACK BRADSHAW NASHVILLE,TN
The new one works fine, no real issues with putting it together, I expect another 15 plus years out of this one. Arrived on time as promised, packing kept unit well protected.

topic: DocaPole 6-inch Soft Bristle Scrub Brush with 6-24 Foot Extension Pole
texts: Bought this to wash algae growth from the exterior of my house. The brush would not tighten. It would almost tighten, then the treads would give and it would spin around; duct tape allowed me to continue the project. After 2 hours the pole had bent. I had extended it to about 30 foot to reach the peak, but the weight of the extension seems to have been to much for the pole. Waste of money.
I used the 24 foot DocaPole to scrub my house and it worked really well. It's easy to use, sturdy, its not extremely lightweight but if it was it wouldn't be as sturdy.

Nice quality - At first the brush seemed a little small but it’s perfect for being on the end of a long pole. Anything bigger would not work. Overall very nicely designed an allowed me to clean the side of my house from the ground without a ladder. Nice and useful tool!

This was exactly what I was looking for. Worked well for washing the north side of the house that had a little mildew built up. Light weight enough to easily manipulate when extended out to ~16' Mine came with an additional duster that I wasn't expecting.
I bought this to clean the vinyl siding of my home. Extends easily, lightweight but strong. The bristles are bit softer than I expected but it still cleaned the siding & gutters well.
The only thing that could be better is the wash brush. We purchased it to wash our 38 ft motor home and the brush as you know is not very wide.

This is the BEST extension pole to clean aluminum siding and reach the second story. I love the multiple extension options to allow cleaning at ground level versus using a ladder. Good quality and like the option to buy additional cleaning tools. I cleaned the entire two-story side of the house in less than an hour.

Your brush was installed wrong making it mostly unusable, unless you just use it as a straight pole , it is unusable as I received it. No return label or instructions of any kind. Pole looks good.... brush is totally useless!!

topic: 20 Pack High Resistance Chair Bands, Classroom Bundle, Foot Fidgets for Kids, Fits School and Classroom Chairs, ADHD and Sensory
texts: After reading some reviews, I was a little worried about the quality and longevity of these bands. I’m glad I bought them because they are good quality and durable. I teach upperclassmen in high school, and they love them. They have been in place for 3-4 months now and although they are a bit dirty from shoes, they work just fine. For reference, they are on the front two legs of the standard blue classroom chair. I will buy this product again when these wear out eventually.

My 5th grade students love these. No noticeable smell out of the package, and easy to place on regular blue school chairs. Some of my more active students have practically been jumping on these bands for 2 weeks, and none have broken so far. I ordered an extra package as there are only 20 per pack and I needed 23, but this way I'll have extras on hand just in case, or I can use them next year.
I purchased these at the request of my granddaughter. As a teacher of young students, these foot fidgets are a great help in the classroom. They are reasonably priced and were shipped promptly.
Great product! The bands take place of tapping pencils and various fidgets ( which tend to be even more distracting) during small group instruction. They are quiet & have worked wonders so far. 🤩
My students absolutely love them, but its January now and about half of the bands have broken. The band can also be noisy so be prepared! I really wish they lasted longer.

I hate these bands. Bought them for my 5th graders. The noise made when student feet make contact is incredibly loud and disruptive. Squelching squeaks abound. And the blue color quickly turns to dirt. They should only come in a dark color. My students love them though.

I didn’t think they would fit high school desks, but they do. Nothing but positive feedback from kids. Update: I took off a star because of the light color. They still work great, but they're pretty scuffed and gross looking after a month.

I teach 5th grade and these are the best I have ever gotten. They do show dirt easy, but they can be washed off like other plastics. They are tight and durable and don’t fall down when student fidget. Worth the money. My active kiddos love them.

Product took 90 year old concrete off a waste pipe under my basement slab. Now I can tee off the waste pipe and install a bathroom in basement. After applying product to concrete covered cast iron waste pipe I waited 20 minutes then uses the nail-remover side of a hammer to scrap off concrete. This required a lot of scrapping and three applications. However it worked great. Thank You. Save me a ton of money, plumber wanted to replace the whole pipe under slab. Picture 1 shows pipe, picture 2 shows pipe with this product spayed on and picture 3 shows finished product. I am so happy.

My order came with a 1/4 leaked out broken windex style spray bottle. It would be nice to have a powered sprayer something similar to the Raid Max defense purple/blue looking bottle you can buy. That thing sprays stremes up to 12 feet away. I think that would be ideal for this especially since it foams on contact. Theres little use for an atomized windex style spray handle that will ensure you breathe and taste some of the chemical as you are on top a mixer with a cross wind in my opinion.

I used this to remove concrete splatter from the side of my house, 6 days after it happened. The key is, it needs to be DRY - don’t wet the concrete with water first. A small shot on it, wait 5-10 minutes, and the concrete was liquified, wiped clean with one swipe of a dry rag. Amazing stuff!

does not work as advertised. it will help in softening the top of the ceramic tile mortar/grout, but will not fully dissolve mortar even after repeated sprayings. I ended up using a 4.5 inch double row grinding disc on my grinder to remove the mortar for the 12 tiles that i was replacing. used the remaining spray to keep dust down when using the grinder to remove the mortar.

Product does work! However it takes 5 or 6 applications if the thing your trying to remove the concrete from is not laying flat as the spray just runs down. We removed splatter from vinyl siding, vinyl railing, metal garage door panel and the bottom of metal gutter drain

Absolutely did nothing, bought this to remove grout, used half the bottle and did NOTHING!!! Went to Walmart and bought a $12 can of stripper and worked within minutes (also works with floor leveling and concrete) so save yourself $40 and aggravation! And the real kicker is you can't return it because Amazon can't receive items with flammable liquid, but they can ship it out?

Never heard of having tile and grout dust causing your shower drain to clog with a cement like substance. Read some reviews and watched a few videos and decided to go with this product. Poured half of a 22oz bottle, and waited about 6 hrs then poured the rest of the bottle in. Got up the next morning and turned the shower on it started draining. Needless to say we were very excited. Recommend this product.

I used it to remove cement from the front of my fifth-wheel trailer. I had not realized that the splatters on my trailer were from wet cement. I had tried scraping, vinegar, WD-40, alcohol, Simple-Green, etc. and nothing would take it off. Then, 6-months later it dawned on me that the splatters might be cement. So, I tried Speedy Clean Concrete Dissolver. It took several applications, but the cement softened so that the majority could be wiped of and the rest could be scraped off with a plastic scraper. It did not damage the surface of the RV nor the vinyl trim that runs around the perimeter of the front. I highly recommend it for cement removal.

topic: VELPEAU Carpal Tunnel Wrist Brace -Night Sleep Wrist Support for Men, Women, Tendonitis, Arthritis, Broken, Sports Injuries Pain Relief -Removable
texts: I bought this after reading the reviews here and I am glad I did.All though it is a bit snug as I have very large hands and wrists it is cooler and more comfortable than the others.

This has great support, but make sure you measure your arm before picking a size. I belive I could have gone down a size. I also did not care for the strap around the palm of my hand. It did not stay snug. I am constantly tightening it. But overall it really does give great support and is a great value.

I ordered this brace not know what to expect. I wanted something that would allow my wrist to rest because it had been rather sore. It helped after just a few days use. I will be using it in the future as needed.

This was for my daughter that has carpal tunnel problems and needs to lift somewhat heavy items at work. It had been quite painful for her but the brace has helped a great deal and she thinks she can put off surgery for quite some time.

Fits pretty comfortably, I do wish the extended section in the palm of the hand aligned more towards the thumb side of the hand instead of the pinky. It's not uncomfortable, so much as annoying. I've had carpal tunnel in my wrist for years and as a chef my hands are my livelihood. After four or five days of wearing this to sleep I noticed a significant difference and now I only wear it a few nights a week as a preventative measure and it's worked. Highly recommended.
The metal support strip makes it very uncomfortable to sleep with. I tried adjusting the Velcro strips, but the design is flawed & it’s too stiff for a nighttime brace.

This is a very nice brace. Well made, padded and very comfortable. My only complaint is that the last strap should be a little longer. I ordered a size large because I have a large arm but I can barely get the strap fastened.

Thought about buying this here, but having second thoughts after watching the price go up rapidly before going down the same day just so you can say it's a bigger discount. It's an old trick and it probably loses more money from sceptical folks than you make off of the gullible in the long run.

topic: MyKuali Penang Hokkien Prawn Noodle (4 Packs)
texts: Stay away from this unless you like the taste of old seafood. I'd throw away my prawns if they tasted this bad. Thankfully the packet of fried onions drowned out that flavor.

I usually use half the flavor packet and that's plenty of heat for me. The shrimp flavor is still strong and the noodles have a good chew. Takes well to extra ingredients like scallion, shrimp, carrot, etc.

This is the most authentic instant noodle I have ever tasted. It tastes like REAL Food and much better than the Korean ramen cause those are so MSG loaded and taste like it. The sambal is 'strong" because this is south east asian cooking, just like Thai cooking. Also, the smell is strong because it is a very concentrated shrimp soup. I know this because I have tasted the real ones in Penang.
Like many others, I ordered based on Dancing Bacon's review. Great Shrimp paste flavor, not overly spicy (just enough heat) and nice addition with the fried onions. Good value for the money.
One of the best things ever! Prawny, rich, spicy goodness. Great with an egg dropped in. I love every product this company produces, and this rates among their very best.
Best ramen I have ever had. The appropriate level of spices lead to this wondrous creation, while it does have a fishy smell the taste is fantastic. I will eat this ramen over and over again.

After I asked, the wife said the Wen met her expectations as it has in her past use of the product. In my narrow perspective, I think it just costs too much for "soap".

Love this! My daughter has a lot of thick, beautiful hair but it has tended to be dry, especially at the ends. Since the first time using this, it has been easy to manage. Even the gals at the beauty salon were wondering what 'trick' mom came up with.
I always love the seasonal scents by chaz Dean, but this one is a particular favorite of mine. Wonderfully fragrant without being overowering, rich, thick and makes your hair feel soft and silky.

I love this shampoo. So far I love all of the Wen shampoos. My hair feels bouncier and healthier very much healthier. I would write a whole lot more reviews if we didn't have to use 400 characters on every review.

I had heard a lot about Wen but hadn't tried it. While it does add some volume and body to my hair, my favorite thing about it is that I can go two and sometimes three days without washing my hair. Previously, I had to wash it daily so it would not become oily. The fragrance is pleasing as well.

topic: ARS Aqua Relief System Hot or Cold Water Therapy Device
texts: Used machine for first time this week following surgery and work well but there was no instructions with machine or strap to carry it in box so makes moving it around difficult. I have tried to find a place to purchase a strap for it since I didn't open until after my return date but have not been able to locate one.
As good as you will find in any healthcare setting. Put the water in the central unit, decide if you want heat or cool therapy, and hold on for the best therapy you could ask for in the home setting.

The ARS relief system is easy to use and worth the money at this point. I need a knee replacement soon and recently had surgery to clean up torn meniscus in opposite knee so icing is imperative. The system has provided relief and easy to use without any problems. It is simple and nothing fancy about it and have not used the heating feature yet. I hope to use this of equipment for a long time, so I’m hopeful the machine can provide long term relief.

I ordered this product ahead of a scheduled knee replacement so I would have it when I went to the hospital. I started using it after my surgery on October 24th and by the time I got out on November 8th, it was leaking so bad where the hoses connect to the cooling pad I could no longer use it. I tried contacting the seller about it but I got no reply because of a 30 day no return policy I guess. It was great when it worked and I don't regret buying it but it seems like they would at least stand behind their product. Great product but bad customer service!

Works well but the clip in front to hold the lid shut was made out of chinsey plastic and broke. Now I have to wrap a strap around the thing to keep it shut until I find a way to fix it. Otherwise, it does what it is supposed to do, and it is fairly quiet.

After using a similar product during a long hospital stay, this was exactly what I needed. The gentle heat comfortably eliminates hand and arm cramps. EXCELLENT customer support. When the heater quit after 3months I contacted the seller by email. Within five minutes I had a personal response promising immediate replacement. In three days I had a new unit. FANTASTIC!

This product is amazing. I had hip surgery and used it at least 3x a day for almost a month. I ended up freezing mini water bottles and using those with some ice water up to the fill line. I couldn't imagine going through my recovery without this product. I have not yet tried the heat function.

Works surprisingly well for the price. No, it is not equal to the GameReady system they use in Physical Therapy. But at roughly 1/20 of the cost, that is not a fair comparison. This ARS allow me to ice down aching body parts in between PT visits. It is well worth the price for what it does.

topic: DANYING Pill Cutter for Small Pills, Pill Splitters, Vitamin Splitter, Vitamin Cutter

I used to tool to split small pills, it did not matter if I got the blade lined up exactly with the scoring lines on the tablets, it worked well with out making a mess of the pill, very neat

This product works alright I use mine for my prescription, which is a pretty big capsule. Haven't tried it on small pills, but it cuts through big ones. Sometimes it cuts it into three pieces, though.

it didn’t smell anything like sandalwood it smelled like rose very disappointed in the aroma, but it was packaged amazing the smell is definitely long-lasting and strong enough just wish it was the sand I wanted! 😞

it was having trouble letting soap stick to it at first and wasn’t sudsing up. But, after a couple of uses, it wore down and started sudsing soap, exfoliating, etc. Way more effective than a regular loofah!

topic: Kunto Fitness Graduated Compression Socks for Men and Women (Medium, Black)
texts: I am a Respiratory Therapist in a busy Hospital in Fishersville Virginia. I walk five to seven miles daily at work and these socks have made an enormous difference in how my legs and feet feel. The only negative is that I did not get them sooner.
I bought these to wear during my stress test so my legs wouldn't hurt as bad on the treadmill. I did see a difference and my endurance seemed a bit longer and there was almost no soreness in my legs!

After years of running, I decided to try compression socks. I just received the socks and have not used them long. I like the padded foot and the feel of the socks. Because I have short legs the socks are a bit long. Maybe I'll try the sleeve next.

I bought the size medium and they are too long. I wear a size 8 woman's shoe and these socks come over my knees. I don't have particularly thin calves. The compression was mild on my calves and was comfortable. The thing I don't care about them is that the toes are very bulky and take up a lot of space in my boots and sneakers. There is a lot of padding around the front of the foot and is comfortable when wearing no shoes. I was hoping to wear these hiking but because of the excess bulk in the foot and toe area, they just don't work without causing blisters.

LOVE these socks, probably my favorite pair of compression socks and I've tried ones from the medical supply store, and several different brands from Amazon and elsewhere.
