I’ve been outside for 3 hours. I’ve applied this at least six times thinking maybe I didn’t get good coverage. This ultimately doesn’t work for south Alabama mosquitoes. Also, the bottle started leaking. I’d give it two thumbs down but really I can’t take a break from swatting mosquitoes off of me.

I have used Swamp Gator Insect Repellent for several years. I live near a forest in the pine barrens in NJ, otherwise known as bug central. LOL. Along with mosquitoes , we have a lot of biting flies in the summer. They make working in my garden a misery on summer days. Swamp Gator repels the flies better than any other repellent I have tried. The few times I have neglected to use it, I have had trouble with flies. When I use it, I hardly notice them. I also have a lot of allergies, and this does not cause any skin irritation for me. I will keep buying this as long as they make it.

UPDATE: My husband said that he thinks that he didn't use enough of the bug spray, the first time, and that is why he was eaten alive by the mosquitos. The next two times he played golf he sprayed more on and didn't have a problem!
We have used it for years! Smells great- works beautifully! I get eaten alive without it. I spray on before getting dressed head to toe- never a single bite. No swarming gnats either!
South Florida's rainy season is prime time breeding for the State bird-the mosquito. I have used DEET for years. Now I am using Swamp Gator with excellent results. My outdoor friends also approve!

I’m getting used to applying this product in 2-3 hour intervals for max protection. I’m also hoping I can keep the fire ants from biting my ankles while golfing, so far so good! Like the smell and wish the spray application was wider or faster. Overall pleased!
I bought this product strictly because it is deet free and the manufacturer/supplier's good reputation. It works perfect and without the harmful chemical deet . I love it & am very satisfied

topic: 12 Pack Surefire CR123A Lithium Battery 3v with LightJunction Battery Case
texts: I had another brand of CR123a batteries in my weapon light didn't last as long compared to the Surefire brand. Will only run Surefire in my weapon lights from here on out.

SureFire 6 SureFire 123A Batteries I was very pleased with this order These Batteries are sometimes difficult to find so I was pleased to find them in bulk packages. If you use a Tactical Light I would recommend this product. They do burn out with out much notice so it is always advisable to have extras on hand

These Lithium Ion CR123A Batteries work great and last a long time. I use them is the older ARLO Security cameras that we have inside and outside our condominium - they last a long time before needing replacement.

I’ve tried (compared) several brands of CR123 batteries, including rechargeable. These outlast them all. I’ve been using them for my Arlo cameras since early 2017 and they outlast the others by a couple weeks use, minimum.

Batteries arrived in secure wrapping just one day late, but this is totally expected due to all the traffic in and around the area. I checked the voltage and all batteries have 3.22 volts which would mean they are fully charged. I would recommend this produce to others

I purchased a SureFire flash light at Turner's sporting goods store. When I wanted replacement batteries, they were always out; they were always on order. And if they had any, they only had two. They price was outrageous. So the Amazon order of a dozen was fast and saved money to boot.

We bought these batteries to go in our new Surefire flashlight (The brightest small flashlight I have ever seen). The original batteries are still good, so I would expect these to perform similarly. Good batteries.

I don't know why but these batteries died in about 3 weeks after use. I purchased a pack of six and I used 3 and like I said they died with less then 3 hours of total use. I just put in the other new three and I want to see how long these last. A waste of money so far hopedley just a bad batch.

topic: SP Ableware Hole In One Key Holder Red Wide Oversized Handle - 60668
texts: The product description is pretty accurate. It only holds two keys but is sturdy enough to turn the ignition. And that's what I needed help with. I'll figure out how to link my other keys and fob since big issue is solved.

I work at an assisted living facility and we have residents that cannot open their doors with the keys. These are the answer to their difficulty. We have several residents that use these and they are so happy because they can open their own door without having to call a caregiver. They are very high grade and easy to carry in a walker pocket or purse.
This "handy, dandy little item" works perfectly giving my 89 year old arthritic mom the advantage she needs to properly hold her key and easily unlock her door! Thank you for a superb product!!

It definitely works but will give you enough leverage to break your key off in the lock. We broke/bent three different keys in a new, stiff lock. A design improvement would be to have the key turner attach closer to the teeth of the key.
This is a gift that someone recommended to me for people with arthritis in their hands. Hope it helps her as much as it has helped the person that recommended it. Thank you Amazon and ableware.

This product was delivered to me in less than 48 hours. My husband put the ignition key to my 4Runner on the front end and our house keys on the other. I am now able to turn the key in the ignition without causing great stress to the RA in my right wrist and knuckles. Great product, super customer service!

Great product. Excellent leverage for turning a key in a difficult lock with arthritis hands. However only a slim metal key will work in it - no keys with plastic grip at the top. I had to get my keys remade using plain metal blanks. Also I needed help from a man with strong hands to get the keys into the holder.

Great invention. Really helps my husband control the key. I have some peace of mind knowing he can open the exit door in an emergency. This handle is easy to grasp and easy to find. The nut can be tightened to minimize key movement.

topic: White Tea West Luxury Signature Scent Air Freshener/Fragrant Room Spray - Made with Fine Fragrance and Cosmetic Grade Essential Oils
texts: I like mixing this scent with my cleaning solution of dishwashing soap and water. I spray my mattresses before I make beds with clean bedding and my house just smells great!

It smells good & a little is all you need. But with that being said, it's just too expensive. It's a small bottle. It would better if instead a spray nozzle it would have one that delivers a fine mist. At least it would last longer.

I receive the spray from Westin from a friend and it is exactly this item. So instead of paying $60-75 for this product, I buy it here. It's perfect, although a bit pricey, especially directly from the distributor. a few months ago, I got it "on sale" for $24. Today, it is $42. I love it though!!!
This spray was most disappointing. The only scent we smelled was a faint Cedar wood. Not even a hint of White Tea. Not at all what I read in other reviews. Too bad. Almost 50.00 wasted
White Tea is an amazing product!!! One spray lasts forever! Everyone that has come to my house says how good it smells! I bought this for my sister and she is a big fan! Worth the money!!

Have been trying a number of products for over a year trying to address an ongoing odor in the home. Nothing has worked. This stuff is amazing. The bottle looks small but after you realize how little you need it makes sense. Very pleased at its ability to tackle an odor and keep going.

My car had a wet musty smell from rain getting in and I used another product for 5 straight days but the smell remained. I bought Blaze Away Commercial Air Freshener and with one application the smell was gone and has remained gone to this day with no smell returning. This product works and works very efficiently. I would recommend this product to anyone as I love that it lived up to the claims it made in its description.
Love this smell. Wish it came in larger sizes. Very much the closest match to the Westin hotel scent. Not exact but I don’t mind and might like this scent better.

topic: Kunto Fitness Graduated Compression Socks for Men and Women (Extra Large, Black)
texts: These are awesome! Great quality and they really do help keep my feet and legs from aching so much. Only downside is they are a little difficult to put on. Not enough to drop my rating. If you have any trouble with circulation or foot pain these really do help. Nobody paid me for this review and I did not get anything free or discounted for my review. Will be ordering more.

My doctor recommended compression socks as part of my recovery after breaking my ankle. I found these to offer the best pricing AND padded toes and heel areas, which I wanted. I have minor plantar fasciitis and my heel and balls under my toes are sensitive to walking on bare floors. These socks offer great support and the padded areas add an extra layer of comfort.
Man o man. I love these socks, which I had more. They make your leg and feet feel wonderful well at least it do mines. These are a must have, try them for yourself

Fabulous!!! This is the first pair that my husband absolutely loves! He was 3d-burned as a child and is now experiencing lots of leg pain in his later years (56) from the burns the docs say. He's tried many brands and this brand helps relieve the pain. He loves the thickness and the comfort too. They were a bit too long so he ordered a smaller size....3 more pair. Worth every penny.

These are great very comfortable!! Help with swelling and pain control big-time. Only problem when they came they was a same tear in one. But they made it right by sending a refund immediately. I will be ordering another pair asap

I was very pleased with these compression socks I can't believe it actually got rid of my leg cramps like it did. About 95% gone. they were delivered on time and appear to be of really good quality. I Plan to buy from this seller again.

I bought these to combat tired legs and feet at the end of an 8-10 hour lifeguard shift, mostly standing. They make a huge difference. I wear them hiking and biking too. Also, they look great. I'm buying two more pairs.
Ordered an extra large. I have worn compression socks before and found these very dufficult to put on and were extremely tight and uncomfortable. Were not graduated compression in any way.
Finally! After returning other scales I tested for accuracy, I purchased these basic scales and have found them to be accurate. The only accurate scales I have ever had, have been Tanita brand.

While on a major weight loss program, my nutritionist suggested getting a good scale. I asked what was the best, and, without a moment's hesitation, she advised to get the Tanita HD-34. I am so happy. Sturdy, accurate, smart-looking. A must have.

I picked up this scale at the recommendation of my physician. Cheap scales can weigh pretty inconsistently at a 1-2 pound swing. This particular scale is far more accurate. I tested the accuracy by weighing certified weightlifting equipment that I knew weighed exact amounts. This scale reliably confirmed each reading. The scale does have done heft to it, which is indicative of the quality. Of all the scales I’ve owned, this one seems to be the most accurate and highest quality. I found this purchase to well worth the price.

Scale is large and very heavy when you have to move it. I have owned a more expensive version Of the same brand for 10 years and liked it. More bad news..... you cannot return it. I guess I did not read the fine print.

I compared the readings from this new scale to two others that have been calibrated. It matched. The scale itself is lightweight though sturdy and appears simple and stylish. The button is quiet and no squeaks when it is stepped on.

If you're looking for an accurate, attractive digital scale that doesn't break the bank, this is the product you're looking for. Sick of having two different scales in the house reading 5-7 lbs. (at best!) difference each time, we wanted a scale that was as accurate as possible for less than $40. I got my wish! Nothing fancy--no body fat readings (not that those are super accurate on scales) or multiple users, but this is accurate to +/- 0.2 lbs and seems to work just so when I measure my weight several times, turning it off in between readings.

My Tanita HD-314 is incredibly accurate based on a test where I weighed two 25 lb barbells. The scale displayed 25.0 lbs for one, 25.6 for the other, and 50.6 lbs combined. It showed my weight as144.0 lbs and after adding the two barbells it showed 194.6 lbs. That's amazing accuracy! However the platform needs to be bigger and flatter. People with large feet or who have difficulty balancing should avoid this product. Also the display would be easier to read if it were LED instead of LCD.

My first Tanita lasted close to 10 years; it had body mass features but they seemed highly suceptable to fluctuations in hydration making it more of a novelty that an accurate indicator. This time I just wanted to know my weight and this scale does just that with accuracy and ease.

topic: Sound White Noise Machine with 36 Soothing Sounds and Night Lights Sound Machines with Memory Function 36 Levels of Volume
texts: Our 6 month old has used sound machines during sleep since she was born. We have so many different kinds - we even have the Hatch. This one is my fave after Hatch. We have it in the living room for when she naps there and we love it. I love the night light candle like feature too!

Husband is actually the one who wanted this as he loves to fall asleep to the sound of rain. Before he ended up with that one, I checked out the other sounds. Crickets, frogs, water, birds, storms, etc. It can be set on a timer or turned off and on at will. A ring of light appears in the dark on the top of the machine, turns off by tapping the top of the machine. The light is muted, doesn't light up the whole room.

[[VIDEOID:367fed935b181e9dfcbc46751aa5675c]] A beautiful device, I got it for myself, I love the sea wave sound, however, you have many options to select it will depend on what kind of sound you like. The noise machine has a great power sound; it really blocks any external sound so you can relax. It helps to improve my sleep, it has three timers (30, 60, or 90 minutes) or continues mood. I like its compact and beautiful design that’s why I placed it close to my bed.

This white noise machine/night light is perfect for achieving optimal rest and relaxation. It's a great size for taking with you just about anywhere. It provides an amazing variety of sounds (36 to be exact) and easy for anyone to find what works for them. It also provides a timer and 36 volume levels to top it off. I highly recommend for anyone with issues unwinding and getting sleep. It's also a great gift for any new mom is your life (they will thank you!)
I love the white noise and the ability to put the light on! My 7 year old and 4 year old learned to use to with ease before I got to it!

We've tried a number of these things and this one isn't bad. It's not the most UI friendly one, but it's not bad, either. We do love the design and it looks sharp sitting next to the crib. We like the different noise options, but we do wish the sound quality were a tad better. The baby certainly doesn't care, though, so overall we're satisfied.

This sound machine isn't awful but it's not my favorite either. Alot of the sounds in my opinion as a re not very relaxing...and definitely could only sleep to a couple of them...even thought theres so many...it has to be plugged in at all times or wont work...it just wouldnt be my first choice, amazon had alot of other choices I would pick first.

[[VIDEOID:b326c65a232163221d500491683f3f97]] Awesome little machine. About the size of my hand. Puts out loud and great quality sound. I love the different modes of sound and each has like 6 varieties. Definitely enough for everyone. Also like the light feature that turns on with a light touch of your finger. Only complaint is this only comes with an older style USB cord, not a wall plug. Works fine for me, but keep that in mind.

topic: Turtle Wax Color Magic Ultra Shades of Blue New Formula Colored Car Polish Cleans
texts: This stuff works. Be advised that like any wax, it does wear off eventually. In the meantime, the result looks so good that the paint/clearcoat seem like new, if the scratches are small enough. Buy more than you think you will need; one bottle is maybe enough for a small car.

A decent wax, like regular turtle wax. Goes on easy comes off easy. Works well to diminish scratches, fills them in with the color of the wax, where regular wax would show up white. I have used the black and now the blue on a 2017 Civic. In my opinion, worth the money.
I received a damaged, unsealed bottle with wax around the top of bottle and lid taped on. Pretty shoddy! I paid for a brand new bottle not someone else's used return.

Have a blue vehicle with speck like chips in the clearcoat that regular polish turns white so, with with focused application and repeated buffing the chips turned blue and vanished from sight. About $4500 cheaper than a paint job.

My 2019 Subaru Forester Limited got some scratches on the edge of rear hatch was open when overhead garge door was closed. They were deep enough for the white primer to show through faintly. Regular buffing didn't work. This Turtle Wax color Magic - Blue did the trick.

Had a dark blue car with a couple deep scratches and was doing a lease return. It worked so well, made the car look almost perfect, and I wasn’t charged for any damage. Body shop wanted $850 to repaint my door! Very happy with this product!

Got this color wax because the top of my Tahoe fading. Dealer must of used something like this. Because a week after buying the Tahoe it was fading. It did help bring back color but it's a temporary fix. Have to do every 4 days...Az sun a killer. Will get clearcoat fix but for now it's worth using.

I like it. Works as advertised. Not a perfect substitute for an honest to goodness paint touch up job. But you must know that no wax product is that fantastical. It does however mitigate very nicely the little speckly imperfections and tiny chippy marks in your blue paint. I used this product in black when I had a 12 year old black vehicle and it worked great! This blue is very good, not as great as the black, but on my Nissan Murano blue from 2007, it created a great improvement.

topic: SUPRENT Multi-function Beard Trimmer, 5-in-1 Professional Men’s Body Grooming Kit with Mustache Trimmer, Nose Hair Trimmer and 8 Sizes of
texts: Absolutely love this trimmer. It's sleek and ergonomic, easy to hold and manipulate into trimming edges. Battery is very nice compared to others I've used. The only complaint I have from it is the guards for the beard trimmer pinch my hairs and pull them out. At first, it did it ALOT but now I know how to detect it before it pulls it out. Granted, I have thick, curly beard hair, but it does snag one or two just about on every run through. Other than that, it gets the job done nicely.
Very suitable for cut or trim hair and beard, a lot of accessories. All-in-one designed tool. I bought it for trimming my little son's hair. But it seems more powerful than that.

This trimmer is works as expected,comes everything you needand long battery life,i had one Philips Norelco Series 7500 and it dead with the battery for few months used.hope this dont let me disappoint.

Looks nice, but from a full charge, the battery needs to be recharged again halfway through trimming my beard. Trims nicely without the depth extensions used, but for some reason, with them, it just feels like it is pulling your hair out... can not understand why. but either way, do not buy this based solely on how terrible the battery is.

Great man's grooming kit. It's a lot better than the one that I have used before. Decent quality, straight away and it doesn’t vibrate too much, so makes shaping much easier. All trimming heads fits perfectly to the main device. I would highly recommend it！

Works nice but be careful changing the attachments. Attachments are nice feature but it seems fragile when changing ends. Does nice job on hair and plenty of guards for every length. I haven't mastered the eyebrows yet. Rechargeable is very nice too.

Arrived quickly and packaged securely. I have had a lot of these types of clippers. This one is by far the best I have owned. I like the accessories/charger base. The main thing I like is, if you look at the picture you can see the long black button close to the cutting head, this is a slide type button to adjust the depth to 3 different short cuts without using the guards. A lot of power to cut and the charge lasted a long time. The silver round button gives you the option of locking it on cruise control or just pressing the button to cut and release and press to cut again.

This trimmer has many more uses than I expected, while I haven't used it for haircuts, the possibility is there. The mustache trimmer (main reason I bought it) is a bit rougher without the guard than I would like but overall the attachments as well as the adjustable length of cut on the trimmer itself even without the guards makes it a superior grooming tool. Highly recommend it for quality and price.

topic: 2 in 1 Epilator for Women Hair Removal with Electric Razor Bikini Trimmer, Cordless Women Electric Razor with 18 Tweezers
texts: Very surprised by this product. It works extremely well. Shaves and pulls hair very nicely. Gotta be cautious though when pulling hair and it took me several passes just to get everything. Very good, but could be better.

As far as pain goes, it’s not excruciating, but if you have a very low pain tolerance this might not be for you. It does a pretty efficient job with hair removal. You’ll need to make multiple passes and then redo on a weekly basis, afterwards you can begin doing biweekly. I would only use for legs as any other areas(armpits and such) are too hard to maneuver the device.

Nice little 2-1 electric epilator hair kit that comes with brush and cord. Can be used for many places such as armpits, legs, bikini lines etc. Very quiet and easy to use. I definitely recommend to family/friend!

[[VIDEOID:46bf07192823567cf9b451a13ced9846]] I've tried laser treatment on my legs recently so I had to shave my legs with razor. Few days later new hairs showed up. They were not too long for waxing treatment that's why I've decided to try an epilator. Honestly, I was very skeptical because I couldn't believe that epilator can catch such small hairs. But it did! I will post before and after pictures so you can see how clear my leg was after using this epilator just for a few seconds! It removed my short hairs with the roots! I'm impressed! Definitely will be using it. It is lightweight so I will be taking it with me when traveling.

This came exactly as pictured. I have never tried an epilator before and this one allows you to switch between a regular shaver or the epilator. According to the instructions, it says that the epilator might be uncomfortable for first time users so I went with the shaver attachment for the first time use instead. It removed my hair with no problems. I would definitely use this again and recommend for others to use.

The description of the Epilator, 2 in 1 Epilator for Women Hair Removal with Electric Razor Bikini Trimmer is accurate. It has two replaceable heads and two speed settings. The trimmer works decently and the epilator works if you can stand the pain. The machine is small and compact for easy use in multiple angles. I do feel this is a cheap plastic version of what an epilator/trimmer should be. The heads are activated by ONE small plastic gear which does not scream longevity and contributes to a slower cutting speed. For quick use in travel situations, this machine is great as it is small, compact and easy to use quickly.

So my main issue with this epilator is that of the 2 heads that were included, one didn't work. It was nice to have the option to switch, but the second head doesn't work. My next issue was that this was painful. I did a handful of passes and it was just painful every time. I might give it another shot some other time but I would pass on this one. Doesn't seem well made if one of the heads isn't going to work.

[[VIDEOID:3231cbf94f042c42a25dbc418d84f824]] This epilator, is really practical. First it is cordless and have a usb cord , so you can travel with it and charge it anywhere. Second it comes with 2 heads a trimmer and an epilator head. I have noticed when using the trimmer I can not use the speed 2, but able to do so with the epilator head. I am not use if it's a malfunction of mine or if it is normal. For me it works well because I am not a very hair person , but if you have thick and like a zero hair or roots epilation , you could find a better epilator

topic: Eco-friendly Bamboo Dental Floss with Refill | Organic Vegan Floss Infused with Activated Charcoal, Natural Candelilla Wax, Peppermint Flavor |
texts: Sure it breaks easier than the flosses with teflon in them, but after watching the movie "Dark Waters" it makes me very happy to have proof that this bamboo floss contains no teflon . I also like that it's in a reusable glass container.

I really like this natural floss product. It feels good to know that I have reduced the impact on the environment while also maintaining a hygienic lifestyle. It works just as good as the oral b floss I typically use.

I love the way the floss really cleans my teeth and does not shred. Plus it's biodegradable (vs. the standard nylon) and comes with a second refill. The little glass bottle is about the size of my thumb (glass breaks down whereas plastic never does). I plan to give this to my friends and family to spread the word (yet another way to reduce our dependence on plastic products!)

Didn't think I'd write about floss before, but here I am. Great product. Strong floss with better grip than I'm used to from other brands. Love that it has a refill, comes in glass, etc. Think this will be my go-to source in the future.

Used the floss one time and it snapped off. can't get it loosen from the opening in the center so the floss is basically useless and I guess I'll have to get more. I like the idea of not using as much plastic just wish the spools were designed to avert the snapping off issue.
Convenient bottle that protects floss while letting you know how much is left. Durable material that cleans well while also environmentally friendly. Happy a refill was also included! Great product.
I value the fact that the floss is eco-friendly. And I also truly like that the floss works well, does not break, and presents no toxic plastic or other chemicals into my mouth. I'm smiling.

First time using bamboo floss. I discovered it was much easier than I thought it would be compared to traditional waxed nylon. The packaging and glass/ chrome dispenser is classy. I also appreciate the refill. I should be set for a while.

topic: Myhouse Women Girls 18k White Gold Plated Rhinestone Heart Ring MOM Letter Ring For Mother's Day Gifts (8)
texts: Well I ordered this a few months ago and I'm just getting around to the review. I'm not even disappointed, really. I was shocked. It is cute! It is, however, pretty heavy. But, overall, good fit and definitely a neat little gift.

Shipping took forever (2-3 months) lol but what can u expect for the price. Good quality for how much it costed. Ordered for christmas but it came in two weeks after but thankfully my moms birthday is in january so i can still give it to her:)

Super cheap looking, “diamonds” are not sparkly, the ring itself looks right out of a quarter machine. It arrived late and is missing 2 “diamond” stones! I truly didn’t expect much for $1.88 ring, but you can not classify this as costume jewelry. Wish has better products.

I bought a size 7, as all my other rings are a 7. It won't go past my knuckle on my middle finger where I wanted to wear it. Wearing it on my right hand ring finger and it fits there, which that finger is a 6. Still will wear it, its a beautiful ring just wish it fit the finger I wanted it for.

My son picked this ring out for me. For the price I thought it would be more like a ring out of a gum ball machine, but it wasn’t. I wash my hands & sanitize them several times a day & it is holding up wonderful.

Great quality for the price! I recieve alot of compliments when I wear this ring! This is my 2and purchase of this item! Previous purchase of same ring turned green around band within a few months but the price and quality of ring makes it worth purchasing again!

Very surprised! At this price I was expecting something different not the look it gives me. Always wanted a mother’s ring well I saw this at a great price and hopped on it. Doesn’t turn my finger green, leave marks or scratch my fingers. A great gift to give your mother. It’s not the price it’s the thought that counts. So in this case you are covering both areas.
I wasn't sure that this ring was going to look like much when I ordered it but to my surprise, it is absolutely beautiful. I love it. It was also true to size.

topic: Poswlto Eye Mask for Sleeping Men Women Block Out Light Sleep Masks Concave Molded Night Sleep Shade Cover Mask Blindfold
texts: This is the best eye mask I have found yet. The concave molding over the eyes has a lot of room and it does a really nice job keeping the light out. The strap around the head is also comfortable and the Velcro never catches my hair.

Facinado con la compra, mi esposo que es exigente ha quedado encantado con él, lo utiliza en sus viajes de trabajo y dicen ser confortables realmente. Se olvida que los tiene puesto al dormir, no le incomodan para nada.

Just ordered a second one after trying the first. Adjustable for a perfect fit, and the best eye cups on any of the dozen or so masks I've tried - enough space to blink and firm enough to hold it's shape but is not hard.
It completely covers all the light. It has a contour around the eyes and is very comfortable. It won't be placed directly on your eyes, so you can still blink.

I had this mask only for 6 months. At first it used to be okay but lately I noticed that it's coming off and falling on my bed. I tried adjusting the velcro patch accordingly to my comfort level but still wouldn't help. I had a Nayoya eye mask before but they don't make it any longer. This product in my opinion is 100 % junk not worth it doesn't even block the sunlight properly. The seller doesn't even have the guts to take the comment or respond back to it. Such a filthy product I have ever seen.

Finally found a mask that actually works, after having the one I used to use being discontinued. This mask covers very well, with only a few minor tweaks and adjustments being needed to keep light from creeping in by the bridge of your nose. The eye domes could be a little bit bigger, but overall, it is pretty close to perfect. Plus it comes in a fancy package, with ear plugs and a small box for the earplugs. Fun! We even bought a set as a Christmas gift, in addition to the three we secured, in case this one gets discontinued.

It's basically comfortable on the face and eyes, but if you do not sleep on your back all the time it does need a bit of adjustment as one rolls over from side to side. This is common to any sleep mask that I know of and don't believe it to be an isolated complaint that detracts from this particular item. I don't think you will get a better mask for triple the price.

No light comes in, and it's so comfortable you forget it's on. I have trouble sleeping in hotels when I travel and this mask plus the white noise from my Pandora worked like a charm, I fell asleep almost immediately because it blocks out all light and you can't even tell you're wearing it because it doesn't press on your eyelids. I highlight recommend.

topic: Calendula Flowers, Whole-8oz Heat Sealed Pouch
texts: Definitely a lot more flowers than I expected to receive! They came in expected condition, no mold or debris. I've since used them for a couple batches of calendula-infused oil and it has turned out wonderfully! This stock will definitely last a while!!

First off, I'll say that 8 ounces is a lot more than I imagined. Second, the dried flowers look bright and vibrant and smell amazing. I bought these for tea and the taste is excellent. Lots of whole flowers in the bag, which I love, and not a whole lot of stem stuck to them. It's going to take me a while to get through all of these flowers but I'll definitely be buying some more.

I am using it for making tea for me. That would require for remove some flowers with actual seeds. The good side of I have now lots of calendula seeds and will try to grow them at least just as flowers. Other than that it is a good tea that helps with candida A in the body, including mouth.

The eyewear is great (fits over my glasses), but I needed a strap that would hook into the holes at the end of the eyewear's stems. These straps may be a tad overpriced, in my opinion (when coupled with shipping charge), but for me they were worth it because they filled the bill perfectly. Didn't see anything else on Amazon quite like these straps.

I got these for my son’s sports glasses after he lost the elastic strap that came with the pair. First of all, these were a “Prime Shipping” item and took 5 days to arrive. The quality of the straps seem pretty good. The straps however are way too big. My son has a big head and with these straps shortened all the way there is way too much room. My son wanted the straps to keep his glasses from moving while running/moving. They do not do that because they are way too loose.

These are perfect. My son is 7 and wears Enzodate 48's. He wears the strap just below his hairline and pretty loose (as he doesn't like anything squeezing). They are just the right length. he wears the strap not quite as big as it gets, so he still has quite a bit of room to grow. His original strap started to look kind of dirty after about 6 months and so we tried this as a replacement. Perfect. The fact that I received 3 straps kind of surprised me, but I'm thankful we have a few more spares! Thank you.

I bought these to replace the strap on my son's dilli dalli frames. They fit on the frames very well, however, due to the way the plastic clips are it does make the strap a little longer than the original. The only problem I have with these straps so far is my son (who is 3) likes to pull his glasses off and when he did it with this strap part of it came undone (see photo). I can easily sew this back together so it's not a huge deal. I already had to sew it a little to make the strap shorter as the shortest length wasn't enough.
Our toddler got glasses and the straps that came with them kept coming off. We wanted something that would stay on. These are perfect! Love the colors and the hook attachment.

I searched everywhere for Dilli Dalli replacement straps. The company told me the only sell them through eye doctor offices. Which is inconvenient for me - I wanted something shipped to me. Not only are these reasonably prices, but they loop in through the small holes in the back of the Dilli Dalli frame perfectly. They don't look as integrated as the Dilli Dalli original straps do (the plastic pieces show on these.) But, for my 2.5 year old son, the look is not a big deal and he hasn't noticed a difference in how it feels. We will be back for more colors if/when these straps stretch out.

These are great. My 18 month old can’t get them off and the different colors are so fun. I wish they were a little shorter so I could tighten it more. I had to knot to make it right enough. On an older child you may not have that issue though. Also the colors are less vibrant in person than online. But overall I am very satisfied.

Love these straps!! They worked perfectly for my 4year old son’s Zenni’s. Can’t tell you how long I’ve searched for these, and the amount of money I’ve wasted. So happy we found these. Great price and awesome product.

topic: BUG HULL Pill Cutter for Small Pills with Blade Guard, Tablet Splitter with Finger Protect Guard, Stainless Blade Medicine Slicer
texts: Where has this been all my life?! No more cutting with a kitchen knife to lose a portion of the pill or have it fly across the kitchen. My doctor recommended buying a pill cutter because only wanted me to start with half a dose and then scale up if needed...wow, I never knew such a small thing could make me so happy!

No way the pills can be cut in exact halves with this thing. A kitchen knife did a better job. For the price I paid, I knew I could not expect perfection. However, if perfection is advertised, perfection should be delivered. I needed to cut my pills in two exact halves. Taking more of the med one day and less the next day compromises my health. Obviously I need to find another solution.
It is a razor blade and the pills I am cutting are for a pet and need to be clean cuts into pill. Okay for halfing pills not quarters. Apex does a better job there
This little gadget works great! It splits the pills easily and does just what I was looking for. You won't be disappointed if you order this product. We're very happy with this purchase!
My old cat requires daily blood pressure medicine and the pills are tiny. This works nicely to cut them in half. Very rarely does one end up crushed. It seems to work best if I apply pressure slowly.

Excellent pill cutter. I was prescribed a really tiny pill that I have to cut in half and it was an ordeal until I got this cutter. It works for tiny pills and big pills too. I like it so much that I will buy another for a relative that needs one. Highly recommended.

The product works well. But the top locks down after each cut. Very annoying because it is not easy to unlock. I cut off the lock, and now it works great. A lock is completely unnecessary. They need to make a sight change in design and and it will be perfect.

I had to start my cat on anti-anxiety meds and give her a half pill each day. They are the tiniest things I've ever seen and a knife wasn't cutting it (no pun intended) because I knew it wasn't accurate. I ordered this yesterday afternoon...it arrived this morning just in time for her meds! It has this great v-shaped rubber insert that held the pill perfectly and made a nice, clean cut. I'm so glad I ordered this product and feel relieved that I know she's getting the right dose on a daily basis.

topic: FlexiSnake Pro Drain Weasel Sink Snake Cleaner with New Molded Tip - 18″ - Drain Snake Clog Remover Tool with
texts: Forget the so-called "drain cleaners" that just discolor your sink drain fixtures. This amazing gadget will quick dislodge hair and other material clogging your drain in a few seconds with any harmful finish damaging acids or lyes. A little pricey but a great product.

Best invention ever - easy to use, the rotating handle makes it easy to grab the hair in the drain and the flexibility works great with turns in the pipes. This is my second order! The globs of hair are removed from the drains in seconds!

I love this Flexsnake drain cleaners.. They are so easy to use . It was surprising how much you actually pull up. Love that when you are done you just throw it away. Wish they had refill packs so you do not have to buy the entire device again.

What a great idea! I just twisted it a few times and the clog was gone. Cleaned the drain way better than anything I've used before. I didn't know how to clean it off without lots of effort because the little bristles will catch hair and wrap it around, so I threw the wand away. I still consider it a great investment, as it is much faster and effective than other methods and it comes with extra wands. Very easy to use.
Although a little pricey, this weasel really gets my daughter's long hair out of all the drains! I do wish each weasel could be used more than once. I shoud have this on a subscription!

I had a drain problem in the bathtub and I tried liquid plumber without any success. I wasn’t sure if these would work and the reviews seemed a little mixed. I finally decided for the small cost it was worth a shot. Opened the package, grabbed one of the snake/weasel tools, put it down the drain, gave it a twist or two and pulled out a bunch of hair. So happy I decided to buy these.
This is a worthless product. If it did reach the clog, it isnt strong enough to pull up more than 2 hairs at a time. Don't waste your time and money!

My husband loves this gadget and has bought a couple. It seems to give him great satisfaction to remove drain gunk and make me look at it. It does a good job of removing all the long hair that clogs the drain.

topic: TopNotch® Back Brush 2 Brushes for Bath or Shower 1 Clear and 1 Blue with Long Handle Body Scrubbing
texts: This scrub brush is perfect for exfoliating while in the shower. The brush is firm enough to get the dead skin off but not too rough that it hurts or scratches. I hang mine up to dry by the little loop at the end of the handle and it's good to go for my next shower. You also get 2 in a pack so you can have one in each bathroom. I recommend. This product was provided at a discounted price in exchange for my honest review.

Great price and great to have the option of buying a two-pack. One for each shower! And each brush is well-made. No jagged plastic bits around the seams and the bristles are firmly embedded. And there's a hole at the end of the handle, so you hang it on a hook, as well.
These brushes are terrible. The bristles feel like you are using sand paper on your back and the head is angled in the wrong direction, making it awkward to use.

The original version was constructed of a cheap brittle transparent plastic but the latest is more of a polypropylene that’s flexible & resilient. High density bristles and nice & firm. Only negative is the handle could stand to be a little longer. If you want a good stiff aggressive brush this one will do nicely.

These are very well-made, sturdy, easy on the hands, won't mold, and beautiful. I dropped one on our hard tile shower floor and it didn't break or crack. The additional directions to use hot water to soften bristles or cold water to harden bristles are an added benefit for varied peoples preferences.

Back started itching in the middle where you can't reach. Bought this and hung it in the shower. Works great, great quality and seems like it will last a lifetime. I bought the 2 pack, so I will have to leave one in my will for someone.
I enjoy the bristles, but I wish the handle was longer. I have good arm mobility but still have to struggle to reach all areas of my back with these brushes.
The brush is just perfect for back, leg and arm scrubbing. Relatively stiff, but not too much to endure. NOT for face or other sensitive BODY AREAS. I love this one.

Just received the package, it doesnt have the amt. of product on the bag. When is the best time, if there is one, to ingest the mixed product? Use it anytime or have eaten before? I am anxious to use it although first time trying it. Thanks.

Great product, dissolves easily, good quality, virtually tasteless and provides a piece of mind knowing its a clean product. The only negative is that it is out of my price range.

Love this collagen! It is from organically raised animals and wild caught fish so no toxic gmos, pesticides or heavy metals from gmo feed. There are no other brands that can claim this. Most brands are made from gmo-fed animals and full of toxins. I have used many brands of collagen but this one mixes the best and it doesn't get gloppy like other brands.

The powder dissolves so readily, no lumps, easy to prepare, where could I gain more info. on any expected results from taking this product for osteoarthritis assistance? Please advise. Thankyou.

I am ordering this for the 2nd time. I like that it has different sources of collagen as I used to buy each 1 separately. It's not that I have noticed any dramatic results, I am using this for health and as we age our collagen production declines. I really like this company and will continue to order from them.

Work great on higher end sunglasses like my 2 pairs of pit vipers because they are all lens nad scratch super easy so its great to have these to clean the crud off of them and not have to worry that cleaning them will damage the lens

By the time you open the packet and the wipe, it's mostly dry. It takes about 3 of these to do the job of just one generic pharmacy brand. I would not purchase this product again, and do not recommend. Sleek packaging, though.

These lens wipes work well for cleaning your mobile phones, screens, and eyeglasses. Does well removing the grease and oil and leaves no streaks. I prefer these individual packaged wipes over a microfiber cloth. The wipes are 4 x 4 inches. So far, I have not opened any dry wipes. Convenient to carry a few around with. I am using these wipes for both my glasses and for my camera lens. They leave no streaks and the cleaning fuild is drying up right away. I am super satisfied

topic: Luxury Bath Pouf - Shower and Bathing Sponge Mesh Puff Luffa | Loofah | Louffa with Gentle Body Exfoliating Scrubber
texts: I suppose if i had read the reviews I would have been smarter about this purchase, but I was in a rush and in need of a new bath poofy thing. They're not bad, per se. They're just super tiny and fall apart quickly. They'd be great if you were going away for the weekend and expected to throw it out after you traveled.

These are great Poufs!! Thick, not like others that will fall apart after a few uses. And customer service is phenomenal. My package arrived with a missing Pouf and they gave me a credit PLUS sent me another order. It was not asked for, they just offered. Nothing like great customer service along with such a great product. I will definitely buy again when needed. Fantastic.

I just received my 3rd re-order of this product. I like them because they are on the small side, as others have said, and they seem to hold together pretty well. However, on this last order, they were twice the size of what I had been accustomed to. Not sure if their supplier changed, or what happened. I will give these a try, but wish they where the same size as the others I ordered.

Good product, but it was a little soft for my preference, it expands a bit more quickly than the other ones that I have used before; probably wouldn't use again but still a 5* product -- I first received an opened package that only had 3 pouf's -- i contacted customer service, they were quick in response, gave me a full refund and sent me a completely new package again. I would recommend this product to a friend if they liked the softer bathing poufs. :)

We have always used poufs instead of washcloths in out family. Me being the only female, I feel mine last longer than my husbands or my sons. It seems theirs fall apart much faster than my own. When I received these poufs I expected them to be larger which was a disappointment. They still are quite nice and are not scratchy like some I have used. They lather nicely too. I purchased these at a discount to do an honest review, and although they are nicely made, I don't believe I would pay full price for the set of four.

Puffy puffkin bath pouf! I love that these are packaged together with different colors! I kept one for myself and I'm using the others for stocking stuffers, but I almost want to be greedy with them and keep them for myself! The pouf is firm and tightly knitted together so it doesn't unravel like some I've had in the past. I noticed I only needed a small bit of body wash as it lathered up very nicely! It scrubbed all the day's work off and left my skin feeling smoother and softer! I was given a coupon code to provide an honest unbiased review and all opinion is 100% my own!

I am extremely pleased with my purchase. The quality of the mesh sponges are superior and not cheap. The material of the mesh is soft, rather than rough. These sponges are excellent to provide a satifying clean in the shower! The sponges help to provide a great lather, and also gently exfoliate. I am very pleased with this brand, the product, and the pack! I definetly recommend this item and I will definetly be repurchasing from this seller. I recieved this product at a discounted cost for an honest review. This is no way affects my opinion of the product and I have not been paid to provide or alter this review.

A bit on the smaller side as one reviewer mentioned, but overall a good product. Each pouf tends to last 3–4 months before starting to lose its shape, so this 4-pack should last most people about a year.

topic: Sleep Headphones 3D Eye Mask, Bluetooth 5.0 Wireless Music Mask, Eye Shade Cover with Ultra-Thin Speakers Adjustable, Blindfold for Men
texts: I wasn't sure these would actually work for me, but they do. They are comfortable, block out all light and the music is just what I need. You have to fiddle with the speakers every time you put on the mask to position them just so. If you have insomnia these could change your life. Try them

The sound, ease of use, and comfort make this a perfect sleep mask. Amazing sound for a mask. What makes this even better than the others is the space for the eyes so it's not smashing your lashes and eyes. I can lay down comfortably with this mask. Love it!
Love this! I listen to meditation’s at night when I go to bed and this mask is perfect. It beats putting your phone by your bed to listen to things. It’s comfortable and the sound is good.

The sound on this mask is really nice and the battery last all night. The mask itself I found to be very uncomfortable because of the way that the eye socket pillows are too bulky which causes very noticeable large indentations on your face. I was told that I looked tired by two people after wearing the mask. It’s a “No Go” for me!

I wanted a good pair of in-ear headphones. Being a side sleeper, the fit was very important to me. I figured this mask might do the trick since I use a sleep mask and headphones. I am pleasantly surprised how well they work, given the relatively low price. They are not super comfortable when sleeping on my side, but not bad enough to keep me awake. The sound quality is good. The only thing negative I would say is I would like the battery to last longer. I get about 1.5 nights out of one charge. And it is weird in the middle of the night to hear the lady's voice say BATTERY LOW. Overall, I am satisfied.

I have really enjoyed this blue tooth headphone sleep mask. It allows me to set a podcast, calming sounds or easy listening music to drift off to sleep or just relax. My only comment would be the info provided about the charging. There were no instructions on where to charge this sleep mask. Trial and error to find it. However, overall I am very pleased with this product.

I love the idea. Unfortunately, that idea really isn't realized here. I purchased these thinking I could replace earplugs for noisy neighbors, but I can easily hear everything and it didn't work out. However, the reason I really don't like this is that it also doesn't work for what it is. The speakers don't stay put, so if you move around at all, you will find that the speakers are no longer on your ears, causing either not enough sound or imbalanced sound. So unless you're the type of sleeper that lays down and doesn't move an inch for eight hours, these simply don't function for their intended use.

I love the amazing sound quality and battery life of this headset. Allows me to listen to music all night and not have to worry about the battery dying. The only issue I've had was the Velcro strap in the back being uncomfortable when laying on it. It stabs into my head and makes it tough to sleep. I put some cotton in it so it feels better but that's all I didn't enjoy.

topic: Rael Natural Herbal Heating Patch - Cramp Care Natural Heating Patches (1 Pack, 3 Count)
texts: Like all Rael products, this is high quality, great value for the money and just work. I purchased these for my daughter, who likes being able to have a “mobile” heating pad.

Initially I was hesitant to try this product but was suprised that it actually works! I have massive cramps during my time of the month and am always taking Advil, however I have found an alternative. This little heating pad keeps your belly nice and warm and really alleviates the pain. I would definetly recommend using this product if you have cramps and are tired of taking pills.
I ordered these in April. Used one and was not impressed. It is August, I went to try them again and they are not even getting warm. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND

These worked great. They lasted for at least 8 hours and were fairly comfortable and easy to use. Only complaint that kept it from 5 stars was that it had to be stuck to clothing rather than directly on skin so I had to choose appropriate clothes to ensure I had something covering where I wanted the heat.

This products says not to put it on your skin but I did you can feel the product better and its not as sticky so it don’t rip your skin or anything fell asleep like a baby with this on. Great for people with endometriosis I put this on my lower back

You know those hand warmers that get super hot when you shake them? This product is just like that but BETTER. It has an adhesive so you can pretty much stick them anywhere - on top of your undergarments for your cramps or even for any back pain (just stick it on top of an undershirt or something). I thought it would have a smell because it's called an "Herbal Heating Patch". But there was no smell whatsoever and the warmth lasts WAY longer than 6 hours! I want to say up to 10 hours. Love this product and definitely recommend it!

I have endometriosis and can’t take my heating pad to work when I need too. I purchased these patched and had to use one for the first time today. Going to stock up! These are life changing, I put it on at 9am and it’s now past 2pm and it’s still hot. I like that it's discrete and no one in the office knows I’m wearing one.

The best product I have found for cramps. These patches alleviate my cramps very quickly! I just wish that they were a little bigger and has better adhesion, that being said, I will continue to buy them!

The company that supplied and installed our granite counters recommended this product and now it is easy to see why. The counters have remained sealed, are very shiny and remain new looking. The product works well, is easy to apply and does not give off unpleasant odors. I'll definitely keep using it!

Like how the daily cleaner works... no streaks but I wish it had the same scent as the Supreme Surface Treatment! That smells amazing. This is the third cleaner I have tried and I think I have found a winner!

Had been using the cleaner/sealant for years recommended by the tile company that installed the kitchen countertops. Needed to reorder and the former came as a kit with a daily cleaner. A bit skeptical, but find the daily cleaner is great, and do not have to use the sealer as much. Also, found the daily cleaner does a super job on stainless steel as well. No build up and removes finger prints and occasional water drips from fridge.

Bought a new house with a granite composite sink and wasn’t exactly sure how to care for it. After I had a stain in it I bought this and it removed in my first go. Really feel this is a great product for the sink I have.
I used a same brand sealer every day for a week & now I just use this cleaner as needed. My sink shines & beads up water. It's smooth & shiny. Love it.

topic: CYMBIOTIKA Creatine+, Creatine and Glutamine Supplement for Amino Energy, Recovery, Muscle Mass & Brain Support, Liposomal Delivery, Gluten Free &
texts: Each packet contains 4g of Creatine and 500mg of L-Glutamine. For only 20 doses this seems like a high price to pay though I understand that the delivery method and other ingredients may be worthwhile to others. The flavor isn't bad, but it is strong. It made me cough, though I didn't mix it with anything. It tastes like raspberry in high concentrate. This is likely to mask some of the other ingredients. Overall, I believe this is a high-quality supplement but just know that there's not many servings in a box and the doses are on the low side.

If I could get a decent pre workout packaged like this, I’d love it. So far this concept comes closer but this is very under-dosed to be considered anything. Maybe throw some caffeine? Just use generic creatine at 5g? Or make this vitamin shot with creatine at the right dosages? I’m not sure, pick a market and go the whole way not just a product that could be this could be that.

I guess I didn't read it properly that this is 20 individual packets. This makes it super easy to use and you don't waste a thing. The flavor is much better than I expected and it has all the right supplements in the correct dosage. It is a tad on the pricy side but is much better than the powder alternatives.

I really like the fact that these pouches are super portable and easy to bring with you while on the go. There is a good level of creatine and L-Glutamine as well. The flavor and consistency really aren't bad considering the relatively high dosage of creatine and small package size. Definitely a good option if you don't have time to make a full pre-workout drink or are travelling.

This pack is great because each pack contains a good amount of creatine and L-glutamine for muscle recovery and growth. I have been taking these after my intense workouts and I can definitely feel the difference in recovery and strength. They are super portable and easily taken while on the go. The flavor is good and allows the supplement to be taken easily. I love these packs for their portability and overall health boosting properties. I highly recommend them.

Best mixed in with something to hide it which seems misleading sense it’s in a single dose package meant to take on the go. I can handle it but my wife doesn’t like the feeling after taking it she just described it as making her feel jittery or tingly.

This is pretty interesting to me because usually when I take in creatine, it's usually in powder form or capsule. I noticed that after taking this in, I felt the effects more immediately, but at the same time I think this product is pretty potent because I get slight jitters if I don't push myself hard enough during my workout. Still, that is why I take creatine, to push myself harder and get more gains.

love the concept, the taste needs work though. it's a yogurt consistency. I recommend mixing into drink rather than taking it by mouth because its awful. it kind of burns going down. love that I can carry it with me to the gym without a mess. don't really see a boost of energy but for what it is...not bad.

This is the element in cranberry juice that makes it help wipe out and prevent UTI's. I have experimented with it for years. If you dissolve a tablespoon with a full 8-oz glass of water both before and after sexual intercourse, it causes the bad bugs (e-coli) to clump together and pass out of your bladder rather than stay in there and get a foothold.

I have only just started using this product, but it dissolves quickly, had little to no flavor (maybe a slight sweet taste), and is easy to use. I'm hoping it will keep away any and all UTIs! Thank you for an easy transaction and a great product!

this is my 3-4th order, I am using it for my cats with renal issues, so far it seems to really be helpful, I just add it to the daily drinking water and all drink from it. so the do not mind any taste if there is one. it dissolves easily in water.

Had chronic uti for 2 months. Had adverse reaction to antibiotic. As a last resort doctor recommended d-mannose. Within days symptoms started going away. I have had chronic uti's for 42 years. I will definitely take this every day to help prevent or ease my symptoms.

topic: Afriso Mechanical Float Operated Tank Contents Gauge - for 2" NPT tank openings
texts: Upon receiving it, I installed it on my vertical 275 Gallon tank. I removed the 2" NPT cap and before I put on the new tank gauge, I measured the depth of the heating oil left in the tank, it was 26 1/4". According to the tank oil level chart: a depth of 26" indicates appoximately176 Gallons of oil (5/8 tank). After I installed it, it read 5/8 as seen in my attached photo - pretty damn good! The shipping was fast as well! The only thing that I feel less comfortable is, shipping is not free. When all put together plus tax, it's almost $50! And it's all made of plastic, so how durable it will be?

This is the best oil tank gauge out there. Why would anyone use those gauges that are made with float on a arm! They always break or catch on side of tank. I ordered it just a few days ago n it arrived tonight , put it in it just 2 min Thank you!

SOOO easy to install! Our tank is 275 gallons, but on its side (wider rather than tall). Popped in the alternate gauge ring, climbed in to the crawl space, unscrewed the cap on the oil tank (the old gauge wouldn't budge, so we left it), screwed on the new gauge, and DONE! Bummer, only half a tank... Hope to get many years use out of it, but if not, I'd buy this again...and send someone else into the crawl space. ;)
Super easy to install just screw it right into the bung hole where the plug is and you're done. You might have to adjust the sting on float depending on the height of the tank.

Very simple gauge to install. Have to be a little careful, since it is made of plastic, so you don't crack it while tightening it. Would be nice if it had the ability to thread it into both a 1 1/2" and the 2" opening. This gauge is nice because it is a simple drop weight float, so there is no issue with the float getting interferred with by the older exsisting gauge system.

Worked great in my 250 gallon IBC rain water water storage tote! I have two totes connected for a total of 500 gallons and they’re wrapped in black plastic so this is the only way to tell how much water is stored. Very happy!

I really really like this gauge used for my 275 gallons heating oil tank. It's so easy to read like a vehicle fuel gauge. It's spot on for my oil tank height no string adjustment needed. This gauge can only be hand tight and it fits 2 inch opening hole on the tank. I just put a little silicone grease on the thread and the rubber o-ring and installed it.
Does not tell the correct amount of oil in the tank. It was reading 1/4 left so I called for a fill and it only took 100 gallons. We have a 275 gallon tank. Easy to install

these came vacuum packed and flat as a pancake. they are squashed beyond belief and will never be fluffy and soft like they are supposed to be. they are horrible and not soft at all. they are cheaply made and cheaply shipped and I can not use them. they are going in the trash since I already opened them and to find the softest one I used them... none of them are soft and usable.

topic: XL Hot Cold Therapy Reusable Knee Gel Ice Pack Wrap
texts: I wanted to like this item. The idea is great but they really need to go back to the drawing room and get it right. It warms up to fast. My knee and surrounding area needed more ice pack and less fabric

The XL Hot Cold Therapy Reusable Knee Gel Ice Pack has been a wonderful product. It is used every night to reduce the swelling in my right night. Since I have used it I have been able to sleep well with no aches.

I took this out of the freezer after several hours and it was too stiff to wrap around my knee. waited about an hour for it to become pliable but it kinda lost is most of it's cooling effect. I will shop or buy another knee wrap with a better gel insert or one that uses a better type of plastic wrap.

topic: Verilux Heritage Natural Spectrum Deluxe Floor Lamp, Antiqued Brushed Brass

Bought both a floor model and a desk lamp: every bad thing you have read in all the other 1 star reviews are true. * the floor model is poorly constructed and after assembly is wobbly and tends to work loose at joints * floor model is highly unstable * bulbs are expensive and short lived * both lamps died within a year * customer service isn't * light output was poor

I am putting this lamp out for the trash tonight. It worked fine for a few months of infrequent, gentle use, then for no reason at all stopped working. A replacement bulb also did not work. The lamp cannot be easily repaired or returned. So it has been a piece of expensive and completely nonfunctional home decor. You take your chances when you purchase this lamp. (Oh, and if yours happens to function, don't plan to use it on a carpeted surface and have it stay stable; I had to put a piece of plywood under mine.)

Good reading light is hard to find. The Verilux provided that in an attractive design that kept peace in the family when I added it to our living room. Easy to assemble, simple to use. fair price for the product.
