Expensive replacement bulbs and although there is another company making a compatible bulb for half the price, Verilux added a notch to theirs so that this is not an option. You MUST buy the "Verilux" bulb. I did try the other, it didn't work so save your money. Sent the lamp back and looking for an alternate lamp brand that has a better reputation.

I would prefer to give this no rating. The lamp was in excess of $200 and NEVER worked. I purchased another bulb as company claimed that was the problem. Still does not work. The company said it was the ballast sent another. Lamp still does not work. I now have to box it up pay to send it back and also include a $14 check for replacement shipping. This lamp is not very sturdy and gives off zero light. Flush your $200 less stressful.

Right now I am pretty annoyed because the light just arrived and I can't position the light to point downward. It only faces the wall. Curstomer service not open when I called so we will see what they say after they read the email I sent online. It does look nice, aside from the fact that the light is pointed at people's eyes.
the lamp is advertised as new but both the base & the lamp itself are deeply scratched. The screw in the base to hold the pole is not seated properly but is off center. the lamp does work though.

topic: Cricket Flours: Pure Cricket Powder 1/2 lb (Made from Real Edible Insects in Portland, OR) Great High Protein Option for
texts: Very tasty addition to my smoothies! I'm transitioning to a Paleo diet and prefer to use a protein source that isn't derived from beans, rice, whey, eggs or other vegetarian sources, mainly because they are either overly processed, raise my blood sugar or don't agree with me. So I've started using cricket flour when I want a smoothie. I also plan to play with making my own protein bars using this flour. This is WAY better than the overpriced and overly processed "protein" bars sold in the stores and more affordable than Exo and Chapul cricket protein bars.

I found this product to be exactly as described. I baked both chocolate chi(r)p cookies and whole wheat bread the day it arrived, substituting the cricket powder for 20% of the flour called for in the recipe. It completely disappeared in the cookies. The bread had a slightly different aroma than usual, but the flavor was excellent. I hope the price will come down in the future, but regardless, I will be purchasing again. Highly recommended.

This stuff has a really gross metallic aftertaste. I really wanted to like it too! I am not a picky eater at all, and am adventurous with new foods. We made muffins and granola bars that just had a small amount of this cricket flour added, but I just couldn't stand the aftertaste. (Neither could the rest of my family.) What a waste of money!

The smell and taste of crickets is still very strong regardless of what you mix it with. It's worth trying if you are open to experimentation bit I couldn't get past the smell. Baked a whole loaf of bread and it made the kitchen smell like crickets. Even with jam and butter we still tasted crickets. If you are ok with the taste of chiton, this is a great product. If not...keep looking.

I'm pretty adventurous and will try almost anything once. I actually tried it three times, but I could not find a way to mask the taste. Some others mentioned that it had a nutty taste. To me, it was more like dirt. I tried it with berries, cashew butter, bananas and other foods, to no avail. I could still smell and taste the insects. Guess it's back to plant-based protein powder for me.
Pretty much a rip off for the amount I got for the price I paid. It also doesn't taste particularly very good. I tried making brownies with it and I couldnt even finish them.

I have bought a lot of different cricket powders/flours before, this is the first time I have bought this product and ran into this issue. There are hard black small pieces of something, if I had to guess it would be the cricket "crap", which should not be there. Normally crickets will be fasted for a few days so that all clears up, this step either did not happen or somehow missed. I will upload photos of what I am seeing a bit later. Definitely have to throw away the entire bag, that is an expensive lesson to got with a different vendor..

Seems like great quality but I have a hard time with the taste. Haven't yet figured out what I can use it in that will either mask or compliment the taste. I *am* vegetarian (well not completely, obviously ;-) so I think that's why I don't like the taste so much. I think if I ate meat, I'd like it more.

topic: Cadillac Boot Scrubber Cleaner Shoe Brush - Mountable Boot Scrubber Buffer for Boots, Shoes, Sneakers - Indoor/Outdoor Boot Scraper
texts: THE PRODUCT WORKS BUT THE MATTERIALS ARE CHEAP , NO LONG LASTING , SPECIALLY THE WOOD IT ROTTENS WITH RAINWATER, FAST! BARELY LAST ONE SEASON, THE DELIVERY WAS INSANE FAST !
The product arrived with bristles already fallen out of the product. The holes for bristles are too large. The product is not good quality. I do not recommend this foot scraper.

Thought it was great at first but after a few days of use, the wooden bottom brushes have already come unattached from the frame and now only brushes left are on the sides. It worked great but not built durable enough for work boots.

Received this product and thought it was well made. Used on one boot and worked well, started to clean the other boot and one of the blocks of wood holding the brushes broke loose from the screws. This happened just after receiving it on the first time use. This is not the well made product I thought it was.
The metal base was scraped inside the box and it appeared to be a used or returned unit. The mounting hardware that was advertised as with the unit was not provided.

I got this to screw down to our new ramp that leads from our backyard down to the lake behind our house. I had to wait a few weeks for it to be built, and then screwed it down last week. The first time I used it this week, one of the cross brushes broke off the screws that it was attached to the metal frame. The wood on the brush was split and there is no way to re-attach it. :< First time to use it and, last time.
With so much rain this year, we were constantly bringing grass into the house on the bottom of our shoes. This worked great. Took the grass off t by e bottom and sides if our shoes.

One of the small brushes broke away from its hold on my first purchase (right side in pic) and then same thing happened on my second purchase (left side in pic) within a week of its use. First purchase was a lesson, second purchase was a mistake and won’t be a third purchase because that would be insane.

topic: Master Massage Glider Adjustable Rolling Stool in Black with Chrome Grab Bar for Salon,Beauty, Home and Office Use
texts: I was hoping this stool would work because it showed as double my weight. 1st issue cushion might be 4" but when you sit on it, it goes flat & hard as a rock. 2nd issue is the hydraulics has never stayed in place it slowly goes down since I got it 2 months ago. At 1st I thought it was my imagination but it's not & having mobility issues I use it around my kitchen & it's hard to work at the sink when it's low.
I wanted to like this stool but the seat is quite small and so poofy that I always feel like I'm going to fall off of it. The wheels don't roll well. Really disappointed.

I was impressed to start with. It glided well. One day as I was gliding across the room I hit a crack in my hardwood floor. It wasn’t a big crack, but when it hit the crack it shot me forward and I heard a high pitched cracking sound. I rolled on but felt unstable so I looked. The plastic in the leg broke. Now if I try to ride it the broke leg folds in on itself.
Less than a month later, and this stool will not stay elevated. You sit down and it does all the way down. You get up and it comes back up...and that's with my 200lb husband!
So soft comfortable however my tush and balance needs practice I slide off the seat maybe it needed a back rest, not the fault of company. Just want think about staying seated.

It may hold up to 500 lbs but it don't fit fat bottom girls. OK, I am not not 500 lbs but I do have a large bottom and I felt like I was going to fall off this thing. When you sit on it the outside edges gives away because the base under to stool top don't go all the way out to the edge so when you sit on it, the part that is not supported give away and you are left with the part that is supported and for a fat bottom girl that is not enough space to feel safe.

I Purchased this stool in January. It will not stay up now. You sit on the seat and it slowly lowers to the lowest point. The hydraulics do not hold up. I am past my return date and cannot find info about getting it replaced.
This is a beautiful, sturdy, adjustable stool. I'm only 5'2" and the seat is a little thick for me. I have a hard time using the stool when it is raised up...

topic: Tech Love XXL Electric Heating Pad for Neck Shoulder and Back Pain Relief with Fixation Strap Moist Heat Pad with
texts: Works wonderfully !! The extra large size is very nice and makes covering a large are such as back or lower back and stomach at the same time a breeze. I highly recommend this product

They make it look huge but it’s not. There’s a larger less expensive one I got after this one turned out to be smaller than I thought. I still use this one too and it hears fine just doesnt cover my back like I need. I got the sunbeam model that’s much larger for $44 for my bedroom so I can cover and heat my whole back before bed.

I've bought this item twice. I actually love it for the size, comfort & adjustable heating but it just doesn't last. This pad has no durability. First the heating temperature starts to decline then it just dies by only returning the "F" error message. Once that happens, there's no recovery. The first one lasted about 6 months and the second lasted only 3 months. I use it according to the directions and never use the damp heat option. That doesn't help to preserve it for long-time use. Both pads followed the sequence of failure I described above. Sadly, I must strongly recommend against buying this product.

I purchased this heating pad twelve months and a week ago. It has stopped working, giving the dreaded blinking 'F'. The warranty was for twelve months. I'm not even mad that it's broken; I'm impressed that it broke so close to the expiration of the warranty. They really know their timing. During the twelve months and a week that it did work, it worked pretty well. My only complaint is that an 8 hour cutoff would be more useful than a 6 hour cutoff but that's a minor quibble. It was a nice heating pad during the time period in which it worked.

So I have bought this product twice. First on 10-9-1018 then on 2-18-19 because the first one stopped working. I do like the 6 hour shut-off compared to 2 hours on most others. It has lasted longer than other heating pads I've purchased but I use mine almost daily with Reynaud's disease. I probably would not have ordered again but I didn't check the date of my first purchase until I sat down to write this review. We will see what happens.

I use this thing nearly every day. It gets screamin hot really fast, an auto shutoff that works, and hasn't set me on fire yet. Dislikes: i hate the texture of microfiber, so I'm not a fan of the pad part. And it does get super hot. Like you could probably burn yourself easily if you have poor circulation and don't pay attention. I only ever use the lower settings, which are lovely.

Bought this on March 16, 2019 and it stopped working on March 31, 2020. Digital display just keeps showing "F". Disappointed that something of this price range would have a problem after such a short time. Spend your money elsewhere.

Great when it worked! Now when I plug it in I get a flashing F and turns off! In a matter of seconds! Waste of money! There's no fix online! I have plugged it in and taken out and still FLASHES F! VERY DISSAPOINTED!

topic: 5PCS Cotton Black Face Masks ,Washable & Reusable Anime Cartoon Kpop Lucky Bear Women Men Muffle Face Mouth Masks
texts: Bought one of these from a different seller and realized I wasn't washing it enough. Bought this pack to fix that but the breathability is the worst. You're just breathing in your own hot air and end up really hot after barely a few minutes. Pattern is printed well, but i cant reccomend.
After the first wash, the cheap fabric tore on the side on the first use. The fabric string became brittle as if it was not fabric. None of them lasted.
These masks are huge. They are too big for my teenagers. They are also very thick and hard to breathe in. The stitching tore when I took it out of the package. Not good quality.
We received our order nice packaging that zips closed. 3 out of 5 masks came unraveled. They are cute, soft but if they went through quality control they missed these big time.

Over the course of a few washes, these shrank by half. They started out adult size and ended up child size. The quality other than the shrinkage, is great, good stitching, nice amount of layers, and thick, which is nice. Just wish they would have worked out. Printing was still great, regardless of shrinking.

I gave it a 4 because the material that goes around the ear was cut in the middle and then sewn together instead of being cut near the mask and tucked in. Also the stitching on the ear pieces is loose, giving the impression that it may unravel after repeated washings. Only time will tell. Kids love it.
Worth it they haven't broken. The masks are thick but you can still breath in them. They print hasn't disappeared I washed them 3 times immediately when I got them.

Poorly made. Material is very thin. One side of the ear loops is slightly bigger than the other making the mask sit on ur face funny. I bought these for my 4 kids and they are too big for a child (7-8 years old)

topic: New HAIR CLIPPER Trimmer BEARD Head Blades Replacement For Philips BT7220 BT7220/13 BT7220/15 BT7220/16 BT7215 BT7215/13 BT7215/15 BT7215/16 BT7215/49 shaver
texts: This poor-quality trimmer head has several problems. First it noticeably slows the motor speed causing the occasional pull on your beard. Second it only lasted two months before the tabs that hold it to the body of the trimmer wore out. You'd be lucky to get one that isn't damaged in shipping but it's way overpriced garbage, don't order it.

I purchased this to replace the original which had broken during use only to find this one doesn’t cut hair very well. I’ll try it again and if still not working properly I will return it for another replacement. Very unhappy

The cutter on this head is complete garbage. But that's OK, because you're buying it to replace the stupid little plastic tab from Norelco's spectacularly poor design, and the plastic is a perfect replacement. You can swap the blade for your original by removing the single screw on the bottom (no need to remove the top two screws).

This doesn't get the job done. Like so many others, the cheap plastic clips break on the original Philips blades. This replacement fits just fine but it grabs your hair something fierce instead of cleaning cutting it. I use it to shave my head with no attachment (don't like to flat blade it) and it actually hurts to use this... and in the end doesn't really get it done. My hair is uneven. So bad I don't even use it... so don't bother.

Bought two since they break every 6 to 9 months. Put on the new one which was louder than the original blades. Followed the advice of others and removed the bottom center screw, slid apart the base, and put the original blades on the replacement plastic base. Seems to work great.

This already broke within two months. Horrible product quality. This is a cheap Chinese knockoff, but on the pictures they try to make it look like it's an original piece, and they certainly charge close to an original piece.

I had previously bought from Amazon a replacement shaver assembly that worked wonderfully for several years until the plastic prongs that position the assembly in the shaver broke. I have really liked the now-discontinued trimmer so I didn't think twice about ordering another. The second assembly looked fine but was a total disaster. Shaved poorly, pulled hair. Won't make this mistake again.

I got this after I broke my original head - which worked for years with no problems. It took months to get here (from China, my bad - and corona - but months to get here... After about 2 uses it has started to pull my hairs even after oiling. I dunno - as fragile as the originals are, I wish they would have a head that was actually OEM.

topic: PTSLKHN Eyeglass Nose Pads, 20 Pairs of Adhesive Anti-Slip Nose Pads, Soft Silicone Nose Pad Cushion for Glasses, Sunglasses, Reading
texts: These are low profile which is a plus and they work, however the adhesion they doesn’t work well for long so you do have to replace them more than I’d like

I bought these pads to keep my reading glasses from slipping. They worked perfectly for about 3 weeks then they just fell off! The adhesive stayed behind but the silicone pad was gone. The glue was difficult to remove and wound up peeling off the finish on my plastic frames. Really disappointing
While they do their job for the first day or so, the pads fall off almost immediately, leaving the adheshive to be scraped and scrubbed off. But you get 20 pairs for 4$, so you get what you pay for.

The adhesive disintegrated into a very thick sticky mess. It adhered to my face, the glasses frame and lenses. It took an hour using 90% alcohol to clean the mess . The rest is going into the trash. Hopefully my new glasses haven't been damaged by this product.
My husband has oily skin nd so the pads only last about a week. He would like them to last longer; but they do help keep his glass up and in place. He does like them for comfort.

I have plastic frame glasses. Without silicone nose pads my glasses would slide off. The price is good, the packaging is nice, & they are easy to adhere. The problem I had was that after about a week, they fell apart. Maybe if you got these for a pair of sunglasses you don't wear all day, every day you'd be ok.
From the first day, the heat from my face warms up the adhesive and makes it leak out and makes my nose sticky. They're completely useless in less than a week.

well I have not had glasses for a long time so I unaware the nose pads were not a universal size. I haven't even got the chance to see how the feel because they are to big, I thought I could try to trim them but it looks terrible and they just fall off.

topic: Innotech LumbAIRPlus Portable Backrest Inflatable Lumbar Support Cushion with Adjustable Internal Air System, Black
texts: Incorrect sizing information listed! The dimensions listed for this product is 13.5x3x7. The actual product itself is 10.5x3x6. When I contacted the seller, they told me the dimensions were the size of the box, which would have been fine if I wanted to pay that much for a box... 10"x6" won't meet my needs. And the only thing better than to have paid for the shipping for this incorrectly described product is to pay to send it back...

The air inflatable support has an additional 2" of foam padding that results in a very awkward bulge behind your back and in my case is far more support than I need or want. Nowhere in the description does it mention the additional 2" of foam and this is enough to make the support very uncomfortable and essentially unusable. It gets two stars because it is easy to inflate and deflate. Those are about the only advantages I see. Not a product I would recommend or purchase again.

Caution: they will not accept returns if you've opened the package! Thankfully, I had read another evaluation of this product and was warned. I returned it intact in the packaging and vendor was very good about crediting my account.

Purchased three of these. One works flawlessly. The other two constantly loses air - which is a pain to use. Customer service sent me a new pump and told me to cut the old one off and use a lighter to melt the plastic and attach the new one. Haven't tried yet.

My father does long driving trips for work and the vehicle does not have very good support for the lower back so I recommended this to him and he loves it!! He takes it with him on every trip now and he says his back feels much better when using it opposed to when he does not use it.

This is a good product and performs as advetised. I would have liked it to be a little wider across my lower back. Also note: it provides considerable support even when the bladder is totally empty of air. If you want to remove all support, you have to take it out. Otherwise very comfortable, also makes a nice neck pillow when you want to tilt you seat back and take a nap.
It's too short so it doesn't provide enough support - just sort of makes a lump that pushes into your back. It's made very well. If they'd make it taller and taper the top it might be perfect.
this thing constantly needs to be readjusted as it is always sliding down. I stopped using it after a couple days and donated it to a local charity resale store.

topic: Collagen PRO Peptides Pure Premium Hydrolyzed Protein Powder 16oz Grass-Fed Pasture-Raised Unflavored Easy to Mix Non-GMO Paleo Friendly Gluten Free
texts: I am confused by so many reviews stating that there is no flavor in this. There is a distinct scent of beef product that is then confirmed by the taste. Orange juice could't hide it. I cannot comment on the results as I just received it and have only choked it down twice. However, I may not be able to convince myself to continue to drink this product because of the offensive taste. Admittadly, I am easily put off by smells and tastes. This is only a hint If you don't have a sensativity to tastes you will be fine.

My update on this product after going through 2 of them. It doesn't work. I didnt see any changes. My skin is still dry and nails still breaking and hair still falling out. I'm glad it worked for a lot of people but unfortunately not for me. I will be trying another brand. Wast of money.

I bought one can at first. When I saw no results I thought I hadn’t used it long enough. I bought four cans the second time I ordered. I’ve used this for about four months now. It has not done anything except cost me money. Absolutely no improvement of any kind. I tried not giving it any stars but that wasn’t allowed. My rating would not even give one star. It has a nasty taste and terrible odor.
I give this 1 star because of the awful flavor it has... Just gross, i cannot even drink it.. Tried it in juice, tea, and crystal light... Awful. Too bad.

Bought this for my bulletproof coffee as a substitute for another brand, and am very disappointed. When I add it to my coffee and whip it in my vitamix, it foams and bubbles up like animal fat and curdles in my coffee. Completely gross looking & couldn't drink it. I am returning the product to get my money back & will not purchase again. I will spend the extra money to get the good stuff that mixes well.

I bought this for my husband, so he could increase his protein intake. He really seems to like it. He doesn't seem to have energy crashes after working out when he uses this. With what I've seen from him, I think I'll be taking out myself. :D
This stuff is not odorless ...tasteless yes but odorless, far from it smells like rotten fish...it's not easy to drink..I have to hold my nose and chug it...Will not be purchasing again.

The best! I've tried probably 6-7 brands of collagen peptides, having rheumatoid arthritis, food allergies and being keto. This mixes the easiest- all I do is put it in my cold coffee with a lid and shake. Also, it tastes the best, no after taste, just makes my coffee creamier and richer than with just a splash of cream. This afternoon I had made some bone broth and was looking to add a bit of protein and I didn't think it'd taste good with this, but I was wrong! It was great.

topic: Heel Tastic As Seen On TV Foot Cream 1 pk
texts: I bought this one for my daughter because when she stays over she uses mine and loves it. I put it on in the shower and use one of those foot file peals and rub it for a few minutes. When I get out of the shower and dry my feet they feel like I have had a pedicure. It's really great.

The product is clearly no longer the one I have been using for years. I mean it smells better. That's about where the positive things end. It's now greasy and the "tube" lasts about 1/4 of the time it once lasted. One month everyday and you are 'out'. I could once buy it in CVS for a decent price and it would last forever. Now, it is relegated to low status on Amazon and costs nearly twice the price- not in the "Prime" list. I will probably find something better. I have turned so many people on to this product. Makes me sad to have to say this and move on.

This is a fake product, there is no expiration on it, it looks different, the package was different. It is a different color and smells totally different. Do not buy! I have been using this product for years and this is fake! DO NOT BUY!! FAKE!!!

I've purchased this before but have never experienced such a mess like this. It was a very creamy/soft texture (instead of the normal/firm consistency) which led to too much product left on my feet. Will only be able to get 3-4 uses out of it before it's completely gone. Very disappointed.
This item came used with hair and particles of something on the stick. I’ve used it in the past and loved the results. Disgusting to open what I thought should be brand new.
This product arrived and it was very very soft and mushy. I used it once and it was like a muddy cream. I had to throw it away after 1 use.

This product is the absolute best for dry, cracked heels! The roll on application is super-simple and it starts working immediately. I saw significant improvement in the condition of my heels within days. Even my pedi girl noticed the difference; she is now hooked on this product also.

I used Heel Tastic for years and love the product - the most recent purchase through AMZ however does not work - product will not advance from tube - probably "Chinesium" plastic technology - have to dig product out with finger

topic: FootMatters Expander Shoe Horn Extra Long Handle - Twist to Lock - Extends 16 to 31 inches
texts: I am very disappointed with the lack of sturdiness with the shoehorn blades. Within a half dozen uses, the heel slide portion was bent and misshapen. The heel slide is way to flimsy and will not hold up.

The horn is on a spring, which makes it way too flexible. My wife and I have joint issues that makes it difficult to bend fully to slip on shoes. Thought this would be useful for traveling, but the flexible spring end made it VERY awkward. I travel alot, so thought this would be great. I normally use a plastic boot shoe horn (which is great) like this https://smile.amazon.com/gp/product/B00JVF0F96/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_search_asin_title?ie=UTF8&psc=1. It's just too long to fit in my normal suitcase for shorter trips.

Disappointing! It does NOT stay locked in the length position at all! The purpose in having an adjustable shoe horn is to be able to adjust it.This fails to deliver, does stay locked in position. Not pleased with this purchase! Waste of money.

The spring between the shoehorn and the handle defeats the effective use of the long handle. Because the spring bends when you try to put your foot in the shoe, you have to bend over the hold the shoehorn upright. So no better than a plain short shoehorn.

This two bad features expands, yes it does but will not stay expanded when you try to use Also the picture doesn’t show it but there is a spring that makes it impossible to keep it straight I sent mine back
I am pleased with my purchase. The extension is easy to adjust and I can use it when needed. It was described perfectly and I received just what I ordered.

I see the issue people have with the spring, but this type of shoehorn is not for that type of use, you have to know what you want. This type is for simply sliding your heel into a shoe that fits properly. You can’t use it to leverage your foot into a tight shoe. So for what I expected of it, it works great.

There seems to be a divide among reviewers regarding the swivel feature on this product—some people really like it and some don’t. Count me among the latter. Also, metal portion of the horn which is supposed to help you slide your foot into the shoe seems much too flexible for the job.

topic: Organic Dried Elderberries (Sambucus nigra L.), European Whole Cut, 1.25lb (20 Ounce), Great Immune System Booster for Syrup, Gummies, Jelly,
texts: We used this product to make an elderberry tincture... Our original purchase of elderberries from Amazon had to be returned as it was nothing but a powdery mess. We ordered these as a replacement and are delighted with the quality. We successfully made bottles of tinctures which are reportedly immune system building. Good product.

These berries were terrible. They did not look at all like the dried elderberries I’ve purchased from other brands. They were tiny, seedy, brown and full of dust/dirt. When I boiled them up for syrup it came out brown, sour, bitter and gritty. Not at all purple and tart like other elderberries.

Just terrible, the elderberries are tiny and mixed with what seems like dirt. After making 3 mason jars of syrup I can't get the aftertaste of mud out of mouth. Syrup was a brackish brown color with sediment even after filtering through cheesecloth and 2 coffee filters. Dumping what I made and trashing the rest of the bag. Was a third of the price of my normal organic brand; that should have told me something.

Awful. Do not buy. I have been buying elderberries for 6 years and these were terrible. They were squished i to a powder. Maybe they were super old? And they smelled like wet dog. I made a batch of syrup with these and basically gave it away for free. I did not receive a return for the open bag, but I asked for a return on both bags I purchased.

These are apparently micronized elderberries, whatever that means. Little brown pellets and a fair amount of dust. When I ordered them, they were the only elderberries available. When they arrived, I saw the other reviews and immediately sat down and ordered regular dried elderberries. BUT I also tried making elderberry syrup, and they aren't so bad. I make mine in the Instant Pot with cinnamon, cloves, ginger and vanilla bean. I used less micronized berries than I would whole berries because these are more closely packed, and also added quite a bit more honey than usual. Taste is ok. Hopefully they are as good an immune protector as regular elderberries.

In no way shape or form is this "whole dried elderberries". Upon opening the package, I found clumpy elderberry powder. NOT IDEAL doraking your own elderberry syrup, may be fine if you just want to make tea. Highly disappointing.

This is not the brand of organic elderberries I had purchased before but due to the pandemic & skyrocketing costs I was able to get this...yay, me. Nope. Made my syrup by the same recipe & it’s barely tolerable to swallow. The berries were almost ground, the smell was musty and I will never get them again.
Awful foul powder and twigs, nothing even close to a whole dried berry! Only gave 1 star because no stars not an option.I rarely leave negative reviews,has to be extremely bad for me to do so.

topic: Valentia Lavender Oil 1.7 Ounce Made in USA | Lavender Essential Oil for Skin and Hair Growth | Pure Therapeutic
texts: I love this product and brand. I use lavender oil in my bath at night. Valentia’s Lavender Oil smells wonderful and is high quality. The bottle is a good size for the money and I like the dispenser top. It allowed me to get the right amount out without too much trouble. I will definitely purchase again!

I just received this item. I read all the reviews and there is something very wrong with this Oil. Very disappointed. Does not smell like Lavender at all. I have no idea what the smell is. Just so disappointed.

Same price for twice less the amount it used to be! This is horrible. Absolutely unacceptable. Never again. I paid this price for 4oz. Now it’s only 1.7... are you kidding me?! I’m so glad I’ve read the complaints before placing an order! I’m done.
Fantastic oil and great price for the quality and quantity you receive. I use lavender oil to prepare my daughter for sleep - it is soothing and reminds her of sleep. Lovely scent!
Miss the 4oz bottle. The oil is nice and smells great but I bought the 4oz in the past for the same price and now they sell 2oz for $30! My search for great smelling lavender oil begins again.

I purchased the 4 ozs. bottle and it was so wonderful, needing another, decided to purchase again. NOTHING about the bottle just received is the same! I paid less for the 4 ozs. bottle than I did the 1.7 ozs. bottle! Had I known they would only send a tiny bottle for my hard earned $30, I would have never repurchased. And by the way, this smells nothing at all like the first bottle and another reviewer had it right when saying it smelled medicinal, nothing like lavender. Small bottle and yucky smell this time I’ve been scammed??? I WILL be sending this back and will not purchase again!

my first purchase was for 4oz apps $24 i purchased again it went up app $8 more, I did not squawk until I got a 2oz bottle. topic: Sweetleaf Stevia Natural Water Drops Variety Pack (Mixed Berry, Peach Mango, Tropical Punch) - Water Flavoring, Zero Calories, Zero Sugar,

these are delicious and help my kids drink more as well. They are clear so that helps with others judging me for getting my kids to drink more water. I love that they are sugar free also.

I received the product... on the bottom 12 bottles , I found those individual bottles were stained, expired, and gross!!!! Fortunately the top 12 were ok. Time to change up.

I love 5 hour Energy, especially the Pom flavor, but the "new and improved" version is TERRIBLE. I don't know who in the world would say that the "new" flavor is better than the original, but 5 hour decided to switch things up and it was a bad decision, in my opinion. I have been searching for a box of the original flavor. The picture for this product shows the original box and no where in the description does it mention you're getting the new flavor. I would NOT have paid $50+ for this if I had known, and this company does not accept returns. Buyer BEWARE.

topic: 8-Pack - The Works Classic Clean Toilet Bowl Cleaner 24 Fl Oz Each
texts: I have used 2 bottles of this "the Works toilet bowl cleaner" want to be. Neither bottle barely took out any rust stain and that maybe because I scrubbed so hard. I used The Works all the time for years, then it disappeared off of the shelves. I ordered here hoping to get my old reliable back...Didn't happen. So Disappointed. I won't be reordering from this supplier. BEWARE.

The product is for cleaning toilet bowls. IT WORKS, have used it for years..But the packaging was not up to par for the USPS One bottle opened during shipment, destroyed the shipping container. 7 bottles is enough. The shipper needs to up grade their shipping containers.

There is something different with this product. The packaging and overall appearance is the same as the WORKS I used to purchase at the local WalMart for just a FRACTION of the cost-pre-pandemic; but, more importantly, it does not work at all AND actually made my toilet bowls stains much worse and the newer stains are nearly impossible to fully remove,

I have hard water that stains my bowl yellow. The original Works was amazing within seconds the yellow stain was gone. Used a full bottle in my master bath toilet and it seemed watered down; not as blue and required soaking before the stained cleared. I miss the real Works toilet bowl cleaner. I bought the shower/tub & sink product too 🤔 I’ll let you know if it Works!

This product is the only one so far that does what it says it’s supposed to do! All the other toilet bowl cleaner’s pale in comparison. That is if you have hard to clean stains, lime, rust, calcium etc etc etc

Read the other reviews regarding the active ingredients. This is NOT the same as the Works we once bought in Walmart. Notice it is "Classic Clean". I bought 8 bottles and like other have said, likely will throw them away. I did not even find the cleaner good for basic cleaning, let alone taking off rust. It does NOTHING for rust stains.

I'd always liked this toilet bowl cleaner, thinking it was the best. For some reason it just no longer seems to even work. Have they changed the formula for it? Am extremely disappointed and will not be buying this again.

I love the works it is normally the only thing that we'll get my bathroom clean but this did not come close it is a watered down version of the works in fact I would say it is water with a bit of blue dye in it

topic: Celeste Stein Therapeutic Compression Socks, 1st Kiss, 8-15 mmhg, .6 Ounce
texts: Great socks for travel! My feet didn't hardly ouff up despite a long overnight flight to England from the U.S. The socks are comfortable and pretty too. They washed well and dried quickly.
These are dress socks, or rather panty hose. There is no compression. By the second wear, they were falling down to my ankles. I paid way too much for these.
These r horrible! I have been a nurse for 18 years and I've had a lot of support stockings. These will not stay up. I found myself constantly pulling them up. Will not be wearing these again.

These don't fit most ad described. I purchased for my Mom who needed low compression. We couldn't get them over her ankles without pain. I normally wear medium size and these rolled down on me. Only purchase if you have very small calves, they look like they are for a child and very thin. I will never purchase this brand again.

Was looking for affordable compression socks for my grandma. The pair I bought at our local pharmacy cost $39.99. I decided to give these a try. I bought several pairs. They’re comfortable to wear all day. The only con is the top band which is non compression slides down. This makes you to readjust the socks. Folding that band down seems to be a solution. My grandma has not complained. She seems to like it. According to her they feel like regular knee hi stockings. I recommend these for the price.
Made for a child! Man am I aggravated. Glad I had the foresight to order others which were not support but at least fit the length of my adult American leg.

Very tight, constricting and binding knee hi socks. Didn't work for a tiny, petite woman and probably won't work for most. However, for an average person (without moderate/severe leg problems) who likes a fashionable sock option this might be a good choice.
Loved the patterns, but they don't offer much support and would slide around in my shoes and rotate around my foot; I was constantly trying to align the seams all day.

topic: Power Swabs Teeth Whitening Kit | Easy 7 Day Treatment for Whiter Teeth | Dentist Formulated Whitener and Stain Remover
texts: I got excited by a tv commericial for this product so much so that I went straight to Amazon and ordered it BUT didn't read the reviews, shame on me. I just don't see much difference and I so wanted it to work. My teeth are not stained just the yellow from coffee drinking. I think that because you have to apply the product tooth by tooh and rub with the included 'swab' for a bit per the instructions, the teeth get 'cleaner' and shinier, BUT NOT WHITER! Don't waste your money.
I was skeptical at first but then it worked, it’s easy to follow instructions, it has a nice taste and it’s not shocking like most whiteners. This is the best one yet thumbs up to Power swabs.
Really disappointed. Saw this on TV and bought from Amazon. My teeth do not need a lot of whitening. I see no difference and was sloppy and not easy to use. BIG time buyers remorse. Expensive.

So far I’ve lost 3 of the whitening swabs and then I got pissed and gave up. I was unable to snap and break a swab out. It worked with the first one yesterday with no issues. Threw them in the garbage. Never buying them again.

I read all of these Reviews. I have not found anyone with crowns to have posted a review. So I have pause, especially when it states results vary. It either works or it doesn't. Why would results vary if it works on all types?

What a waste of time and money. This product did nothing to whiten my teeth. The only thing it did was irritate my gums. You’re better off getting Crest White Strips! If I could give it less than 1 star I would.

I am now on day 4 and there has been no results at all. In addition the swab is practically impossible to remove from its case. I follow directions and pinch the tube and even watched a video on exactly how to extract the swab. Not good. This may be defective and I am requesting a refund

Bought these for my husband who has had his teeth whitened by the dentist and now has trays he has to sleep in occasionally for maintenance. He said this is much easier, not messy at all and no sensitivity. Looks good too. If it lasts fo a decent amount of time he will be tossing the trays!

topic: O-Cedar Professional Heavy Duty Deck Scrubber
texts: The brush is only a row of bristles around the outside.. not a complete brush head. The part that connects the handle to the brush is a CHEAP, flimsy piece of narrow plastic that is so sub-standard it's not even funny! I'm just waiting for it to break any minute now. If it was worth it, I'd return this cheap piece of crud. DO NOT waste your money on this!!!

I disliked this product because it was much less than I expected! The center of the brush was missing and what was left was uncontrollable! Impossible to move the brush back and forth to scrub! A very disappointing purchase indeed!!!

I have been looking for this for a long time, who knew I would find it on Amazon. I use it to scrub the tile in my shower. Makes cleaning a snap with little to no bending or stretching for low or high places.

This product is useless. The brush head does not stay put and therefore renders the ability to scrub useless. I bought it to scrub up tar mastic and it did little to scrub at all. You can also purchase it for half the price at your local hardware store. Don't waste your time or money.

This item is a total joke. With every push the whole head of the brush flipped over - CRAZY!!! Then the whole connect point fell apart without it even being used. O-Cedar should be ashamed for selling any item this totally, worthless designed.

Terribly unpractical, this is pretty much unusable if you need to exercise some pressure as the rotating head would work against you. The brush is firm but also very sparse. If only I had read more carefully (and believed) the other reviews, wold have never purchased this: it is a total waste of money and I had to revert to another bursh to clean my deck.
I like the brush but not happy when the head flips because I'm brushing too fast or rigorous. I wouldn't allow my husband to use it because I know he'll break the brush off of the swivel.

What a piece of junk. How the hell are you suppose to scrub when the brush flips upside down everytime? What a complete waste of money. I might as well have taken $20 and burned it in a fire. I'd rather poke my eyeball out with a dirty needle than buy this brush. Heavy duty? Yeah. That's a joke!

topic: Magnifeko Brush Straightener Hair Straightening Styling Detangling Comb for Natural Silky Hair
texts: First time using this I have very coarse hair due to it being curly. I had tried another brush straightener however found myself going over my hair more than once then using a flat iron to finish it off. So I decided up try this one due to reviews. It was faster to do my hair heated up in 3 secs. Eliminating the flat iron completely. However I definitely recommend a heating glove due to the handle getting really hot. Overall working great.🙂
The item sucks. My Walmart cheap flat iron does a better job. I read all those positive reviews and fell for the item. Used it and my hair was freezy.
Never worked properly. Company refunded and didn't even want me to return it. They must have been having a lot of issues with it. DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY!

I would give this no stars if i could. when i first got this it shut off on me and i was baffled as to why. they it progressively got worse with the shutting off and now it won't even stay on for a minute the cord seems to be the problem. BEWARE before the purchase.
I purchased this in June 2016. I've used it probably 6 times. Yesterday it stopped working. Won't even turn on. I will say it worked great the times I used it but I wouldn't advise on purchasing it.

I didn't feel like spending $200 to replace my broken Chi straightening iron. This works pretty darn good! Not the magical fix all that they claim, but definitely a great tool. I have fine, color treated hair, and find that this smooths my hair out so it looks straight and professional. A quick fix!

This can not be used on shorter hair. I have a short bob. I cant get enough hair on the brush when brushing under and also if I try to use the to flip the hair under it burns my hand. This was bought through the recommendation of a friend with shoulder length hair. She loves it and her hair looks very nice but this is not for short hair

I was amazed the first few times I used this product. Unfortunately, after less than a month of use, it has started to be less efficient and the little balls on the end of the bristles are breaking. Also, it is very difficult to get the brush to power on and off at times.

topic: Lifemall Unisex Furry Heated Warm Slippers with USB Port, Electric Heating Cotton Shoes (Brown)
texts: Great transaction, Item came quickly but it doe snot have the wall adaptor for the hmdi plug. I had to buy it separate so it not that great a deal.

The only way these heat up is if you are plugged into a computer or ps4 not into a outlet. The bottom of the shoe has no cushion and the fabric slids. My husband fell down the stairs in these because how bad they are. Also both of the shoes were not put together very good all the cotton has come out of both of them and they were only worn 4 times. Honestly I do not recommend this to anyone not worth the amount they charge if mine hadn't been thrown away I would have requested a refund.

T[[ASIN:B01M7X9C15 Lifemall Unisex Furry Heated Warm Slippers with USB port, Electric Heating Cotton Shoes (Brown)] ]he slippers are comfy and warm. However the warmers stopped working on the 7th day of use.

Nice while they lasted. Alas when I disconnected them to go the the restroom, one of the wires sticking out of the slipper caught on the door, tripped me and ripped the wire off the heating pad. So now I can only heat one foot at a time. Kinda of defeats the purpose and I don't see anywhere on Amazon a replacement pad can be purchased. Oh well. They really should make the heating pads available for replacement. I can't be the only one this has happened too.

Got them in December 2016. They immediately tore at the seam. We sewed them. After a few uses the cord quit working after being handled with care, not even walked in. The cord is too short. Folks these are cheaply made, cheap materials and a weak cheap cord. It's a good idea. I'm mad that I paid more than $19.99! Save your money, it's a rip-off!

Not very warm, seams in both slippers torn apart on the inside on the day they were delivered. Not big enough for men's feet. Bought as a gift and had to return because of the poor quality. On the bright side, very easy return! Thanks amazon.

Be aware that these are shipped from China. They draw 1.9 amps, so if you are going to use a power adapter get at least a 2.4 amp. I did not realize this and literally burned up a 1 amp adapter. They are very soft & warn. Construction is not the best but OK. They say it will fit up to US size 11 and they mean it. I have a size 11 and there is not any extra room.

Default wiring!!!! Bought these as a Christmas Present for my sister and the heating mechanism caught on fire while she was wearing them!!! I wanted her feet to be warm, but not that warm. If you prefer not to have synthetic fabric melted to your socks (or feet), this product is not for you. Buyer beware.

topic: VENOFYE Viperlift Bio Syringe 0.39 oz / 11 g
texts: I, like others, was stopped in a mall and given a very artful sales pitch. It looked good in the store, but was way too expensive, so we left without buying. Minutes after leaving the store, I touched the area where the product had been applied. It was rough and dry. I not only think this wouldn’t work, I think it must actually be bad for your skin. After removal, the skin around my eye was puffier than it had been before. Not good.
I bought this in Mexico for $200. They started out with $900.I love the tighning of it.They get you after a few drinks getting back on cruise .I won’t buy again

I purchased my Venofye while on vacation in Alaska. It cracks as soon as it dries. Not sure why someone would state that it goes on at night, doesn't say that in the directions. I emailed Venofye directly a couple of weeks ago, no response, not surprised.
I was stopped in the mall by someone selling this . My three grandsons all that were skeptical as was I . I bought the product because it blew us all away!

I have dark circles and bags under my eyes and this product works well for me! It really does smooth the puffiness out and lightens up the darkness. My eyes always look tired but this brightens up the entire under-eye area. I recommend you try it!

All the Venofye products are a scam. I fell for the scam while on vacation at a resort and got fleeced. No results, no possibility of refunds. In fact, several of the products are downright toxic (this one particularly) and might make you break out in hives. Don’t fall for this.

Bought in a mall in Portland. Looked great but did the obvious bait and switch. Said it was $400 and when I said "NO way." It was suddenly $125. Again no and then went to $100. Put it on and it cracks. Looks like I have varnish on my face with crackle like old varnish. What a r ip off.

This is a scam sold all over - malls, cruises, vacation spots etc. ettc. The demo they do to you is incredible. Really incredible. Then they sell you one to take home and it does not work AT ALL. Bait and switch! Read BBB reports on this scam. If you do encounter one of these demos, INSIST that they give you the syringe they actually applied it from.

topic: Do Vitamins VitaBeard - Beard Growth Supplement for Men, Daily Multivitamin Facial Hair Growth for Men, Sheen & Shine, Improve
texts: Complete bull of a product. It only really provides vitamins that supposedly keep your beard healthy but if you expect this to make it grow faster or fuller, not going to happen. It all comes down to genetics. No product can help overcome that.

These pills are junk. Do your research, look at the ingredients and go buy some Now supplements instead. For the price they charge you can get 3 bottles of Now supplements(an extremely well respected brand) for less that do the same thing. I recommend Now B-100 Sustained Release, and pair that with another and you'll get the same results if not better.
My personal opinion is that this is an overpriced vitamin and users would have better luck with a deep exfoliation of the skin on their face to encourage the opening up of pores.

I have been using this product for almost 30 days now and i have noticed a significant growth increase compared to without. It seems as it almost doubled my growth rate compared to not taking Vitabeard. Going to order another bottle at the end of the month! Great product!!

Didn't notice any changes. Made me sick a couple of days. At the end of a month, my blood work was all wacky at my yearly physical with my MD. not really 100% it was these supplements, but I quit them anyway. Not sure about this stuff, maybe it works for some people.

I finished using the first bottle with no drastic results (but I did not use 3 pills a day as directed). How ever I switched to Beard Grow XL which seem to be working for me. Vita beard did give me upset stomach. Probably its not work me. But may work for you! Good luck
Wooow nice vitamin my beard grow and become thick than before itry so many vitamin but vitabeard is No 1 of great result and it come in saftey package , thank you soo much '

Seems like a good product but I honestly couldn't tell if it helped that much. You can either grow a beard or not. I do know for sure that the product is causing me to have acne breakouts on my face. I have stopped taking the pills two different times to see if my acne would clear up and within 3-4 days of no pills it did. I am getting compliments on my beard so I'm going to just quit taking the Vitabeard so I can maintain clear skin....a refund would be nice.

topic: FEIFEIER Firefly Trendy Waterproof Lotus Shape Solar Floating LED Lamp Color Changing Flower Night Lamp Pond Garden Lights Fancy Ideal
texts: THIS WAS A JOKE. TRIED EVERYTHING TO GET UNIT TO WORK. INSTRUCTIONS CAME IN CHINESE. TRIED TO GET AUTHORIZATION TO SEND IT BACK OR GET INSTRUCTIONS IN ENGLISH. NOTHING HAPPENED. GOT SO FRUSTRATED THAT I FINALLY THREW IT IN THE TRASH . DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY ON THIS ITEM.
Its adorable, but ours broke in the first week. lol. I think because there is a GIANT tree directly above it dropped crap all over it. Its really cute though!!!
Looks very cheap and artificial. Instructions are in German or some other language. I had to look at the item description to figure out how it works. A waste of money.
super tacky and ugly during the day and the plastic compartment w the bulb totally filled w water. i even added tape to snug the top down after screwing it on, still leaks.
They came very frazzled because of being put in too small of a box. Only two are working now, and all 4 of them are in the sun all day.

This solar flower is a nice concept, had it been of better quality, I would have given it more stars. The center with the solar panel always listed to one side, never sat straight. The colors are pretty, but it only lasted about a month, then, no more light. It is ugly in the day light, and it has a lead weight that hangs on fishing line underneath it for ballast. The weight rusted badly, as it should have been coated it plastic, and was not. I do not recommend wasting money on this light. Mine is in the trash.
I really like how it lights up...very pretty. I find the center plastic part fills with water if you don't get it connected tightly. Nice addition to my garden pond.

It is unattractive and cheap looking. Look carefully at photos of it unlit. Also be sure you understand that you are getting only 1 - despite pictures of 4. I am giving mine to goodwill as I cannot return it.

topic: Verilux Original Natural Spectrum Deluxe Floor Lamp, Ivory
texts: I really like these lamps - have had two (in black) for a couple years and was really looking forward to getting this one. It was shipped in the manufacturer's box, which looked like it had been open. Unpacked, assembled, and ... IT DIDN'T WORK. The bulb was good (tested in another Verilux lamp). Disassembled the lamp and did some quick troubleshooting - apparently the wires that lead from the base to the lamp itself were damaged, leaving me wondering if this wasn't a floor demo. I still want one, but am very leery of ordering from Amazon marketplace.

I purchased this for my wife as she previously had two similar but cheaper reading lamps. She uses this for her jewelry hobby and reading. Similar lights were cheaply constructed and did not hold up. This is much better built with a slightly higher stance and more flexible neck and solid pole. It was very easily assembled with two screws. It appears it will survive much longer than the prior lamps.

I ordered this lamp to replace one that I had for nine years. The old one quit working just a few days ago so I was very excited to replace it with this new one. After just a few days the light no longer works. I took the bulb out and put it back in and it turned on for a few minutes before going out again.. Bummers!

I bought 2 of this lamp about two years ago. We use them only when we play the table game of mah-jong...twice a week. One lamp is not bright enough to light up a table, so we had to use 2 lamps. Over the two years, both light bulbs needs to be replace at close to $20 per light bulb! The bulb is rated for 10,000 hours, but by my calculation, we had use the lamps at most 2,000 hours in the two years. What a rip off for a $20 light bulb! I would not recommend anyone to buy a Verilux lamp with such an expensive replacement bulb.

I own 3 of these and am about to order a 4th. Everything seems brighter and clearer when reading with this lamp. The swivel head allows you to adjust the light to hit the page just right. I don't know what everyone is saying negative about the bulbs and never working, etc. I've never had any trouble with any of my 3 lamps. The oldest one is about 12 years old. I've only had to replace the bulb once. Very long lasting bulbs. I don't find the lack of height adjustment a problem at all since the head has an adjustable neck. Not the best looking lamp around but not terrible either. Very functional.

[[ASIN:B000F97B5I Verilux Original Natural Spectrum Deluxe Floor Lamp,Ivory]] Not at all as advertised. Light poor. Need table lamp also to be able to read by.I wanted a reading floor lamp this is not what I need.

The bulbs don't last- 6 months on my first one. The new bulbs are $20, and you have to buy Verilux bulbs, unless you want to modify the base of other bulbs. They state 10,000 hour average life for the bulb. Read other reviews and see how likely that is.
A good reading floor lamp - while it WORKS! But finding a place to fix it - in Los Angeles - when it simply refuses to light - even with a new "bulb"? No luck so far. Robert

topic: Hion Anti- Motion Sickness Smart Glasses, Ultra-Light Portable Nausea Relief Glasses, Raised Airsick Sickness Seasickness Glasses for Sport Travel Gaming,
texts: These are for the size of a little kid. They dont' fit my face at all. they buckle at the nose, cause they are too small. Horrible. Unfortunately, I didn't realize they can't be returned either. So I am out money now too. Do not recommend

These were so poorly designed. The sides do not bend and therefore can’t be adjusted to fit properly. It’s also really uncomfortable. I tried to return it within the week of purchase but it said not eligible for returns. Do not buy based on quality and return policy.

I don’t know if I got a faulty pair but they do not fit on my face. The nose bevel is SO small, they are very crooked and the plastic is bent the wrong way. Waste of money unless you get a pair that actually fits. No idea if they actually work for motion sickness or not.
Received the glasses and they were cracked. The blue liquid leaked out everywhere it was a mess and I had to throw it out. I would like to receive a refund.

These worked tremendously!! Hion Anti Motion Sickness Glasses allowed me to read during a 12 hour car ride and I never felt any motion sickness!! Sure, they're a little goofy looking; but they helped me finish a whole book on the trip!! My husband loves to drive and we're always in the car for at least an hour or two or more on the weekends. Now I can get some quality reading in. And my son has started complaining of feeling bad when he's trying to play his Nintendo Switch in the car so I'll let you know if they work for him too.

I purchased 2 pairs, one for myself and one for my 7 year old. As you can see from the picture, they are extremely bent and are too small for even a child’s face. Because they are so bent, they are painful to wear, especially on the nose. Both pairs I ordered are like this. It’s also ridiculous how cheap they are. They don’t even have hinges like a normal pair of glasses, they are just one big piece of plastic. These are also not returnable, so save yourself the trouble and get something else for your motion sickness needs.
They are silly looking but I've never been able to be a passenger in a car without getting sick and now I can even read in the backseat and feel great. They are just a little tight on my nose

I’ve heard great things about motion sickness glasses so it was very disappointing that these didn’t end up helping me. The glasses arrived with one of the rings missing. They’re not very comfortable and sit weird on your face. They sort of bow out. The ring with liquid isn’t very visible because the white frames cover so much of it. If the frames were sturdy like normal glasses frames and covered up less of the blue liquid ring, I think it would be more likely to work for me.

topic: HoMedics Foot Salon Pro Footbath with Heat Boost Power | Massaging Vibration, 4 Pedicure Spa Attachments, Splash Guard | Soothe
texts: I love this foot massage. After playing basketball I come home and let my feet soak. The best part about this little machine is that it keeps the water hot. It is worth every penny.

This product is very poorly designed and is very cheap in construction. It worked for about five minutes and then died. I returned the item and had another shipped to me. The same exact malfunction happened again. If this product actually worked and was reliable then it would be worth buying, however, with my experience I would not recommend this product to anyone.

This is a great unit. This is the second one that I've owned and even though the instructions say to not use oils or Epsom salts, I've used both and my first unit lasted me for 5 years so I have absolutely no complaints whatsoever
The piece on top kept falling off. The rollers on bottom would get stuck. The bubbles production were very good. Only used about a dozen times and then threw away because did not like.

This thing is horrible. The bottom surface is very hard and lumpy. Its like walking in the driveway and stepping on rocks. Yuck. It has hard plastic rollers that feel awful. I took them off but there is hard plastic posts left. Bad design.

I purchased this product for my wife. I gave it to her for her birthday, unfortunately she was very dissatisfied with the product. The water does not heat in a timely manner and the water circulation is very low. The entire product is cheaply made, the foot attachments do not stay mounted to the centerpiece to be used. I have purchased many Homedics in the past and have been very satisfied with the product. This particular product is a wash......
This has rollers in the bottom that are painful for tender feet. Starting with warm water, the water does stay warm. I don't recommend it for diabetics or those with impaired circulation.

Had it (2) months, work nice, then it just quit working. No power! 30 day warranty. Homedics really are proud of their products for 30 days, then they don't give a crap! No Returns! $60 bucks down the drain!

topic: Cupping - 24 Piece Suction Cup Massage Therapy Set
texts: I love cupping- I do it almost everyday at home to help with refered nerve pain that I have from an old injury. Cupping works! The quality of the cups seems to be a bit cheap- the suction regulators are plastic and can fall out, but they are easy to put back in. With everyday use I will be satisfied if I get a years use out of them- and for the price that is reasonable. But hey, maybe they will last longer :)

of all 24 cups in the package one was able to attain suction. I used it 3 times and even that one died. A complete waste of money, particularly since I didn't need the cups until over a month after ordering and by that time the return window had expired. I'm appalled!

pay the extra for a true kangzue cupping set. I am a Certified cupping therapist and this was the first set I used when I was just learning well I learned my lesson. the plastic that these cups are made out of is not durable and cracks after a couple uses which makes them unusable as they then no longer hold suction. I would also recommend the rubber or silicone cups you can buy off amazon for anyone who is just learning or experimenting with cupping much more user and beginner friendly.

When I got this there was no connector tube. Which I absolutely need to have. I'm not very pleased as it shows a tube, and includes a tube in the description. It even comes with instructions on how to connect the tube that was not included.
I liked it at first but I bruised and obtained water blisters after removing one cup. I used it on my family members as well but they said it was too painful for them.

I do professional cupping with my massage therapist and wanted to try it at home. Make sure to use moisturizer and don't leave on too long (no more than 10 minutes). I think it works great. It's a good starter kit. It's difficult to use on yourself on your back even with the extension. The cups feel a bit cheap and one has already cracked.

Really cheaply made, but what can I expect for the price. They don't hold the suction very long and most of them have a sharp barb of plastic on the lip of the cup that I am assuming is left on from the molding process when they are formed. I normally use a different brand but wanted to venture out to try something new. Big mistake.

I like the variety of sizes and the packaging. What I don't like are the small pieces that easily pop off the cups. When I washed the cups prior to use, about 75% of the plugs came out. When using the cups, we had the same issue. The cups are low quality, even for the price.

topic: Wonder Wafers Air Fresheners 50ct. Individually Wrapped, Nu Car Fragrance
texts: works great...now I don't have to go to car wash to get that fresh smell that I want in my truck. no more clip on air fresheners that block the flow of ac.

Stay away.... The waffers were dried out with no scent. I’ve used wonder waffers for years and these don’t appear to be them. Way bigger square than what I use to get and paper thin. The ones I received were dried out and had no scent to them. Put 8 of them in my car and couldn’t smell any scent at all. Old product that should have never been packaged snd shipped out. I requested a return label and refund.
I have had these put in the car when I get it professionally cleaned and they make the car smell great for days but the ones I bought here did not last at all....a few hours at most.
I was so excited to get these but so disappointed once they arrived. Can't even smell them. They're no where near the ones used at the full/service car wash that I go to. Boo

It has not "smelled" of new vehicle....will see if it does tomorrow...but I doubt it. Had gotten some before, that were shaped in circle or disk, and thicker, but did not see any on amazon, sorry we bought them, as we had used the disk ones before and they were GREAT!

This product smelled more like a Nevada Brothel than just an air type freshener. It smells nothing like a new car and just one wafer burns your nose! The only reason I didn't return them is because I'm having too much fun putting this in some employee offices and watching their reactions. Don't waste your time with this product. The "leather" fragrance is much better.
Its super strong. Woorks great. I had to put it in the back seat cause its too strong to have in yout face. It keeps the car smelling like new. I love it!

These are a waste of money. Does not smell like any new car scent I've used. Unless your new car had a perfume sickening smell. Good and bad news is that they don't last long as the scent is gone in a day or two.

topic: 70% DMSO - Pharmaceutical Grade ingredients | Dimethyl sulfoxide Liquid 3.4 Oz - 100 ml | High Purity | Low
texts: I am Gobsmacked! Honestly, where has this stuff been? Instant relief from arthritis and bursitis pain in my hip. Instant relief from Morton Neuroma pain in my foot. Instant relief from Tennis elbow. Amazing! Absolutely amazing! If there is any drawback at all, it would be the garlic taste. But, I am regulating just how much of the DMSO is necessary for the pain relief and with less, comes less garlic taste. And I should mention, there was some itching with the first application but none again, or at least not enough to really notice.

The product description says Pharmaceutical Grade DMSO, implying that it is for medical use. However, the first sentence under directions on the label is, "This product is intended for use as a solvent only." it goes on to say that it can irritate the skin.

Had great hopes after reading all the hype. Applied to painful arthritic hands, knees and wrists and got no notable pain relief. Maybe an inferior DMSO. No garlic taste, no pain relief. This stuff was supposed to freeze at 64 degrees or so. Put it in the fridge for half hour at 40 degrees and still liquid. Has been in the freezer at zero degrees for another half hour and still liquid. Anti-freeze?

I bought this product to treat a bursa. It has done nothing to alleviate the situation. It states that it may be irritating to the skin, you may get a garlicky taste or smell, etc. I feel no warmth when it is applied, no irritation to my skin, nothing. I’m not saying that it is, but, it seems like all that it is, is water in a bottle.

DMSO is a carrier product, to be applied on clean skin away from cut sores and only to be used externally. Apply a little with sterile cotton, let dry and apply I.e. Icy hot or pain medicine, may give a licorice taste in mouth. This should only used for severe pain, check with your health care provider.

What I dislike is there are no good instructions or directions on how to use the product external or internally,so I have no idea on how the product taste.To say the product is intended to use as a solvent ONLY is a very broad statement. I'm not pleased,and so with no knowledge how to use it, means it's a total waste of my money. The only thing understood on the label is the Warning signs. To either get good directions, or simply get my money back would be the only other good thing to achieve from this ordeal.

I was looking forward to getting this. It is advertised as pharmaceutical grade. When you receive it the bottle doesn’t indicate pharmaceutical, it specially says solvent use only which means industrial not pharmaceutical bodily use. Very disappointed in that! It was also leaking with seal broken when I received the shipment with half of the liquid leaked out in package. Reached out to seller with no response! Money lost!

Although this brace looks like it would be a decent one for wrist stabilization, it will not work on someone with larger forearms (see the photo). It is uncomfortably tight at furthest extension. I have a 7.5 inch wrist, 8.5 inch palm, and bought a medium accordingly. My forearm where the brace ends is 10 inches. Why are the braces sized at the wrist when that isn't where the straps tighten??

topic: Wahl Professional Massager, 3 Therapy Attachment Heads, Powerful, Lightweight and Quiet for Professional Barbers and Stylists - Model 4120-1701
texts: I have owned Wahl massagers for the last 30 years, and this new model sucks! The message attachments do not stay on. Wahl was always the best in this category, and now they are the worst! Why buy something that you can’t use? Very unhappy.

I have used several Wahl vibrators and no problem but this one is crap I have a small battery vibrator that does more than this one I guess the quiet means you do not get much vibration and used it 5 minutes on my knee put it back in box to return only to find out you can not return it.

I've been using Wahl massagers for the past 20+ years or so, and was looking to replace the 4120-1 model I bought about 10 years ago... apparently the newer version of that was the 4120-600 which was HORRIBLE and super weak. I was disappointed and thought Wahl products were going downhill! But then I saw this 4120-1701 model... voila! It was the same as my previous massager in size and strength. Very happy I found this because I thought maybe they didnt have the same massagers I used to use!

Vibes seem slightly less than previous model. Made very well. Long cord is a bonus. Has a more robust connection at cord to unit. With previous purchases the cord wears and frays quickly. Attachments (attach) well and don't slip off. Good product!
This is the only item I have purchased from Amazon which completely disappointed me. It says "Professional Massager" yet is so weak my wife can hardly feel it when I massager her back.

Purchased two from seller "Avalanche Brands" both came in tape closed boxes. Returned one immediately for making loud noise when applying only light pressure, kept the second one for a month (too late to return), then it too began making the same loud noise with very little pressure applied. I've owned several Wahl Professional Massager #4120-1701 models over the years, they usually last for years before wearing out and making the loud noise I'm referring to. Both of these seemed liked used vibrators.

This product is not nearly as powerful as previous models. Wish companies would start leaving things alone. The attachments are only as good if the massager has a good strong vibration, which this one does not. I gave it a two because its good for legs but pretty much nothing else.

We've had Wahl body massagers before. They were powerful and very long lasting, though a little noisy. I don't know if they've always been made in China, but these new ones are and the vibration was so weak, we returned it.

topic: Arctic Blast Pain Relieving Drops with DMSO Increases Local Blood Circulation, 1 fl oz
texts: Unfortunately, this product did not help me as much as I had hoped. It actually made almost no difference at all. I had had real DSMO from my horse and have tried it in the past and didn’t feel anything, but was hoping this human grade level might do better. Maybe it works for some people better than others.
gave no relief what so ever. How do I send this back? I was so in hopes it worked that I bought a bunch. Now don't know what to do with it.

Arctic Blast pain drops is the same thing as DMSO. It has been around for many years. It was prescribed for me when I was diagnosed with rheumatoid arthritis over forty years ago. In the old days, there were limited drugs that were effective for this type of arthritis. This product makes you have extreme garlic breath, and lasts a long time. It gives a warm sensation but really did very little for my pain. They are in essence selling this as a new product for miracle relief. In my opinion it does little for pain and causes extreme bad breath.

I wonder about Gerald's review - "causes garlic breath?" You're not supposed to drink the stuff for crying out loud! It's a topical liquid you rub on your skin that smells domwhat like mentol from what is seems. I recomend you brush your teeth and don't drink this anymore :-)

The Arctic Blast ointment was a disappointment for me and was very over priced. I have purchased other ointments for pain that were much less expensive and did a better job of helping with pain, such as Biofreeze.

This product doesn’t work like it says it will. I have severe back pain, leg pain from sciatica, and a compressed back and neck. I hoped this would give me a little bit of relief, I wasn’t crazy enough to think that it would cure me, but I did think that it would give me a little relief. It gave me none. I don’t recommend.
Does not work at all I applied to 3 different pains it never even tingled like it was going to work.I think it is a bottle of menthol oil. I wrote,to get a refund

Surprised on the don't work reviews. I have horrible arthritis in my hands, knees and back. Certainly don't relieve for 8 hours like it says, but starts working for me in about 10 minutes and lasts for a couple hours. I'm a musician, hands get real bad and it helps me get through the performance. The smell is quite powerful though. I've tried just about everything and for some temporary relief, it works good for me:)

topic: GOBUDi Lanyard Necklace Leash Compatible with VUSE Vibe and VUSE Alto (Black)
texts: I purchased the lanyard for something other than a e-cig, thinking it would fit perfectly. Well I was right! The smaller size rubber ring fits just right! I absolutely LOVE it!
Broke in first day! Not durable at all! Asked for replacement and as soon as I got it it broke as well. Great idea but clasp is garbage. Now they are making me pay for two! Ugh

If it fit ( value for money is wort it, ) & FYI …. I bought 2 of yours & 2 from another retailer, they were to big as well, and they didn’t fit either, I don’t drive so I’m stuck with them, but all in all there both good products, just know the size you need, I don’t know what size I have, just small 👍👍

All 3 sizes provided didn’t work well for the pen I have. The middle size worked ok but the pen kept turning upside down. If it were tighter I believe it wouldn’t tip over and stay upright. Otherwise good length for it hang.

Lanyard broke on the first day of having it. The strap pulled out of the closure that attaches the smaller string for the clip. The rings work great though, and fit on a standard keyring, and the lanyard seems to have been stabilized with a couple of simple knots. If you have a Vuse Alto, just save yourself the money and buy your own lanyard and some 13mm anti loss rings.

I absolutely love this product! It wraps around my neck and holds my booze vapor exactly right and doesn’t slip off at all! I am definitely pleased. I can also like hide it under my shirt and still know that it’s there so certain people don’t know that I have the Vape ha ha Thank you sincerely Michelle.

Right away the clasp was off. The hinged part didn't close all the way. Seemed bent or something. Then eventually broke maybe a week after I got it. So used a lanyard I already had. About a few days to a week later the loop it was connected to broke. So got about 2 weeks use of it at most. I wouldn't suggest purchasing unless you like to throw away money... I wasn't hard on it either. Never hung my vape pen from it. It was more to help me not lose the pen. I use a lanyard for my keys just as a way to help me keep track of them and make it harder to lose them.

I love this lanyard, but the clasp on it breaks almost immediately. I have bought this item multiple times and the clasp keeps breaking. Today was a new record. I just got it delivered today and the clasp is already broken.

topic: FRK Digital Body Weight Bathroom Scale, High accuracy with Tempered Glass Platform, Smart Step-on Technology, Batteries Included
texts: I've had this scale for a little over a month and so far so good on the batteries. The display is clear, easy to read and works every time. The numerical display of my weight is both large enough to read easily and bright enough to be easily seen. GREAT PRODUCT for the price! Economical AND functional!!!!

I am so disappointed in this scale. When it came i was delighted with the trim design, plus the fact that the reading comes up immediately with having to step on it first. After about 3 months I started getting weird readings, then it would read accurately. Now only weird readings or none at all. Very dissapointed.

The digital scale came in with 3 AAA batteries, made of mainly tempered glass and supported with four rubber feet underneath.
