You can change the unit of mass between kilogram and pound button located at the back of the scale. It is easy to use it turns on once you step on the scale and shuts down when not in use. I did compared it with the old weighing scale and it does give you accurate weight results. Design is modern and sleek, perfect for home use. Sample received at discount or no cost for an honest opinion. I'm not affiliated with the product and company. I received no compensation for my review.

Junk. The batteries last 2 to 4 days. After trying 3 different brands I junked it and bought the following item which is a thousand fold better. Eatsmart Precision Plus Digital Bathroom Scale with Ultra Wide Platform and Step-on Technology, 440-Pounds

First let me say the the scale looks good, works good and seems to be accurate. When I first received it eleven months ago it required battery (3 AAA) replacement after about six weeks. Each replacement came a little sooner until the latest (and last) required replacement after only four (4) days of once-a-day use. It is advertised with a two year satisfaction guaranteed or replacement or money back warranty. We will see about that.

Received this scale today & it does not work properly. I installed the batteries & placed on hardwood floor. Set the unit to lbs & every time I step in it I get an error message. I'm about 200lbs less than the weight limit which would cause the error message so that's not the issue. Plain & simple, it just does not work.
I doesn't say the same weight twice. You step on and get one reading then you give it a minute and try again and you get a whole different reading. Very upsetting.
It can't give the correct weight. I step on and it doesn't come on, I step off, I get a weight I try again and get a different weight. I should have returned it. And yes that's with new batteries.

topic: Apalus Hair Straightening Brush, Fast Natural Straight Hair Styling, Anion Hair Care, Anti Scald, Massage Straightening Irons, Detangling Hair Brush
texts: Surprisingly, this brush worked. I have Type 4 hair.. a mix between 4a,4b,4c. You have to comb and detangle your hair first!!! It will not work if you don't. I used it at 370 degrees and I have a nice blow out. It won get all the way to your roots, especially if you're afraid to get burned. It worked great on my hair and it made it silky and smooth.
I have wavy hair and dcouldnt even straighten those. I set it to the highest temp to get rid of two big waves in my hair. It doesnt work for me. Nice for detangling and combing.

This brush does a good job straightening my hair. However, today an electrical short occurred while I was straightening my hair. It scared me a bit when it went out and luckily, I was fine. I am disappointed in this product and I am not sure if I will replace it or find another product.
Arrived in good time, and appeared to be in good condition but will not turn on at all. Lights don't even turn on. Threw away the box so don't think i can return it!

I used it twice in February and not again until now, but now in April it no longer works. It just won't turn on! Plus this brush top is too large and it pulls hair a bit too anyway. My recommendation is to not buy this one... I heard FemJolie is better.

I was excited to try this, but was disappointed as soon as I plugged it in. I pressed the reset button like the instructions said, then the power button and nothing- I thought well it must be the plug- nope tried 4 plugs and I got nothing, it didn't light up or heat up. Needless to say I will be returning it! I wouldn't waste your money, seems like this has happened to a number of people.

Was so excited to try this out. I received it last now & went to use it this AM. It won't power on. I am sending it back & ordering one more. I will give it one more chance before I try a different product.

This is my first time buying a "heated brush". It is not a flat iron, but it works very well. My child is biracial and has a curly, but not kinky hair. This loosens and straightens just enough for us to avoid hairbrush fights in the morning. It doesn't take long to do her very long hair and she doesn't complain (she hates flat irons). It was worth trying...

topic: Electric Razor for Women, ISTON Rechargeable Wet and Dry Painless Womens Shaver Body Hair Remover for Legs Underarms and Bikini
texts: Super easy to use and I love it for a quick touch up. I just wish it would shave closer 😪. I definitely have to use a traditional razor to get a smooth shave

I used the razor two times before it broke. The first time I cleaned it after use it was a little hard to get the razor head off to clean it. After the second time I shaved with it, the entire shaver head came off. In the process it broke the two cheap plastic clips that hold the razor head on the shaver. The razor was easy to use and did a great shave. I really wish they had used something better that plastic to hold the head on the shaver. I have now thrown it in the trash and hope this review will keep someone else from buying this product.

I NEVER write reviews but I am sick and tried of people leaving reviews that they get some kind of gift for. This thing sucks so badly. $30 gone. It took 40 mins to cut my lady parts cause it does cut at all and I does have much to cut. DO NOT BUY THIS REAL TALK.

I think I'll recover but now have ptsd. This thing does more pulling of the hair than shaving. You have to go over area multiple times and it still doesn't get it all. I finally gave up. UPDATE: Now getting harassing emails from Seller asking me to remove my review and they will compensate. I've reported them to Amazon.
I expected more. This does not get the short hairs. I have to be pulling my skin really taunt to get a semi close shave. Works in water I shall give my that BUT my disposable does a better job.

Found this to be Poor at cutting the hair! Have to go over and over at different angles to get all the hair. Im older and thought not being able to nick myself would be a good thing...and that part is good, but the down side is ...I have to really work to remove all the hair. Also the on off button is right where your hand goes, so I’ve turned it off while using ...poor design.

Cut myself shaving with a razor, bleed profusely so I decided to go back to electric. Does a great job, easy to use on legs and underarms, charge lasts for weeks. Only complaint is that it's not that easy to remove the head to clean. These arthritic fingers can't get the head off, hubby has to do it. I like that it sits in it's charger to charge and can stay there when not in use.
Do not buy! Waste of money. Barely cut leg hair. Shaved regularly and 4 days later tried to use this for a touch up and didn’t even smooth my legs.

topic: Do Vitamins VitaBeard - Beard Growth Supplement for Men, Daily Multivitamin Facial Hair Growth for Men, Sheen & Shine, Improve
texts: Didn't see a difference after this bottle but I can't say that's surprising. The main issue is that these things STINK. they stink up my whole bathroom when i open them up and stink up my drawer when they're stored. Take after a meal to avoid throwing up or having an extremely sour stomach. these babies are potent

I fell for the whole " its amazing for your beard" stuff, surprise, I didn't experience anything out of the ordinary. So as vitamins go, I guess they are ok. As manly whisker building pills, meh ....just go get a quality vitamin elsewhere.

Might be just me but I bough these with the intention of growing a beard. Sadly, they did not work. Goes to show that even with some help, nothing except your genes decides what happens with your body.

i know its my fault for buying them. but shortly after using the produce i notices at night time these clear white bumps on my arms after a month or so my scalp started to itch like crazy for 4 months got worse finally i went to a dermatologist and they told me i had Folliculitis from taken these pills so just a warning to anyone looking to purchase this.

But by far the worst smelling vitamin i have ever taken. My coworker says it smells like ground-up old people, so take that for whatever it is worth. It also just doesn't work for what it says it does, I have noticed very little if any growth in my beard and my skin is as dry as ever underneath. So keep your money this is just another snake oil on the corner

I got this for my boyfriend, who is trying to grow a beard, he has some spots where no hair grows. These vitamins seem to helping immensely. He is satisfied with progress, as am I. He doesn't have a full on beard yet after using it for a month (Not extremely consistent), but the progress is acceptable, better than if he wasn't taking anything. He also is drinking more water, less soda, and has more protein in his diet now. Healthier diets equal healthier hair growth.

I have been taking these for 2 months now and have really noticed a lot more growth. I have gotten up in the morning and noticed a hair growth explosion on my face. I was like it wasn't that long when I went to bed! I plane on continuing to buy these every month.

Does it work? I don't think so. I went through an entire bottle and saw absolutely nothing different, though I'm not sure what I was expecting to happen. lol, I guess this is what happens when you shop on Amazon and drink Dalmore at the same time...

topic: TENS 7000 TENS Unit Pad Holder, Holds (4) 2" X 2" Or (2) 2” x 4” TENS Unit Replacement Pads
texts: I love the tens unit, it does what a great job on working my teens muscles. However, I am going broke with having to replace batteries every 2-3 days! I am using top shelf batteries to ensure longevity, I make sure the unit is turned off after each use. At this point I am going to have to return the unit due to the expenses of battery replacement. It would have been nice if it came with a charger to plug into the unit and not have to use the batteries.

I didn’t get the pads I ordered….the two cases are EMPTY!!!! And it’s telling me that this product is not eligible for return. How convenient. Im very upset. This is a total rip off. I want my money back.

This is a great product, that I never knew existed until I saw it. I often wear my TENS unit to bed and then have to get up to take it off. I can lay in bed and pull my patches off and put them right in this unit. So handy!

I thought that this item included the pads. IT DOES NOT INCLUDED THE PAD. Even though the pads are shown in the sales photo, it does state that these are TENS Unit Pad Holder. I should not have relied on the photos only. Now, I find out they are not returnable. That is unclear to me. They are just flat plastic container in which you can place your pads in between use. Why they are nonreturnable is a mystery to me. My sure you read the description thoroughly before purchasing. This is the first time that I have been dissatisfied with an Amazon transaction.

Bought 3 of these, they are already starting to split at the hinges where the plastic comes together. It appears this is a common issue. Overpriced for what they are. They will still serve the purpose even when split at the hinges. Really paying a premium for a fairly cheap item. If you purchase these plan on having the hinges break.

I have not found a design I like. These are OK. No defects and they are functional but they work best with smaller pads. Still looking for something that holds the cable and the pad -securely. These are the most reasonably priced that I have found.

The holder DOES NOT COME WITH PADS. The image above may appear to be false advertising for some, it even fools the amazon algorithm and when writing review it asks me to score the pain relief and adhesion categories of this product (meaning it believe it is pads as well), which it is not. The holder itself also does not hold 4 pads and only about 2 max. And the build quality is poor.

It works great for its purpose. Perhaps it should be made as two pieces that fit together because as a "folding tray", it FAILS. After opening and closing twice, it began to split. After 6, it split apart. It does line back up and holds together for storage.

topic: Aunt Fannie’s Ant Spray for Indoor Use (6-Pack)
texts: I love this product but the product spilled out in transit and all I got was an empty bottle. Obviously, I was given a full refund, so I tried my luck again and reordered another bottle. Again, I received a bag filled with liquid and an empty bottle. Why is it so hard to ship this item without damaging it?? All I want is a bottle of this in my home so I can use it to get rid of ants.

Wasn’t a fan overall, kills them but that’s all isn’t really a deterrent at all and unless you spray them directly and as close as possible if you have a real ant problem don’t waste your money on this, try tea tree oil instead

Firstly, as other reviews state, the packaging doesn't hold up well to shipping. My first order was completely empty and sopping wet. The second was leaking, but useable. However, what makes this a truly one-star review, is that it turned my floors into a slippery, oily mess that was nearly impossible to clean no matter how many times I mopped it. I don't even know how effective this is on ants, but the effort and mess are absolutely not worth it.
It arrived in a soaking wet box. Upon opening, more than half of the bottle had spilled out because of a loose spray cap. So far, not a good value. I'll follow up with a further product review later.

This works! We live in an area where people kind of accept that ants will be a problem at a certain time of year. We spray this when we see them and then they’re gone! We also spray around our backdoor that leads to the kitchen. The scent is strong but of cloves and pleasant.

I want a refund! But I cannot return the item. It was liquid, and bottle was empty. Leaked out. The box was totally saturated. Your email said I’d get a refund as soon as you get the item returned. What do I do? I want the item replaced

My Aunt Fannie bottle was received today.. it was in s plastic bag but the top was not on tight snd it leaked It leaked so much that it went through the plastic bag snd was all over the box. This was very upsetting as it was in a box with other item and some were food. I am very disgusted that this happened and upset

So this is a oil base product which means when I sprayed in by my door I almost fell cause it makes the doorways slippery to bad I didn’t know this until after I sprayed all my entry ways of which I have 4. I have kids which is why I went the natural way of things and my you get two both slip and fell going out the patio door it also left a stain on my wall because again oil base I will not be reordering this.

I was looking between this balance beam in another. This is such crappy material. You might as well buy a large pool noodle and cut it in half. I definitely should’ve gone with the $10 more balance beam that appeared to be a softer plastic.
This is definitely not what I thought it would be! The kids have already taken chunks out of the edges by simply using it. It literally looks like pool noodle cut in half.

Bought it for my son for physical therapy at home. It's ok. If you could find an extra thick pool noodle and split it in half lengthwise, you'd have this balance beam. It flattens out as you use it but kinda springs back up afterwards. Says weight limit is 300, I think, which seems legit after testing it with my husband and son on it.
Not at all what the picture made it look like. I was disappointed when I realized I paid $30 for something made out of pool noodle material. I am going to return it.
Very cheap product, doesn't holdup to repeated use, little chunks come out quite easily. Wish I had gotten a balance beam made from a different material than foam, this one won't last long.

Like everyone else said, this is basically a pool noodle...but worse because it disintegrates. I opened it up and blue foam went everywhere...and every time they stepped on it...more blue foam. I spent a long time cleaning my house after 10 minutes of play. This thing is not just lightweight, it;s basically no weight so it doesn't lay flat on the ground. The only reason it is 2 stars instead of 1, is that for the 10 minutes I let them play with it before I put it back to be returned, they were having fun. Just spend the money for something better.
I'd give negative stars if I could. Half a pool noodle but worse! It's disintegrating and we JUST opened it. I wouldn't pay a dollar for this let alone this full price.
Very cheap material and powder like stuff come off and gets really messy. I threw it away after a couple of days of use.. I would pay a little bit more to get a better one..

topic: Broom and Dustpan Set, Dust pan and Broom Combo, Premium Long Handle Broom with Dust Pan and Standing Upright Broom
texts: I moved into my new apt and received this broom and dustpan. When I removed them item from the box I noticed the dustpan had a huge crack in it. Very disappointed! I just threw it away.

Not even a month into purchasing this set... the plastic connecting points that connect the brooms have broken... and of course it happened outside of my return window and can't return it... DON'T BUY... WASTE OF MONEY
I really love this broom and dust pan set, It has a long handle on both. It also has claws on dustpan to get the dust off the broom which is awesome!! I will use this in my laundry room!!
The bristles on this broom are so soft as to render it useless for office use. if I had opened it when I first received it, I would have returned it. Not worth the money imo.

I was so excited to get my new broom, sounds funny, but I was. Came in a small box and needed to be assembled- which was fine- however, in taking out that broom piece, I knew upon the weight of it that it was a big flop !! The head of broom was very small, and very very flimsy- it would not even sweep up a coffee bean - Very disappointed

The broom head didn’t fit into the poles so I had to super glue it together. As I assembled this product I soon realized that the pole that screws into the broom head wasn’t able to latch on, it was too short.

To say that I was surprised about the small size of the box when this arrived at home would be an understatement. I didn't recall noticing joints in the photos when I ordered the product. It went together easily enough, but this thing does not stay screwed in tightly. Luckily I ordered this for any unexpected messes for quick cleanup, which means I don't need to use it often but if I did, I absolutely would've sent it back. Cheap design, not sturdy. Do not recommend.

This is flimsy from the start. You can feel the broom bend when you use it. After a few weeks the plastic covering the joined parts broke and the top wouldn't stay screwed in. Then it broke off completely and I am left with half of a broom. A while later the rubber part on the dust pan started to come off. It's completely useless now.

topic: ASUTRA Natural & Organic Yoga Mat Cleaner (Mindful Lemongrass Aroma), 4 fl oz | Safe for All Mats & No
texts: I might as well just use soap and water because with this spray it feels like I’m cleaning my mat with just water. I see no difference after using this. It has a scent but it’s very light.

-The spray nozzle does not spray evenly and leaks huge globs of the oil out on to my mat. -It takes a ton of spraying to even cover your mat so I feel like this is going to last maybe 5-7 uses. -The smell is nice and I like that it comes with a microfiber towel but the towel itself is hideous and too big. Overall, I do not recommend this product.

While the products smells great and does keep my yoga mat clean, the pump sticks. It’s really annoying . You press it down and it sticks than when you get the pump to work , nothing comes out. I got so annoyed . I ended up pouring some on the cloth and using it that way.

Could barely this product at all because the spray function doesn’t work. I tried multiple times and no luck. Totally useless. I’ve been trying to pour a little out onto the mat and then spread around with cloth and the results are average.
I order this, and went to open this to use this week. It turns out the liquid leaked out of the bottle and soaked the towel that shipped with product. So no spray liquid left! Very disappointing.

This stuff is great! It leaves my yoga mat clean and fresh. There is no sticky residue like other cleaners can leave. I also love that it is made with all natural ingredients. I will be looking into more of your products!

When this arrived I was upset that the bottle was only 3/4 the way full. Then only after using it a handful of times the spray bottle jammed and no longer sprays. It smells good and it was nice that it came with a cleaning cloth.

The microfiber towel absorbs all of the mist. The mist doesn't really saturate the mat at all and I had to use a lot of it. Trying to wipe a mat down with a towel is frustrating and impossible because the towel just unfolds while you're doing it. You need a lot of liquid to make it not do this. I can't understand all the positive reviews- is this what people consider cleaning? Wiping fragrance on a mat? My mat does not look any cleaner. Because it isn't.

topic: Replacement Toothbrush Heads Sensitive Sonic Toothbrush Heads Compatible with Philips Sonicare Electric Toothbrush(8 Pack)
texts: They did arrive and they did fit my toothbrush, but I didn't really think that entitled them to two stars. I don't really think they're entitled to one. They claim to be for sensitive teeth, but it was a bit like brushing my teeth with a sander attached to a drill bit. I could almost feel the enamel being stripped away. I would have returned them, but they sat in a drawer for about a year and I forgot about them.

When I purchased these brush heads my expectation was that I would receive decent replacement heads. Sure, they’re color-coded. Sure, they (sort of) stay on my Flexcare ok. Sure, they were reasonably priced. But...if there was any enamel remaining on my 40-ish year old teeth before using these brush heads it is definitely gone now (and it ripped up my gums, too, which were in otherwise good shape prior to using these brush heads)!
These are not Sonicare brand, and not for sensitive teeth as described. These heads do fit on my Sonicare, but they are really hard and actually hurt my teeth. Returning to order the real thing.
These are not for sensitive teeth. The bristles are ridged and have to be soaked in hot water to soften up. But for $15 you get what you pay for!

These brushes are nice quality and a great price compared to the price of Phillips toothbrush heads. It is a different shape than the one that came with my toothbrush and I like it better because it is not as tiny as the one that came with my toothbrush.

Maybe I got the wrong ones, but what I received could only be considered sensitive if one were a horse? These brush heads made brushing teeth a painful experience. I didn't want to brush with my sonicare with this head on it, it was so terrible. I wound up tossing these, and getting another brand. I wanted to like these, but it just didn't work out for me. :(

I was disappointed in how rigid the bristles on the heads are. They were much stiffer than I had purchased from another company. At first I thought they sent the wrong product, but the box is clearly marked sensitive. Much too stiff.
As a dentist, I can tell you these heads are not "sensitive". If you use these thinking you are using a sensitive bristle, you can very possibly do irreversible damage to your gingiva.

topic: GNC Mega Women Sport One Daily Multivitamin for Women, 60 Count, For Performance, Muscle Function, and General Health
texts: I wanted to love these but they made me so sick. My stomach is a mess and I’ve been nauseous everyday since I started taking these. I thought it was a stomach bug until I realized it started when I took these pills and went away if I didn’t take them. Will be returning these immediately.
I was hoping to get a bottle of the old formula like shown in the picture. This new formula hurts my stomach and hasn't helped me like it did before. I won't be purchasing again...

I was so looking forward to feeling more energized after taking the Energy&Metabolism pills, but unfortunately, they gave me stomach pain and cramps every single time, even when I took them after breakfast/lunch.

I've been a fan of GNC Womens Ultra Mega Energy Daily Multivitamin's before, so I thought I'd try this one. Cannot recommend. Caused extreme nausea, and made me violently ill. Based on the other reviews, this appears to be a common symptom. Avoid.

Okay so anyone who normally takes multi vitamins knows that it is so difficult to find ones with iron and collagen! This multivitamin is awesome. It is large but that was to be expected considering that it has like everything in it.

This is a TERRIBLE multi-vitamin. Such horrible and misleading advertising. I bought this thinking it was actually going to give me an energy and metabolism boost. HA. That's a laugh. It actually made me MORE tired. I have never felt so exhausted in my life as when I consumed this product for a week. Not to mention it, for some reason, contains Polydextrose which is a synthetic form of glucose made in a lab and I have no idea why it is in the "vitamin". Should have known better considering it was so cheap. Wish I could get my money back as I'm tossing most of the bottle. Oh well. You live and you learn I guess.

These make me feel very nauseous with or without meals. I do feel more alert after the uncomfortable feeling goes away. However, I would rather not put my body through that everyday. Not sure if it's related but I took these for a week straight and broke out on my chin so I stopped taking and it cleared up.

If I want caffeine, I'll drink coffee/ tea, etc. I thought otherwise this would be a great product, but personally caused too much increased heart rate, which seems to contradict trying to become healthy naturally. Of course, I'm speaking my own opinion. Caffeine affects each of us differently. I can only tolerate smaller amounts of it and had to switch to half-caff or decaf coffee

topic: Flushable Wipes for Baby and Kids by Kandoo, Unscented for Sensitive Skin, Hypoallergenic Potty Training Wet Cleansing Cloths, 42 Count,
texts: The box that should have contained 12 pieces only contained 11. Returns are not practical due to Covid-19 issues and I resent paying for something I did not receive. This will not happen again. The product was removed from Subscribe and Save.

Bought these to replace another brand and am very dissapointed. They are smaller; too small to use without getting.... stuff on your hands. They are also very thin and ... stuff... seeps through. Avoid these at all costs.

Even when flushing only the recommended amount, we ended up with clog in our main sewer line which backed up into our home, filling our bathroom and garage with sewage and piles of these wipes, which had not broken down in any way since they were flushed weeks ago. We needed to have both a plumber out as well as a cleanup service. If you are looking for a flushable wipe that is safe for your plumbing, this is not it.
My bottom is RAW!!! These wipes took the skin off my bottom! After only using them for a week I had a bloody bottom. I would NEVER use these on a child or baby. These are TERRIBLE!

I use this at home and when traveling for when my 2 yo goes number 2. He thinks toilet paper is too rough and loves these wet wipes. Love that it actually seals after each use and doesn't dry out. I've already reordered a couple times.

I purchased Kandoo flushable wipes from my local grocery store and have been using them for a few months during potty training. The other day my landlord showed me a pile of old wipes that became sucked into his septic pump and caused it to cease up! I did call Kandoo and they state that they will reimburse us some of our costs. It is my recommendation that everyone google these wipes and read all of the horror stories about flushing them before putting them in your toilet! Please save yourself ALOT of money and put them in the trash when done!

It took my child having such a horrible irritation that warranted a doctor visit for me to realize that a SENSITIVE wipe contained alcohol. I have always bought the Kandoo brand but this was the first and last time buying them. Even my pediatrician was perplexed why a wipe labeled sensitive would have an alcohol ingredient. Returning and requesting a full refund won't cover the doctor cost or prescription but on principle I want my money back. DO NOT BUY!
There are a million products that you should not flush down your pipes if you care for your plumbing or for the fact that you may be ruining public sanitation. This is one of them. NOT FLUSHABLE!

topic: Hollywood Ribbon Inc. Christmas Bows Assortment, 84-Count
texts: If I had known how SQUISHED and DAMAGED these bows were gonna be when I recieved them, I wouldn't have purchased them. Even trying to straighten them out by hand won't work cause they are just TOO squished. One of the three packages of bows I recieved appeared to have been previously opened and those were the worst. I have sad bows this year. :(

The majority of the bows were crush and unuseable. They came in three separate bags inside a black garbage bag where there were bows loose inside the bag as well. The bows do not have a sticky adhesive so you must tape them on.
I actually prefer my bows to come without the look of having been annihilated by a bulldozer, but maybe I'm just picky. Squashed, wrinkly and/or curling up from the adhesive tab- just a waste.

The bows would have been beautiful except that they were smashed when they arrived. As another reviewer stated, there are three bags of bows squished into one bag. The bows were so flattened that they are unusable.

I should have listened to the reviews i read. Arrived in 3 small bags. One bag was so smashed i threw them all away. I was using them for my ugly sweater party. I could only use a few out of each bag due to them being so smashed and unable to be used. I would have used even less if I was actually using them for presents. Save your money, Walmart would be a better choice!

Great assortment of Christmas bows. Nice mix of both sizes and colors. All peel-in-stick worked nicely (some had a clear base that I initially didn't see the "peel", but it was there and they worked great).

You're better off buying these from the dollar store. More than half of these came in completely smashed or uneven, and the metallic ribbon is bubbling on several of the bows. The only reason this didn't get one star is because the adhesive works well and it's clear.

I took the chance & ordered these bows with the idea that maybe with so many bad reviews about the bows coming all smooshed they would've done something by now to correct that & package them more carefully. NOPE! They came as 3 bags of bows crammed into a slightly larger bag. Who on earth would think this type of packaging is acceptable?? Ridiculous! Don't bother ordering these! It's a total waste of money! And they look like pretty cheap bows anyway.

topic: Alimed Torticollis Collar: Infant-Child (Fits 4-month to 10-years old)
texts: It was a good fit after the adjustments were made. I would recommend it to others because going thru insurance would have been $230 for the collar; but this one was $60, same exact one too Great deal!!

Sadly this was so uncomfortable our kiddo wore it just twice. Physical therapy is hard to find for his age. Aging out as a baby at Children's Hospital and too young for their teen area. Living in the Antelope Valley we had terrible experience with two therapists. One claimed to work with kids...sham and the other and "expert" told my son he was being a bad boy. He was 2.5 years old and they hardly had toys. Thought this would be an easy option but it wasn't. Needs to me a foam collar that's comfy and easy to adjust.
I bought it and realized my son wouldn't be able to use it. He is a strong baby and would be able to rip it off. This made it useless to us. It was still unopened and I couldn't return it.

Very hard to assemble or adjust without having to look at tutorials on youtube. Also modifying the product makes it convenient for them to sell more items once kids outgrow that particular setting or size. They should come up with different sizing because that "fits all" approach I think is what is hurting the products reputation. Had to return it.

Too big for my toddler, uncomfortable for her to wear, plastic is not environmentally safe for my child, comes with a warning lable, return policy only on unopened packages regardless of size issue, restocking charge.

Could not get this to the right size to fit our child even with the help of 2 different Pediatric PTs who attempted to trim it multiple times. We tried it both with my child's cranial helmet on and off, neither worked. Since we couldn't get the fit right we couldn't use it on our daughter. Couldn't return due to having to cut tubes to fit your child.

I sincerely believe daily use of this product for three months helped relieve my daughter's head tilt. I only wish the instructions for assembly and correct placement were more clear. Need to watch YouTube videos to see how to apply safely and comfortably to child's neck.

We just bought the tot collar as one of our last resorts battling torticollis. After cutting the collar to fit my 13 month old along with the spacers we are unable to return it to my knowledge. She will not tolerate it at all and even after cutting the smallest size spacers it doesn't fit her at 13 months old. My husband is mad and couldn't believe I spent so much. I am so bummed.

topic: Plus White Diamond Bright Polisher - at Home Professional Teeth Whitening Kit - Removes Unwanted Stains Rapidly - Instantly Brighten
texts: I didn't find any difference between this and using the electric toothbrush- the rubber head keeps popping off if you use too much pressure or do it an an angle, so it becomes a little annoying to use- I will have to experiment to see what angle and how much pressure to use- I am tired of looking all over the bathroom for the rubber head!
Thus is only good for polishing your front teeth, it is far too bulky to effectively reach your other teeth. Additionally the stupid attachment pops off every few seconds while using it.

The light does not work. The little silicone cups you put the toothpaste in are too deep and not flexible enough to get it on your teeth to polish them. Super disappointed that I can’t return this because it does not work.

Total Crap, don't waste your money! Rubber tips won't stay on at all. Fly off as soon as you try to use it no matter how easy or what angle you try to put it to your teeth. Luckily my old one still works even tho the on button is getting really loose (a different band) purchased years ago.

I discovered the cups for the polisher were stiff, like a hard rubber, little or no flex. When attempting to get in and around the curves of the of the teeth, the cup would fly off. Even with moderate pressure on the flat surfaces of the teeth, it would do the same. The cups should be made with a flexible type product and screw in on the stubby shaft of the device. There is no way to turn this on to use it. There is an empty tube where I think batteries are supposed to go, but no way to hold them in place, no button to turn on, nothing.. it's just hollow. And because I can't return it or exchange it I've just wasted my money.

The head is too big to do the back teeth. The tip that holds the polishing agent easily comes off. Unfortunately I wouldn't recommend this product. I will buy one with a much smaller head for maneuverability.

Wish I didn't wait so long to try things because this wld have definitely went back. Money in the trash. I think if it wld have went a bit faster it would have been a hit. One of those things either it works or it don't. Unfortunately it dont.

topic: Professional Eyelash Curler – Get Big Bold Curled Lashes with this Premium Silicone Pad Eye Lash Tool to Complement Your
texts: I'm not sure why this has such high reviews, it doesn't seem to squeeze my lashes enough, they don't hold a curl at all after using this. I've used several brands before and this is my least favorite. I wish I'd just paid a few dollars more for a better quality curler in the first place.

This product curls lashes pretty well but it is child size or something. The finger holes are tiny even without the rubber pads. It is literally half the size of ones I purchase in store. Confused why it is so small. Maybe sticking to store bought eye lash curlers is the way to go.
I am disappointed with this eye lash curler. It appeared to be of the same size as my present Cover Girl eyelash curler....however it is shorter and not as easy to use.

Based on the positive reviews I gave this a shot. After using this for two days, I would not recommend this product. It pinched and hurt my eyelids and didn't curl my lashes. I've used several brands over the years and this was the worst one by far!

NEVER again will I buy these online or at Amazon. I bought 2 hoping one would work if the other one didn't...NOPE neither one of them worked. I take my chances at ROSS Department store and I'm NEVER disappointed, by price or how they work, these DO NOT curl my lashes!

I was a little nervous when I opened the package because the handles are a bit shorter than I'm used to. And the opening where your eyelashes go looked a little sharp. However, when I used the curler, it worked great. Gave me nice curly lashes and didn't pinch my eyelid.

Functioned fine when I first received it, but after the a few weeks the white buffer on the bottom repeatedly fell out in my cosmetics bag. While it's easy to pop back on, it's irritating to have to dig it up from the bottom and put it back in. I would not purchase this item again, for fear of the same thing happening again.

This eyelash curler is the worst that I've seen. It's very tiny, only has one silicon strip and the finger holes are the size appropriate only for an infant. This should be priced as a dollar product instead of $7.97.

topic: Beachbody Energize -Pre-Workout Formula | Improve Your Focus. Train Longer. Perform Better | 40 Servings
texts: Loved the old E&E (and P90X Orange Recovery) but everything is getting away from the old names and formulas for some reason. I had high hopes but finished a whole container to make sure I was giving it a fair chance. This new stuff just doesn't seem to work as well. I don't feel the same boost as before. It is kind of nasty messy with the color and staining. Even staining my mixer bottles for some reason. Seems like I went through it faster than the old as well. I expect more for the price. I valued the old one but the new one, I guess I will be looking for other stuff.
Product came on time. It looks in great condition it smells a lot like citrus. I had a small finger taste and wow! I can already tell it's going to work! I can't wait to try it out.
The only reason people are buying this stuff is because beachbody is telling them to. Look a the ingredients, you can literally get the same thing in a different brand for 1/3 of the price.

I’ve loved Beachbody products for years and haven’t had much disappointment with their products...... but this stuff tastes so bad I had to leave a review. I assume this is what lemon pledge would taste like. Now I’m just trying to power through it since it was so expensive. 🤢🤮 I do feel like it gives me a little boost on those extra sluggish days though so I’ll give it two stars instead of one.

I liked the Energy & Endurance preworkout much more than the new version. This version makes my hands tingle and make it numb. It doesn't give me the energy I got from the discontinued E&E. It also makes my lips really dry for some reason. I don't see the results I wish I did, and I don't understand why this product is much more expensive than E&E was.

This product was terrible! I rarely write reviews but I think I had an allergic reaction to this. Shortly after I drank it my face and ears became very itchy. I thought it was my imagination so I tried it a couple more times. Every time I felt the exact same way. I also never felt like I got any energy from it either. Very disappointing!

I've never used a preworkout and am sensitive to caffeine so was nervous about trying this. I couldn't tell a difference at all with this product! Disappointing bc it was expensive. I can say that it was delicious.
I like the flavor, I actually just dump the powder in my mouth without mixing in water. But it does not give me any extra energy. Total waste of money

topic: Julian Bakery ProCookie | Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip | 12g Protein | 4g Net Carbs | Gluten-Free | Grain-Free |

Like what one if the other reviewers said, even though the cookies don't stay in tact very well...the taste, quality and nutrients deserve 5 stars in my book. The first batch I ordered were phenomenal. They came broken but they tasted so good. I ordered again a month later and this batch is raw, chewy, not in a good way..disgusting and has nothing like the original flavor.
This cookie is VERY DRY I've loved Julian Bakery for other products but this cookie is disgusting. When I opened them they were in a million little pieces. I will never buy again.

Important for people to know that each cookie has 26 g of carbs (only 2 g fiber). So this is not really that great of an option if you were hoping for a keto compatible snack. The taste is good but after eating one, I don't feel very satisfied. The mouthfeel is quite dry. If I'm going to burn about 200 calories on a snack I'd rather go with a Quest bar or a real nut-based bar which have about the same carbs but are more satiating.

Negative 5 stars. Garbage! THERE IS NO FAUCET IT WILL ADAPT TO USE THIS JOKE OF WASTED RUBBER. I cannot believe Amazon will sell, literally WORTHLESS JUNK. THANK YOU AMAZON!!! RENEE ORLANDO, FL

this flimsy shampoo sprayer was overpriced and did not fit the spigot for which it was intended, which was not overly large. In fact it didn't fit over ANY spigot in my house.

This might absolutely be the worst product I have ever purchased in my life. You use the sponge once or twice and the glue breaks down and the sponge falls off. Every single one of them the glue failed and I could not use more than twice.

I was disappointed to find that the wand leaked all of my dish washing liquid into the sink. No matter which way you tilt it, it leaks! Had to use plastic wrap in the screw-on end to keep the liquid inside.

I bought this about three months ago. Typically, the Libman brand sponges to go on this handle will last about a month each. I've gone through the package of six that came with this because the sponge falls off the handle and can't be reattached. Pay the extra money and buy the name brand.

Bought cheapest ones out there. Received them promptly, as promised. Used the first wand about 5 days, then the sponge came detached from the wand. topic: Dr. Fresh Manual Kids' Extra Soft Toothbrushes - Pack of 2
texts: Very disappointed with the purchase. Was looking for a cheap alternative. Thought this was what we were looking for but very disappointed with the quality. The bristles fall apart very quickly and the rubber plastic head the supports the bristles also falls part. The quantity, for the price, is good but not the quality. Specially don't like the rubber plastic falling part when the kids are brushing.
My little ones use those bush for only a week, the bushes start to cured too much that have to change a new one. One new bush for only one week. That’s too short durability.
My daughter went through 3 of these in a week. They are not durable and little pieces of plastic are coming off. More suitable for adults who will not accidentally chew on them.

I guess if you market towards children they don't matter because they don't write reviews. I needed a very soft toothbrush so I bought these thinking that if they are children they should be soft, right? Extra soft? No. These are pretty hard, which is not good for children's teeth. Nor are they good for mine. I would say these are medium bristles. So I would look for other toothbrushes if you want your kids to use soft toothbrushes. Had to throw my extras away.

The colors of toothbrush are not as pictured. It isn't a huge deal except I have 2 boys who will not use the pink or purple (fingers crossed they will use the green with purple accents) so the cost per toothbrush just went up since 4 of the 10 will be donated. One of my boys loves red and was excited for a red toothbrush but it isn't in the packages we received, so I also have a disappointed 5yo. I honestly wouldn't have bought if I had known we would receive different colors.

These may have been incorrectly labeled as soft. The correct label should have described them as very, very hard. The bristles were harder than my medium-bristled toothbrushes for adults. I still kept them because hard bristle toothbrushes can be useful for cleaning sneakers and such.

My kids were very excited to have so many colors to choose from and the size is nice for their little teeth! The brushes are okay and value for money. However, they sent me pink and purple colors, and I had picked blue and red. Now my boys dont want them :(
