I've found this scale to be inaccurate and inconsistent. I was having difficulty with my weight frequently changing and I tried stepping on the scale twice, minutes apart, and the readings were six pounds different. My problem turned out to be a faulty scale. I contacted Fitbit and they told me that their guarantee of accuracy was plus or minus two pounds so a six pound range was not unusual. They went on to say that they did not have any type of repair facility so there was nothing that they could do for me. What kind of a company is this that doesn't stand behind their product? I'd never buy from them again.

The scale works great!! However, the seller is not. The scale I revieved was FILTHY! Even after cleaning it there's water spots and stains on it that I cannot get off. This was the first indicator that I was sold an open box item. Then, when I went to set it up, it had already been set up for someone else's home network. It was a pain to figure out how to reset the scale. I have not tried to return it because I don't want to go through the hassle. The scale works fine but I reccomend that you find a local retailer to buy it from.

Bought this Fitbit Aria, returned this Fitbit Aria! Setup was easy but at the end of the process I couldn't get anything but "ERR" to display after stepping on it. Describe's my response perfectly, "ERR." I've since purchased one in a local store--don't want to have the same seller return experience with the one I purchased on Amazon--and it works perfectly for now. Followed the exact same setup procedures but this one works which confirmed it was a defective product the first time around. I'd recommend buying in a local store since it seems like a lot of people had similar issues either with the setup or following the setup (my case).

It fails right after one year for the same "THINKING ERR" problem that so many people have. I thought it was just me, but there are so many complaints about this all over the web, even on Fitbit's web site. They have no fix, except to recommend that we remove a battery and restart (don't waste your time. It doesn't work). The only good thing is that until then, it worked fine, but a $80 scale shouldn't have to be thrown away after one year.
This thing is great until you want to make any simple changes. Completely un user friendly. DO NOT BUY You are better off getting a $10 scale as Bed Bath and Beyond

This was very cool in the begining. It was able to sink up to my Fitbit and it knew it was me stepping on the scale as opposed to someone else. It is 6 months later and it doesn’t turn on. I have changed out the batteries multiple times thinking this would help, but it didn’t. Now I have an expensive piece of plastic that I can’t return.

If you're looking for a scale that syncs to your Fit-Bit account, then this is what you need. Of course, it's the only available alternative for that purpose. If that is NOT your goal, then you should be looking at another scale, since the price is only justified by the Fit-Bit thing. Also, it seems to update wirelessly only about 80% of the time, although when it is slow, it will always catch up, eventually. Perhaps that is a function of the wireless router in our house, but who knows.

I am so frustrated. I was so exited to receive this scale as I head GREAT things about it. But, I have been trying for about 2 hours in total today to connect to my wifi and it just will not connect. I have tried every possible troubleshooting method and to no avail. I am returning it first thing tomorrow and will just get a cheap $20 scale that actually works. Don't waste your money.

topic: Heated Eyelash Curler, Eyelash Curler Electric, Electric Heated Eyelash Curler, Portable Electric Eyelash Curler for Curled Eyelashes Painless Curved Beauty
texts: Product doesn’t work. I have tested it several times and it has not delivered. My lashes were as straight as can be after using the curler even for a full minute.

This eyelash curler really gave my lashes some lift! They are naturally fairly long, but they tend to point downward. This heated eyelash curler paired with some mascara really did the trick! The heat is not too intense and only needs a few seconds to get desired results. My lashes stay curled throughout the day! I was surprised that my eyelashes were still curled the day after using it, even after I took my mascara off! I also like the slim pen-like design making it easy to take with me on the go.

I can't even give this product a solid review since the product LITERALLY fell apart when I pulled it out of the packaging. I took it out of the box and the bottom piece fell off the tube. Ok, maybe it wasn't glued properly? Then when I went to turn it on, the switch was so stiff that the entire product slid out of the tube. At that point, and by how flimsy the thing felt, I didn't dare put it close to my eye in fear that it might burn off my lashes or that the heating element would spring out and blind me. 10/10 would NOT recommend
This is a cheap piece of junk. On the first day, it would hardly turn on and the bottom piece fell off. On the second day, it stopped working completely. What an absolute waste of money.

I rarely wear makeup so I was really excited to try this but it was such a disappointment. This curler seemed to be a better one based upon the reviews but literally after 2 uses, it no longer gets hot. I've changed out the battery multiple times hoping that it was a battery issue but that didn't fix the problem. It wouldn't be as disappointing if you could still use it as a regular curler but since it can't, it was basically a waste of money.
The curler needs a new battery every two days even though it’s only used for 1-2 minutes. The switch is very temperamental and has to be in just the right position in order for the curler to heat.
I’ve had this for 2 weeks. Worked well for first few days. Needs new battery multiple times a week even though it’s used for just 2 mins a day. It no longer heats up fully. Huge disappointment.

I liked this a lot. Until it stopped working. Which was about a month and a half after i got it. I ordered a similar style in a different brand, which was a little more expensive, which should arrive soon. Don't buy the cheap one.

topic: Weight Scale, Precision Digital Body Bathroom Scale with Step-On Technology, Brushing Finish, 6mm Tempered Right Angle Glass Easy Read Backlit
texts: Can't give features any stars since this item never worked the entire time I had it. Tried new batteries, turning batteries around, noted that the coils and pic for batteries don't match, tried on flat surface anyway to no avail. It never "turned on". Bought a second thinking it was just a fluke. Second didn't work either. Don't waste your money.

This scale is amazing! Didn't know until I opened it that the layer of color under the glass has a little sparkle/glitter in it. The scale itself it a lovely color of blue gray with a silverish glitter.

The "instructions" were poorly written and we coyld not get it to work. Even the symbols inside the battery compartment were backwards. Tried to return it and Amazon said they would refund my money and to just keep the item. Thats how disposable it is.
I received the item and even though the photo showed batteries none were included. I ran out but brand new batteries and the scale never worked. I shipped it back very disappointed

What do I dislike? If you're going to sell things in the USA you could at least be sure the instructions are decipherable. It says "when unused the scale should be left unloaded to avoid over assumption of power and failure of work.".and that means what?? Unload what??? Does it mean I have to take the batteries out every time use it?

For the first few weeks the scale was accurate. Just tried to weigh myself and it is no longer accurate. Never moved the scale from where it was before and it is weighing me at 30 to 40 pounds less than I was about a week ago. Based on the way my clothes fit and the fact that I'm not sick there is no way I lost that amount of weight. Also, stepped on the scale several times. There was a 5 to 10 pound difference each time I got on.

I should have listened to other negative reviews...they were right! This scale gives all different weights - with a range of 6+ lbs(so far!)! I weighed myself last night and again this morning and ..gee! I lost 6 lbs overnight!! I am on a diet and want accurate weigh-ins to see how I'm doing. Can't get them with this! DON'T waste your time on this one...at least I can return and get my $$ back!! (Thank you Amazon!) PS...I made sure it was on a flat, hard surface and I calibrated it as shown online(there's nothing in enclosed instructions about that, BTW!) so I'm sure I AM using it correctly!

This thing is a joke! I can step on and off it three times and it will give me three different weights. Its totally useless and no one should waste their money on this. DO NOT BUY! DO NOT BUY! DO NOT BUY! DO NOT BUY! DO NOT BUY! DO NOT BUY! DO NOT BUY!

topic: O-Cedar Professional Heavy Duty Deck Scrubber
texts: I am giving this POS one star because I cannot give it zero stars. Whoever designed this needs to be beaten with the broken handle of the first one I pulled out of the box. It did not make it past one scrub on my siding. I am ready to cut the other one up into little pieces and throw it in the trash, no burn it. It twirls alright. ALL THE TIME. Do not buy this contraption. It is awful. And expensive for something that seriously does not work.

What a piece of junk. How the hell are you suppose to scrub when the brush flips upside down everytime? What a complete waste of money. I might as well have taken $20 and burned it in a fire. I'd rather poke my eyeball out with a dirty needle than buy this brush. Heavy duty? Yeah. That's a joke!

This item is a total joke. With every push the whole head of the brush flipped over - CRAZY!!! Then the whole connect point fell apart without it even being used. O-Cedar should be ashamed for selling any item this totally, worthless designed.

Terribly unpractical, this is pretty much unusable if you need to exercise some pressure as the rotating head would work against you. The brush is firm but also very sparse. If only I had read more carefully (and believed) the other reviews, wold have never purchased this: it is a total waste of money and I had to revert to another bursh to clean my deck.

This product is useless. The brush head does not stay put and therefore renders the ability to scrub useless. I bought it to scrub up tar mastic and it did little to scrub at all. You can also purchase it for half the price at your local hardware store. Don't waste your time or money.

So wish I had read the reviews first on this deck scrubber. I didn't read it carefully enough to know that the head swivels. Not what I was looking for. Much prefer the head to stay firm and in place. This makes it harder to use the way it moves around. And bristles not all that stiff to do a good job of cleaning a wood or composite deck. Too much trouble to box up and return. Will have to donate.
Head breaks at base of the handle. Cheap plastic junk. Bristles are only on the outside of the head. Also, head swivels and flips over when pressure is applied. Frustrating to use.
Great brush. The head brush moves around with ease. No need to get on my hands and knees anymore. I use it to clean my patio tiles. Easy to use and great product for the money.

topic: OMRON H003D Large Adult Accessory Cuff
texts: Having this Large Adult Accessory Cuff is a moot point since the device I purchased from you to use it on is defective. The device was replaced once with an equally defective unit.
Purchase picture implies two tubes coming off the cuff. The one supplied has one tube with a t connection about 2 inches from the cuff. Totally wrong for my system.

For one it did not match with the OMRON machine I had, which I thought it read it to be compatible. I may have been mistaken. Also, it states to be a large adult accessory cuff, but it is no bigger than the medium to large one I have.

A doctor recommended that I get a larger cuff for my home BP unit due to the size of my arms. He indicated that a larger cuff would probably be more accurate. Plugged right in and works as advertised.

This cuff does NOT fit into our new OMRON machine SO not able to use it. I can't believe that Omron would manufacture something that was NOT compatible with another Omron product. VERY disappointed!!!
If the description of the blood pressure monitor had been written properly, I would see that it was included and I wouldn't have ordered a separate cuff. I wasted my money.

"Large" does not mean longer, it means wider. I purchased the Omron series 5 blood pressure monitor and thought since my family are all "people of size" that we would need one with extra length. This is not it. It is no different than the cuff that comes with the monitor. I sent it back.

This was a waste of money. This cuff is not compatible with the monitor I purchased. Omron BP785 10 Series has a different connector @ the monitor. This cuff is useless with the BP785 10 Series Monitor.

topic: Prorxdisc Pill Cutter/Pill Splitter with Catch Cup, 2 Medication Containers and 18 Cavity Deluxe Disc for Cutting Different Shapes and
texts: Did not work. All I ended up with were a bunch of crushed pills. The few that actually were cut were not even close to being even halves. I do not recommend this for small pills. Maybe bigger ones would cut better.
I was looking forward to using this but it broke the first time I used it. The design is good for different size pills but the quality is very poor.
Very nice product. Does the job better than anything I've used before. It lasted 2 years before the cutter went dull, but it saved us from a lot of mutilated pills. I'll buy it again.

Not that great... The "catch" tray that is built in is not really effective as its very hard to pour the cut meds out. Also, the blade is not sharp enough, you really have to push it down with some force wheres other tablet cutters are a lot easier.
This pill cutter is horrible. My pill fit in perfectly and snug but when I cut it it broke off a tiny sliver from the end and definitely didn’t cut it down the middle.

First of all I have 2 pills that I need to split daily and they both don't fit in the cutter correctly so I have to place it in the next bigger opening. The pills don't split correctly in half, with the smaller of the 2 pills I only get 1/2 as the other side turns to almost power and i have to throw it away. The cheap $4.00 splitter from CVS works 100% better. Don't waste your money on this item.

Garbage. Doesn't work as advertised. I have used several pill splitters in the past and this is no better than a cheap one. The cheap ones I have purchased are the same cheap quality. Will be returning.

This is the worse pill cutter I have had. All of the slots are for ablong pill none for round ones just small to large oblong slots and I have round ones and it will hardly cut the ones I needed it for. Will buy the real cheap one next time works just as good or better. Faye Coronado

topic: Catalytic Burner Air Control for Maison Berger Lamps - Air Control Wick (Long)
texts: For $16 I should get a pristine wick but what was sent to me was chipped. Hopefully it doesn't cause any issue or start a fire. If It does, I'll be back.

The wick was broken when it arrived. The box was dusty and dented. Disappointing, since it was described as a gift box. I ordered a separate wick which arrived fine, stuck it into the filled lamp, and lighted it, but it did little to take any of the smell of polyurethane out of the room, as I read in the reviews. Bummer.

Too expensive for the purpose. It fails to ignite. Unsure if the metal is too thin or the rope material is dry rotted. Very disappointed as I thought the concept of Maison Berger products was awesome. Reminded me of my grandmother's oil lamps.

The first wick we received would not light (which may have been due to the old oil we were trying to use) but Maison Berger was very good about immediately replacing it with another wick even before we returned the first wick for our Lampe Berger. We own several of these lampes but haven't used them for a couple of years which is why we were buying fresh wicks. These lampes are wonderful for killing odors and their oils have wonderful scents like lavender and tea tree. I like that the lamps were originally created by a doctor to help clean the air in French hospitals.

no instruction on how to install the new wick and get it to light! liked it before had to reorder the wick,new wick won't light and no instruction! It is different from the one that came with original set!!!

Some do work and then some don't. If it was my first then I would never buy it again because it is clearly hit and miss. I wish that the maker would do something about it because it is not inexpensive at all especially for elderly people on very limited income like me. I actually god one that was broken in the new package but the package was not damaged so that just tells me that their quality control does not exist.

Ordered this as a replacement wick and it burns but is not giving off any scent. Stone turned deep black and is not holding heat after I blow it out. I usually let it burn 5-10 minutes then low it out and put the diffuser on. I have used the Berger oil and lamp for years and this has never happened. Needless to say I am baffled and disappointed.

I've ordered 3 of these wicks now. 2 fried. The metal in the middle of the center of the stone melted and now the stone won't work. The 3rd stone just won't function. I had to get out my 20yr old off brand stone and use it instead. They sure don't make things like they use to.

topic: Power Spin Scrubber Cleaning Brush - Deluxe Electric Scrubber with 3 Brush Heads, Extension Pole & Rechargeable Battery - Turbo
texts: I should have heeded the reviews. It worked for one month and now it constantly charges and won't come on. So I just use it to scrub with. I saw Clorox has one. Might try it.
This item. Does not work the way they say it does.It doesn't have the power you would won't it to have and the battery does not last long. Not worth the money sorry.

The box came looking like it had been a previous return. when I opened the package, All the parts were thrown all over the box, not in their proper places. As I was trying to assemble it, I realized there was no battery pack part of the handle. It was missing. I was not impressed. I did return the item, and am waiting to see if the replacement is in better shape.
Terrible. will be returning ASAP. I charged this for 2 days and when I used it, it worked for 10 seconds and shut off. Worthless waste of money. Couldn’t be more disappointed with an Amazon purchase.
Absolutely love this product makes it so much easier to scrub the shower & our tub as well. Only issue is you need to charge before use each time, doesn't hold the charge.

DIDN'T LIKE IT. THE CONCEPT IS GREAT, BUT IT DIDN'T HOLD A CHARGE WELLL AND YOU HAD TO USE A LIGHT TOUCH OR IT WOULD SLOW WAY DOWN. I WOULD LIKE IT IF THE BRISTLES WERE HARDER TO CAUSE A BIT MORE ABRASION TO GET THE TOUGH JOBS DONE...LIKE BATHTUBS WITH WELL WATER.

I was quite excited to have this product. However, there is little or no power. If any force is applied it just stops. Who has a shower so clean that no force is needed. If it is that clean why clean. This is a good concept but you need to figure out how to get more power. Good luck.
Battery life is very short and there is not enough torque to really get in there and clean. It went in the garbage after the Battery died and would not charge (2 weeks).

topic: 5 Pack Face Protective, Reusable Comfy Breathable Outdoor Fashion Face Protections, Unisex Black Cotton, Washable
texts: These are not cotton. It was important to me that I purchased COTTON only. I do not know lining is made out of because it has a quilted surface. They look good but are not cotton as advertised. I have black nose guard so that issue is taken care of by me.

PROS: The material is very soft and comfortable CONS: The material is cheap. They fit big so everytime you open your mouth the mask falls off Update! I tried using one of them today and I pulled one of the threads to make sure that the mask was well sewed on and the whole strap came off. Save your money and spend a little extra for some well made masks

The mask is definitely not cotton as advertised. The height from nose to chin is to short. And the fit from ear to ear is much too loose. Very Ill fitting for an adult. Had to hand sew the ear straps to tighten. I don’t recommend. I would return them but instead I’m fixing them for my grandkids.
My daughter purchased from same site and I didn't see an option for size. Hers were smaller and fit our faces perfectly. The ones they sent me were too big.

I unfortunately never got to wear my masks. I have extremely sensitive skin and machine washed then tonight to prepare for the week. 3 were dismantled. Which leaves me with 2! I have never had an issue with machine washing my mask especially after buying them. Very disappointing!
I might have a smaller face than most but it was way too big for me. There is no way to adjust it. I had to sew a tuck in the "straps" that go behind the ears.

I bought these for myself. They are a little to big for my face but would be great for a male with a thicker face. They are super comfortable despite being to big and covering my eyes when I bend over.

Thick with an inner lining. Also comfortable ear tabs, but the sewing seamed sloppy. I exchanged it hoping the new set would be different...unfortunately they were the same and I returned both and ordered different ones(which I like)

The pump came with no cap on the body so there is no way to attach it to the bottle. Can't return it......just a waste of money. Tried taking a picture but there is a problem with the page so I can't even do that. I have shopped on Amazon for a decade....this is the biggest unreturable regret to date. The only plus is I was only taken for a few dollars, but yet it sucks. If you got one that works consider yourself lucky.

Like most is that it pumps, but least is the amount that it. Pumps....way too much. Plus, it is not a foamer. Which using Hibiclens is so much easier when it is foamed. My suggestion is to get a hand soap foamer that you use for the kitchen or bath, rinse it out, and fill with Hibiclens...it works perfect, and just the right amount and foamed, and its a reusable item.

Wow. This thing leaks like a stuck pig. It got knocked over in the shower and stained the tub. I had to spend ours scrubbing and I still couldn't get it all out. Oh and the contents of the bottle were gone.

Squirts the product out top forcefully, too far, and too much at a time. I bought a foam pump hand soap from the store, used it up and refilled it with Hibiclens. It works much better and doesn't waste the product.

Super upset that this arrived broken beyond repair. When first opening it, I thought maybe I’d have to assemble it myself but then I realized it was just broken. Even worse is that apparently this item can’t be returned. I guess I just want to let potential buyers know so you don’t waste money like me.

An inexpensive thing that I thought would facilitate using the soap in its quart size container. Not so--because the soap is so thin, it shot straight out of the dispenser. Had to decent to smaller container w/o dispenser...
It work fine, a bit overpriced for what it is but during a pandemic I am not going to search in the stores for it so there you have it.

It was supposed to pump foam, but instead it shoots soap, that's thin as water, so I can't apply it.I have other pumps that work in16 ounch bottles but no in this large bottle. Don't use this applicator with Hibercleanse.

topic: Water Flosser,Bestrice Nasal Irrigation Dental Care Collapsible Portable Oral Irrigator with Nasal Wash of 2 Modes Cordless IPX6 Waterproof Rechargeable
texts: The unit has a few seconds delay after it is turned on. One charge last about a month for a once a day use. It is convenient for traveling. However, it quits working 3 days after return window is closed. It just quits! I thought it needs charging so I left it charge until the green light comes on. But it still doesn't work. Now I am stuck with a non-working flosser. Too bad it doesn't last. What a shame!

I thought this product would be great especially for traveling. Putting it together was easy, using it was another thing. Water leaked out, I don't mean a little I mean a lot. I was very disappointed.
Product was ok for a few months of occasional use and then broke and won't turn on at all any longer. Pretty much more cheap manufactured junk that will end up in a landfill. Don't buy.

I used mine for few months and it stopped working. It would not turn on but it will go off anytime it wants even in the middle. We would wake up to a sound for about 10-20 seconds and would not stop. It's nice when its working but its not worth the price for only few months of use.

I have only used it about 10 times and the water unit does not stay hooked anymore and even though I try gripping it with my opposite hand while using it, the unit comes off in my hand and makes a mess. Total waste of money when you can only get 4-5 good uses out of it.

I use it in the shower and like it a lot. My husband is letting me use it for awhile to see if it holds up. If it does he will get his own. ****Update** I purchased another and both died before a year. Just stopped working without any warning at all. When it worked they worked great but they die early. Disappointed

absolutely loved it the first week. the second week it's in the bathroom turned on by itself for a few times, which is weird and a little scary when during night twice. now it's been almost a month and half, the low mode is completely not working anymore. the high mode its a little too strong for me especially right after charging. wish I returned it earlier, now it's too late.

This is an unexpected awesome design. The water reservoir is a cover as well. This is a water floss, but can be used to rinse nose with the provided nasal tip. When used as floss, it just very comfortable with different levels. Three classic jet tips let family members to share the tool. It would be perfect that three classic tips are in different colors. Very happy with the purchase.

topic: Andaz Press Blush Pink Gold Glitter Girl's 1st Birthday Party Collection, Favor Bag DIY Party Favors Kit, Thank You!, 24-Pack
texts: I was a little disappointed that the gold parts were not glittery or metallic looking. The appearance was different than online. They come printed on a sheet of four and have to be separated (perforated). They were easy to write on (some glossy invites resist pen, but not these). My daughter liked them.
Disappointed. For how much I spent on this I was expecting a little better quality. Could have printed this out cheaper on my computer and it would have looked better.

Very unhappy with this. It was basically the same quality as if you printed at home. Came in letter size sheets of thin card stock and the printing did not even go to the edges. I had to break them apart at the perforations. I ended up returning these.

Not really easy to use maybe someone would have better luck. I used two for one cupcake and got frustrated gave the rest of the sheet away. Gave it to a friend since it came with no instructions she thought it was stickers. Warning do not stick on kids the glue is strong doesn't cone off clothes or skin.
Ordered 40 labels and received 27 junk quality labels. As you can see half of the labels on one sheet are missing and the other half are peeling off the paper. Total junk. Please don’t buy these

Cupcake wrappers varied in thinness, they are already thin but the same wrapper can go from thin to paper thin. The back where you are supposed to close slot the cupcake wrapper closed is way thinner than the front of the wrapper and if you're not careful they will rip just like regular notebook paper.
Not easy to read. Less than impressed. The online picture is much better than the actual product. I would return it if there was enough time before I need it.
Arrived and half are not useable. Not sure why but they are all bent right out of the package although therthe was no damage to the package. Waste of money

topic: Dental Lace| Silk Dental Floss with Natural Mint Flavoring | Includes 1 Refillable Recyclable Pink Dispenser and 2 Floss Spools|
texts: The floss breaks every other time I use it, and it makes my gums bleed. The jar is nice, a great sustainable idea, but I have to find better floss to dispense from it.

The glass container is cute, but the floss itself is terrible. It's really thick so difficult to get in between teeth, and the wax is super flaky so it just leaves a bunch of wax flakes in your mouth. I'll keep the glass jar, but I'll fill it with refills from a different brand.

I was looking forward to further reducing waste but don’t think this is the way to go. Even after practice, I can’t floss my teeth without at least three separate strands of this floss. The record has been seven. Meanwhile with regular floss I can actually reuse it several times.

This product was unusable for me. It broke repeatedly as I tried to floss over several days. Having said that, I have that experience with many other brands of dental floss. Apparently my teeth have sharp edges. But I applaud the customer service and motivation of this company. Perhaps others will have better results.

The floss breaks between my molars on both sides. I ended up using 4 pieces to get through 1 flossing session. I think I’ve got pretty normal teeth, the other floss I’ve been using never breaks when I use it. Otherwise it’s a beautiful container and I wish it worked better for me.
Glass container was shattered at the bottom and can’t be returned. There nothing more disappointing than opening a package and finding it broken. I will not be purchasing this again.
I really, really wanted to give this product a good review, but I can't. I have almost finished my second spool. It breaks. Even when I am gentle. Great idea, but poor quality.
I’ve never ran into such a strong floss. I’m getting in between spaces I haven’t touched any time soon and my teeth are looking better and better everyday I use this product.

topic: SoundBender 2.0 Easy-Fit Magnetic Sound Enhancer for iPad 2 & iPad 3 & iPad 4 (No Wires or Power Source)
texts: I just purchased the sound bender thinking what a great product this looks like from shark tank. I was mistaken. I received my sound bender today and the magnet is on backwards! how can you sell something with that big of a problem? every time i try to put it on my ipad, the magnet repels my iPad. but when i put it on facing the other way it stays. This is junk! save your money, use your hand!

Put simple, it won't stay latched on my IPad2. For a cheap little piece of plastic to cost 10 dollars, you would think it would at least attach to the iPad. I have never felt inclined to write a review on anything until this. I thought I messed something up, but nope, it's just a terrible product.

Seen this item on Shark Tank and had to order right away works great makes the sound come out the front instead of the back ,only problem was had to turn magnet around because it wouldn't stick ,which was really easy it just pops out and turn it over and I also use a little piece of scotch tape so it don't slide around , so much better then trying to hold your hand by the speaker to make the sound come out the front ,this was a excellent little gadget wish I would of found it sooner ,would definitely recommend it ,I don't use the ipad with out it thumbs up !!!

Actually this little piece of plastic for which I paid $19.99 worked and the sound from the back of the iPad was redirected to the front. However, the basic design was flawed and the item would not stay attached. I do not have a case for my iPad, so that was not the problem. The device slid on easily and had the magnet been larger, or stronger, and the arms a bit longer, it might have worked. The minute you leaned the iPad against your legs, or on a table, or any surface, the little piece of plastic fell off. I am returning it. Too bad, the thought was good; the design was not.

I don't know what happens to the "wonders" of this item but the one I got had to Take and put it on several times to be able to tell the sound difference. Depending On the tablet cover, you may hav to remove it o put this thing on. Not worth it, it's sitting on my desk collecting dust.
It does not stay on my ipad 2 AT ALL. I like the sound, but if it doesn't stay on, what's the point? I returned within 20 minutes of opening it!

Magnet is so weak that it pops of my iPad constantly. Works if it would stay on. I wanted this for when we travel with our kids. The iPad mounts behind my husband's head rest and the volume drives him crazy. The kids are too little for headphones and I had hoped this would help. I ended up taping it on to the iPad mount to get through our drive.
This item makes unnoticeable difference to the sound volume. My hand cupped around the speaker works better than this device. I was disappointed at best and feeling ripped off at worst.

topic: Electric Razors for Women, Facial Hair Removal, Bikini Trimmer, Shaver for Women, Wet and Dry Lady Hair Remover for Legs
texts: This product failed, I got maybe 5 uses of it and the attachment that allows you to change out the different attachments doesn't work, therefore I'm unable to use the face cleaning attachments, I am only able to use Shaver and Nose Clippers. I'm Old and I do not drive so it's very hard for me to return items, this is why I am just keeping it. Disappointed Customer.
I'm not quite sure why this happened but my razor cut me the first time I used it. It cut my armpit 3 times and my legs. I got scared of the simple cuts so I turned it off and stopped using it.
I didn't pay too close attention to what this was. It's very nice!! Can be used also to cut hair! I am glad I purchased! Has its nice carrying case!
It didn't shave my legs that well, I kept going over and over the area, but it would barley get any hair off. It looks nice and all but this wasn't a good product for me.

It worked fine for about 2 months, then it started going off and on while I was trying to use it, I cleaned it after every use charged it correctly and then nothing just won't turn on when I plug it in to charge the led screen comes on but after that nothing, so personally I wouldn't recommend.
Does not remove hair. Also, will only let you use for 1 hour before shutting off? Are you kidding me? $40/60 min is .67 cents a minute kids. To literally do nothing.
Easy to hold, easy to use and easy to clean. Those are the questions on the review. However, it won’t shave my legs. It’s like the blades were never sharpened.

The shaver is easy to use, clean and hold. However, you buy an electric razor to shave, and it just doesn't do that well. To shave an area and make it hair free you have to go over an area a half dozen times and even then some of the hair is missed and not cut.

topic: Verilux Original Natural Spectrum Deluxe Floor Lamp, Ivory
texts: We assembled the lamp according to the instructions but it didn't light up. We took it apart again, and found the white & blue wires at the base of the lamp frayed and cut! I'm not sure if Amazon Prime sent me one that was returned by another customer and didn't check for any defect--so disappointed at Verilux and Amazon! I will be returning this.

This lamp is a piece of crap. Do not buy it. It didn't even last a year and it was not even heavily used by my 90 year old mother. It just stopped working one day, and there is no recourse to repair it. It was made in China, of course. When am I going to learn? But you can learn from me.

IF YOU LIFT THE THING UP BY THE NECK- IT SPLITS, AND OPENS UNLESS THE SCREW THING IS TIGHT. ITS POORLY DESIGNED BUT PERHAPS A NICE LAMP YEAH TOO BAD NO DIMMER BUT WHAT DO U EXPECT FOR 100 BUCK? HOW ABOUT 150? its a Lamp

I am very disappointed in this product [[ASIN:B000F97B5I Verilux Original Natural Spectrum Deluxe Floor Lamp, Graphite]]. The assembly directions are misleading and incomplete. The assembly is held together by 2 tiny screws. (They could not afford to throw in an extra one?)The screws seem too short to gain a bite anywhere on the lamp.Thus the lamp is always on the verge of falling apart.

There are 4 major problems with this lamp after I used it. 1. The flexible neck of the lamp would fall off the rest of the body. 2. The bulb would come lose with a slight bump of the lamp head. (no matter how tightly we replace it.) 3. The bulb shield would come lose after bulb replacement. 4. The bulb is very expensive to replace.

The light defuser wasn't as useful as I had expected but the lamp is great without it. I like the flexibility of the head which is helpful to direct the light where I need it since I have Macular degeneration. This is the third such lamp I have purchased and I would recommend it.

I thought this would be less... medicinal... and more like a regular lamp. It's a "floor lamp" but I can only use it as a bedside reading lamp. It doesn't throw much light at all. My husband said it looked like it belonged in a hospital room and he nailed it. That's the perfect description. Not what I thought it would be at all. I kept it because the thought of boxing it back up and schlepping it to the post office was exhausting. I don't recommend.

screw hole on lamp pole does not align with screw hole on lamp base. Can't be assembled unless I drill through the metal myself. The screw holes are very far apart, not just a mater of slanting the screw a little. Since my daughter's Verilux broke after only a year, I should have known better. Don't trust this brand! Sloppy workmanship!!

topic: Heating Pad for Back Pain, 33''x16'' XL King Size Electric Heat Pad Fast-Heating 9 Temperature Level, Auto Shut Off, Ultra
texts: This is quite easily the largest heating pad I have ever owned. I'm almost 6' & have a long torso. This covers me from my neck/over the shoulder area all the way to my butt. I only gave 1 star because it does seem to get hotter in some areas than others - even on the lowest setting. This is definitely not something I would want to fall asleep on just due to that. ** update - I am returning this heating pad after I found scorching marks & 1 burn hole in the cover, not safe.

The pad is as described for size and softness. However, there are MANY flaws. This heating pad is a MAJOR fire risk. It has several “hot spots” that progressively got hotter to the point it burned the cover and the skin it touched. The smell of “electrical fire” was overwhelming. I may have received a faulty one, but if this is a manufacturing flaw, beware. You are taking a major risk.

This heating pad is soft and thin. The problem is it malfunctioned from the time I took it out of the box. It gets entirely too hot and smells like it's burning. The controls don't work as intended. I put in a request to return it and do not recommend.
Love this pad. Use on 2 most of the time 7 when I first turn it on for 3 to 5 min then its too warm and needs to turn down. It goes to 9. Love the countdown timer so you can see how much time is left

Ok so this thing is huge and heats up amazing. BUTTT…. I used it one night with the timer and fell asleep thinking no big deal it has a timer right. It damn near caught my pillow on fire. It left burn marks on my pillow and heating pad. I Did not have it on the highest heat setting either.
Stay away from this product!!! My daughter had this setting on 2 (out of 10), and it nearly burned through the blanket which was on top of her. Stay away from this fire hazard!!

Loved the big size, flexible softness, and that I could read settings in the dark. Mostly used to warm my bed before getting in, as even the lowest setting got very hot. Instructions said to unplug when not in use, which is a pain but I did. Died after 4th month of occasional use.

JUST received today Was excited to see the size covered the back of my chair. It was hot right away. Started off on 7 to see how hot it was. I kept turning it down I was on 2 and it felt like it was heating up then cooling down. Then the smell came. Almost a fire. Who's going to pay for my chair?

topic: BackJoy Bath Seat Foam Cushion, Transfer Benches, Shower Chairs, Stadium Seats, Durable EVA Foam, Slip-Resistant, Waterproof, Improves Posture, (18"x11"), White
texts: We have pretty hard water and I shower pretty often, so having this stand the test of a good couple of months of regular use while still looking brand-spankin' new is awesome! The holes and texture don't bother my skin at all and it's curved to fit the shape of your rear so it helps prevent the sensation like you might fall and encourages a deeper seat.
This thing is hard as a rock. If you have sciatic pain, it actually makes it worse. They accept no returns, which should've been my first clue but they don't even exchange items sent damaged.

Do NOT buy this if you have any kind of need for support or stability while in the tub. This item does not stay in place and it very slippery in the tub. My tub even has the no slip grips in it and still this item slipped every time the person using it shifted their weight in the tub. I purchased it cause it said is was slip resistant and it certainly is NOT.

If you are buying this for the bathtub and you do not weigh enough, it will try to float and slide out from under you. I am 150lbs and this did not work for me. Very disappointed as it is not a returnable item.

[[VIDEOID:62f4f3c5007ea951fd79104152d35670]] I was very excited about this product, but was disappointed in the quality. I am currently pregnant and standing in the shower has gotten uncomfortable. I didn’t even get to test this seat out because when I opened the package, it looked like it had already been used. Bent corners, chipped on the bottom, and dirt spots inside of the circular rings on the cushion. This is unacceptable. With Covid still in the mix, you would think I wouldn’t have expected to get a used item.

Item not as described. Cushion is very hard!! I would give it 0 stars rating if I could! They don't accept returns either!!! Very frustrating! I do not recommend this item, don't waste your time or money!

This still isn't what I was looking for. I do feel secure using it as far as it sliding off the shower bench. But it really isn't as soft as I would have liked it. I will continue to use it until I can find something different and softer.

I bought this for my elderly mom to use in the tub. She loves to take baths but needed something to give her cushion so her hips and back don't hurt. This did not fit the bill. When we got it, I was worried about how hard it was, but so many reviews said it was great that I thought maybe it works well in the water. Mom tried it and hated it. She said it felt way too hard and wasn't an improvement over having nothing. It was a waste of money.

topic: Innotech LumbAIRPlus Portable Backrest Inflatable Lumbar Support Cushion with Adjustable Internal Air System, Black
texts: Caution: they will not accept returns if you've opened the package! Thankfully, I had read another evaluation of this product and was warned. I returned it intact in the packaging and vendor was very good about crediting my account.

Incorrect sizing information listed! The dimensions listed for this product is 13.5x3x7. The actual product itself is 10.5x3x6. When I contacted the seller, they told me the dimensions were the size of the box, which would have been fine if I wanted to pay that much for a box... 10"x6" won't meet my needs. And the only thing better than to have paid for the shipping for this incorrectly described product is to pay to send it back...

Did not need to inflate very much for good support, so not much pressure in it, but it held air without leaking for only about a week, and now leaks out all the air within a couple of hours. Very disappointed because it provided the support I wanted.

Purchased three of these. One works flawlessly. The other two constantly loses air - which is a pain to use. Customer service sent me a new pump and told me to cut the old one off and use a lighter to melt the plastic and attach the new one. Haven't tried yet.
this thing constantly needs to be readjusted as it is always sliding down. I stopped using it after a couple days and donated it to a local charity resale store.
It's too short so it doesn't provide enough support - just sort of makes a lump that pushes into your back. It's made very well. If they'd make it taller and taper the top it might be perfect.
i like it. only support you can truly boost back up when it lessens to resupport you. hand pump worked for about a yr and a half and then went. but I like it

The air inflatable support has an additional 2" of foam padding that results in a very awkward bulge behind your back and in my case is far more support than I need or want. Nowhere in the description does it mention the additional 2" of foam and this is enough to make the support very uncomfortable and essentially unusable. It gets two stars because it is easy to inflate and deflate. Those are about the only advantages I see. Not a product I would recommend or purchase again.

topic: Sole Sticker Crystal Clear 3M Sole Protector for Christian Louboutin High Heels
texts: The curve of the shoe makes this incredibly difficult to measure and apply. Guaranteed to be an imperfect fit. Additionally, once it's on, it's on. I tried to readjust and ripped the paint off the bottom of a BRAND NEW pair of Louboutins. Granted they will scuff, but I can't wait for these to come off so I can send these shoes to be repaired. Such a waste.

I actually didn’t apply this because my Bestfriend applied it before me and told me when she took it off it ripped the entire paint right off the shoe! I was looking for something that I could replace when it got too worn and this is not it. Once it’s worn you’re going to be left with a hot mess. Better take your CL to a Cobbler and get them professionally protected with red rubber soles.

Not wide enough for a size 39.5 heel. Patched together the scraps to cover whole bottom of shoe. Not in description but recommended only if shoe has never been worn, otherwise pitting shows through. No traction help at all, basically it’s packing tape with extra adhesion; only plus is that it was repositionable and did not lift any of the red. Local cobbler wanted $42 for traction red bottoms; should have done that but he needed a week and I only had a few days.
Really easy to apply product to shoe, just follow instructions. I've ordered this product several times and will continue to do so if I purchase more Christian Louboutin shoes :)
After a few wears, the product had a tear in it so I decided to remove it so I can replace it. It peeled the red paint when I was removing the tape.
My shoes have never been worn out, or on a hard surface. But the product chipped the side of my red bottoms during application, as I was trying to work out an air bubble.
DO NOT BUY! You can literally get these cheaper at Home Depot, plus they’re crap & if you mess up, they’ll take the color off your soles. Super hard to put out, you have to trim them yourself.
Too small. Did not cover the entire bottom of my wife's shoes and scuffs gapped where it did not cover. Now I have to figure out how to repair them

topic: Atzi Hats - Reusable 3 Layer Face Mask, Waterproof Black Cloth Masks For Adults, Washable Masks with Adjustable Mask Straps,
texts: I bought this a long time ago and they were perfect. I repurchased it so my kids 7 and 9 can have extras since there face at school and there not like the pervious ones. There so big and flimsy. Very disappointed.
As soon as my husband put the mask on the elastic straps broke. So he tried on another thinking it was a fluke. It broke. On closer inspection, the straps are glued on through a loop.

Extremely disappointed- bought a set a few months ago and LOVED them. Went to restock and literally bought the same item and received something entirely different. We are so sad. As a teacher I was recommending this mask and linking it in all my emails- will stop immediately as this is not what we paid for or expected.

Unfortunately, we did not have a good experience with these masks and will not be using them. I purchased them because they were advertised for kids but they were a poor fit for my 7 year old. Way too big, even after adjusting them as tight as possible. And zero support around the nose. Disappointed.

The masks are comfortable, stylish, and adjustable. A good size for a young teen face. The problem is that no matter how tight you adjust the strap, they slip down under the nose as soon as you open your mouth to speak. We wanted to love them, but unfortunately they do not work for school since they won’t stay up.

I ordered a pack of these in the past they really comfortable the kids like them so I ordered more second time I ordered two packs and never did receive them so that's why I rated the one star for this particular order but if you happen to get yours they really are comfortable.

The only thing I'm reviewing is the size, the description says for ages 5-14, I'd say it would probably fit closer to 5-8 years old, they are very small, I will be returning these as they are too small for my child.

I love my youth sized masks. I am short and have a small face. These masks fit me perfectly. I also like the material they are made of. They allow me to breathe while absorbing moisture and protecting me from germs (at least I haven't gotten Covid and have been healthier since I've been wearing these masks.) They are adjustable so I can make them fit perfectly. They have been washed over and over and are still holding up well. I recommend these masks for your kids and for you if you are like me and have a small face/head!

topic: TopNotch® Back Brush 2 Brushes for Bath or Shower 1 Clear and 1 Blue with Long Handle Body Scrubbing
texts: These brushes are beautifully made. Will last a long time. Will not discolor or lose their shine as the wooden brushes do. The bristles are firmly attached and a little stiff, but will soften a little with use. The tie at the end forms a nice loop for hanging. You can use liquid or solid soap both rinse out easily. The brush dries out thoroughly just hanging from the shower.

These brushes are a good length but boy are they STIFF!! It felt like steel wool cleaning my back. I might not even have any skin left. If you're a human I'd pass on these, if you're an old rusted cast iron pan that needs a good scrubbing, they will be perfect.

Did no one over three feet test these? Forget it if you have dexterity issues. This brush is an accident waiting to happen. It has nice firm bristles but you can’t use it on your back. It’s only one inch taller than a RULER!!! Seriously, who thought that was a good idea?😳
i have a hard time scrubbing my back to do lack of mobility. these do not help much. not enough of a "bow" in them could be longer. bristles are extremely rough. okay on feet. not back

Cheap material, fragile, and very small in size. After one month only brush is all bent. I do not recommend. Updated with second brush, all bent as well. Bought in May, in September was useless already.
These brushes are terrible. The bristles feel like you are using sand paper on your back and the head is angled in the wrong direction, making it awkward to use.
This brush is not appropriate for body use. It is very stiff, does not hold soap. It is much more useful as a scrub brush for cleaning. Don't buy this item.
The bristles are hard. I cannot use them on my body! Total waste! More of a fit for rough feet! It’s like a hard toothbrush that will take all of your enamel off your teeth!

topic: 18'' 7pcs Remy Clips in Human Hair Extensions 27 Dark Blonde 70g for Women's Beauty Hairsalon in Fashion
texts: These are awful. Not human hair. They fall out of the clips and they can not be styled at all. Mine lasted a couple days before I threw them away.
I orederd these and I tried to dye them, but the color washed out. They also seem to tangle very easily and dont feel like human hair. I was disapointed with them overall.

Got mine today and was VERY unhappy! I have ordered Remy hair extensions plenty of times and I know how they look and feel and these are horrible! Extremely thin an there is no way they should be advertised as a full head extension. They are also very poor quality, the hair looked used and the packaging they came in also looked used! Don't buy these !

Yes you are able to straighten and curl it but I believe its heat resistant synthetic hair it does not dye or bleach. I ordered them for my boyfriends youbger sister and she put a red hair dye on them, after 10 minutes she went to wash it off, the dye was a very bright red, it all washed right off. Like water off a ducks back, if ur hair is dark blonde and u want to make it thicker, go for it but if youre lookeling for extensions to dye/bleach, do not get these.
You get what you pay for. These are cheap as heck. Had to cut at least three inches of it off just to make them usable. They look fake, they feel fake. Terrible quality.

Not human hair i tried to color it to get exact match with my hair and it wouldnt take the hair color. So it is deff not human hair. It was soft and looked nice thou but was just kinda mad it sId it was human hair and in reality it is not.
Awful. Do not order these. They are not real human hair, they feel like Barbie hair, and the color is a horrific golden mustard color. Should have known by the price...

Was i little nervous getting hair on here , this was my first time. And its not my last , i love it. The hair was packaged correctly , color pretty much matched the picture , very nice!! quality Of hair,

topic: Drive Medical 13037-1SV Bariatric Heavy Duty Step Stool, Silver Vein
texts: This item seems to be a good one, but I discovered it's too high for my mom to use. So I ordered another and tried to return it. I found out it's not eligible for return. I wish that was obvious on the website. I didn't realize any Amazon items were ineligible for return. Lesson learned.

I'd anticipated a great platform for my aging mother to assist her during her daily chores. Unfortunately once assembled the footing cover are to hard and allow for the base to slide on any surface. Secondly the handrail wobbles and gives the feeling of insecurity. It does make for a great foot rest which I'm certain wasn't its main design function.
I had spinal surgery twice in 8 months, getting in and out of bed was difficult this step helps met to do just that. Great product very well made looks nice. Recommend

Arrived bent and skewed such that the handle can not be attached. Hang tag has 1 photo of the correct item and then a parts list and diagrams for assembly on what was apparently an older or different model. Seems strong, can't imagine how it became so misshaped. Nice finish, though. Will likely try again hoping for a better result.

The product is basically okay quality, but it tips too easily. I wanted more stability. I suppose I will get used to it. The handle is clearly not going to bend out of shape as I read about another product that I was considering, that much I can feel that it is tough there. I want to add that the rubber coating is really no good -- my cat sharpened her claws on it and left tiny snags in it and the rubber is already un-gluing from the steel platform. Neither me nor my cat did that, it's just junk. I do want another one, a much better one. Do not buy this product, it's a clunker.

I have had this stool for 10 days now. I haveAlso, the rubbrr ,er stepped on it. I have only used it in front of my chair as a foot stool so far. Rubber on step has lifted &, rubber on legs have fell off Everytime I use it. The rubbers on continuously fall off. Also
We bought this to use as a step to get into and out of our trailer. One weekend of use and it’s already bent. Definitely not the quality and sturdiness as described.
Although created for people that can’t reach items the foot base is a big step up, I ended up not really using it and I tried to return it but it was passed the 30 day return window.

topic: Kiss My Keto Creamer Hot Chocolate Mix — No Carb, Sugar Free Cocoa Powder + MCT Oil (9g) | Cocoa/Mocha
texts: This cocoa is delicious. It comes with a scoop. It measures enough cocoa for an 8 oz. cup but I put 12 oz of hot water in it and it's just as sweet. It's a very pricey cocoa but it lasts a long time. It's supposed to have 30 servings in the jar but as I said before, I can make it last longer since it is satisfying and tasty when you make 12 oz at a time.

I purchased this because the keto collagen from the same manufacturer I usually purchase was out of stock. I mixed with my coffee as I do with the collagen. It mixed very well with the coffee and the taste was good. but not even a half hour after my stomach was hurting. I tried it a few times after that thinking maybe it was something I ate on the previous day. but no matter when I consume this product I have stomach issues :(

Product made me ill after consuming one cup, so I went to double check ingredients. WOW, THIS HAS MSG! I feel spaced out, drunk, unable to think or focus, just sitting here without much movement. I'm with the lies and trickery. Will go vegan no processed, package foods. Hope I survive this!

The chocolate flavor has burned undertones but it isn’t that noticeable with the nasty artificial lingering sweetness. I mixed it with hot water and it dissolved nicely. I tried to improve the flavor with heavy cream, but it was a waste of cream. I cancelled my order for the unflavored version.

Not happy with the way I received my package. As you can see by the pictures the bottle was not sealed well and a lot of the powder was all over the outside of the bottle and in the box. Not sure what happened, but this is a problem that needs fixed

This particular shipment came in with less product in the bottle than I have ever received before and the included scoop was buried at the bottom. These two things have never happened before but did in this shipment. This is a pricey commodity for me and to receive in this condition was annoying.

WARNING. This product contains soluble corn fiber which caused my glucose to spike and ketones to drop! Soluble corn fiber is also known as maltodextrin which is NOT keto friendly for many people, including me apparently. Will be returning.

Don't mind the taste but won't mix into my drink. It's like little pebbles of unmixed powder after 10 minutes of vigorously shaking in mixer cup. Gross. Not sure I'll use it again. I received this when I ordered something else. Over all not happy.

topic: Heating Pad Neck and Shoulder Heating Pad Heat Therapy Pad for Pain Relief, Non-Slip Fast Heating Wrap Electric Heating Pad
texts: Warning - Do not buy!! Temperature control unit overheated, melted switch and caused heating pad to burn me. I unplugged from wall when I noticed burning smell, otherwise would have caused wall fire. I missed returning it by one day...

I loved this but it stopped working after 3 months. THAT's PATHETIC! Tried to find a way to return but there is not a return button on my order page. If I can't return things that break in such a short time then it is better to BUY AT A STORE than online.

The electric cord could be longer, but other than that, my boyfriend likes it. It heats up well, and relieves his neck and back pain. Being able to button it up to keep it in place is definitely a plus.

Spent much time reviewing these things for my wife who used her last heating pad she purchased for 4.99 for 18 years and its not working flashing F on 2nd day of use. She also threw the box away. Buyer beware do not buy.
Very disappointed with this product. It did not get nearly hot enough (like not even close) and had a weird smell to it. Still considering returning this product because of how unhappy we are.

Was excited to have this due to shoulder issues. First time using it the shoulder area did not get warm at all. Second time using it only the lower back worked. Figured I would try it again to just make sure it wasn't working correctly. Upon trying it a second time it wouldn't even turn on. Kept on flashing an F or A. Someone said that when it does that it means wires are crossing. However, the heating pad was laid out flat on my bed with no bend in it. Surprise it has such great reviews. Wondering if their heating pads are still working. Anyway going to go back and order a heating pad from Sunbeam.

I could barely feel the heat, I felt like I was choking when I "secured" it around my neck, and if kept sliding off my shoulders. I had high hopes based off of the positive reviews, but I had to return it.

Unforunately I just returned this item because it just doesn’t get hot enough. The features I was most excited about (extending up the neck and on the collar bones) had not heating mechanism at all and not heat was generated in those areas. The heat that could be felt was very subtle.

topic: EAS Myoplex Ketogenic, 14-2.29 oz Packets, Cinnamon Bun
texts: Worst tasting crap I have ever eaten. Used one packet from both flavors. Tried it and dumped it down the sink. Save your money. YouTube Dr. Jason Fung. Free advise and it works without spending money!
Does not tast good at all. Really funky aftertaste, almost like there is way too much raw stevia. Maybe it was just the cinnamon bun flavor but the shake was undrinkable.

I've never tasted anything this bad. I take supplements everyday and I can't even force myself to eat this product. I wish I could have tried a sample before purchasing because it was such a waste of money. Buyer beware!

Did not sit well. I have a strong stomach historically, however this left me praying for it to go through my system fast. i couldn't wait for it to be gone, I was nauseous for hours until i finally sat up in bed and had to run to the bathroom to throw up. I gave it a second chance a few weeks later, I did not throw up but was also left with a disgusting feeling and couldn't wait for it to be out of my system. I actually threw away the rest of the box.

I wanted to give these a positive rating, as the cinnamon bun seems to be the best quick keto meal replacement I've found. I just ordered more of the cinnamon bun, and also some strawberry to see how it goes. I have a couple of family members who also like the flavor.

Way way to sweet.. for the price EAS should add some micro nutrients . love the keto life but these is not going to be part of it , when you only eat ounce a day you cant replace it with zero nutrients

Taste is good, but the fact that it has Whey protein is bothersome. Whey spikes insulin, on a keto diet we are trying to suppress insulin as much as possible. The fat helps, but just having the proper ratio isn't enough. Just like you wouldn't want to eat a meal that has its 5% carbs coming from sugar.

This wasn't for me. Initial taste is ok after taste is not great. I was well into ketosis and this was too sweet for me. I was looking for a way to help supplement intake of fat, but this didn't work for me...

topic: Genuine Corflex Medic-Air Seat Cushion 18" x 15 3/4"
texts: Flimsy, thin, very very slightly and I do emphasize SLIGHTLY better than nothing. It is so light and thin that a SMALL table fan could blow it across the room. To put it another way, if someone offered it to me for free, I would turn it down as it is a waste of space.

I agree with the other reviews---good cushion until it leaks. I had one replaced under warranty, now that's leaking, along with another we own. For more than a short time useage, buy something better, maybe Roho or Air Hawk.

I am a young, healthy person. I ordered this for a friend in a wheelchair and ever since then I am getting telemarketer calls from people who think I have diabetes or need similar services. I have never ordered anything else in this market so I am 99% sure that my information was sold by this company and I am now being harassed because of it. I would avoid "The Therapy Connection at HPMS Inc." like the plague unless you enjoy telemarketers.
This should not be sold to anyone. It is made out of thin plastic material. It feels like it is made out of plastic used to make helium balloons. Very dissappointed.
The pillow does not provide a stable support. One tends to slide around. When inflated (even half way) the pillow is hard rather than soft. Doesn't really do much good.

I should have read the description closer; it matches exactly the description, so that's why I gave it 4 stars. However, for just a bit more, there are cushions which come with a cover. It's easy to pop open the thing you blow it up with, so it goes flat, which is a major reason it needs to have a cover.

one of the worst things i have ever bought, very cheap and did not hold air from the day i got it it leaked all the air out in less than 15 minutes, i returned it and got a full refund.bewarned beware of this product. on a scale from 1-10 i give it a -1....
This cushion is NOT good for sitting but works great when folded up and put behind your back. Ordered for my sister and I ended up using it when I drive long distance and need back support.

topic: White Noise Machine - Koviti Sound Machine with 24 Soothing Sounds-Noise Machine with 4 Stop Snoring Nose Vents for Sleeping&Relaxation,Timer&Memory
texts: I loved it at 1st. Even for camping. The battery lasted a few nights. Now at home plugged in, it keeps shutting off in middle of night. Wakes up cosleeping baby when it shuts off! Ughhh. My power isn't going out, nothing else like fans or chargers or purifier or night lights goes off. Just this sound machine.
It doesn’t hold charge, won’t play while plugged in only as battery operated... only plays a few hours... how does that work for sleeping? Sorry but I need to sleep longer than that... lousy product!

The sounds on this unit will drive you up the wall if you are sensitive to repetitive sounds. The White Noise looped every 12 beats and you could hear three distinct notes. When placed on a wooden platform they were low frequency but when the unit was placed on something absorbent they were high frequency. The brook had a rhythm of 6 beats if I remember now and the Fan noises a 7 beat loop. How anyone could sleep to this is beyond me. Obviously I'm sensitive to this and most folks aren't. This is just a heads up in case you are. Amazon cheerfully accepted a return.

We purchased two of these for our household. One works (it’s only been a few days) but the other runs for around ten seconds then shuts off. I’ll update later to see if the working one holds up but would not recommend this item.

This worked for a short time, then quit.. got a replacement very quickly... Same damn problem!! I loved how loud it got and the different sounds!! Don’t understand all the great reviews!! Two bad ones in a row??!!! Terrible!!
Finally went to use this product-I haven’t traveled much and that is what I bought it for-and it won’t work! I left it plugged in overnight and it still won’t turn on!

I love this! I mostly use the rain and thunder and ocean,but all of the sounds are of great quality. I was disappointed with this gadget. I was hoping to use it to clean my grout on my kitchen floor. It provided no help. I have better results just using a toothbrush.

topic: Dreft Stage 1: Newborn Hypoallergenic Baby Laundry Detergent Liquid Soap, 64 Total Loads, 46 Ounce (Pack of 2), & Dreft
texts: This used to be great, but they changed the scent and it's way too perfume-y now. Clearly from the complaints I've seen on Facebook, I'm not the only one who hates the new fragrance. But dreft is not concerned, even telling one commenter they hoped we'd "learn to love it". Ummm, nope, I just won't buy it.

This is nothing like the store brand.. Completely different. I ordered it, specifically for the smell, and I was surprised to open it up and for it to smell like a "clean and clear" scent or in other words, no smell.

Harmful and toxic ingredients!!! Please beware. After reading the ingredients I noticed it contains borax (sodium Borate) which can cause respiratory irritation!! Borax has been on the Substance of Very High Concern list since 2010!! Also contains diethylene glycol which can cause negative neurological effects. Pregnant women are advised to only use this ingredient if necessary and to use with caution! AND the newborn detergent is not fragrance free which should always be a no no for baby products.

Love this baby detergent. It smells like newborn baby, does a great job at cleaning the clothes, and this combo price online is tough to beat. Highly recommend for baby clothes or for washing anything when you have a newborn!

I had gotten the same liquid from store before pandemic and that one did not leave any scent on my baby's clothes. But after washing my baby's clothes with this one, they always smell. I paid so much money to get little less chemical product..

Omg they changes the scent and it nauseating! It stinks and it make the kids clothes stink! I called them right away as I thought it was written or something. I explained calmly that I wash everything in it, use to to clean my makeup brushes, my husbands work hats, my kids clothes for years! They said they changed the formulating and it clearly marked in the bottle. The lady was rude and ignorant and clearly had a script so I want the first to complain. She then..HUNG UP (disconnected) the call!!! I will never purchase this product again. They really tanked their own company. Investors are super pissed right now. Do not purchase this, ever.

I’m so sad they changed the scent! I used this product for my first daughter and LOVED it. Now I hate it and can’t use it anymore. It also doesn’t get out the blowout poop stains like the old formula did. I’ve pre-treated and soaked so many times and still couldn’t get the stains out with the new formula. My fault for not reading closely enough but there is a strong scent to this detergent. User error but I can’t use it on my infant due to skin sensitivity even though it claims to be hypoallergenic.

I am in my middle 70's and have had bleeding when I brush my teeth, lots of bleeding. I have been taking one pill each morning and one mid afternoon because of gastric bypass surgery 20 years ago. topic: HATTEKER Cordless Mini Hair Straightener USB Charging and Portable Hair Straightening Irons & Flat Iron with Ceramic Tourmaline Ionic Curling
texts: I have used it for two times since I got it. It works great but it will run out of battery by itself while the setting is off/0. Everytime I charge and take off the charger; it will run out of power after few hours.

It won’t stay charged long enough for me to do my BANGS. Its just bangs. It should only takes a few mins but this thing uses all of the battery just to get hot then dies. I got this to use in the car or on the go. I figured I only need it to be hot for a moment so I should be good. Wrong. There used to be several flat irons for sale that plug into a car charging port, but I can’t find any now. So I went with this one and only half my bangs are done right now.

I wanted this only for my bangs when I was out in the heat and sweated, my bangs would get wavy. It was only good for one time on a charge. And after about three times charging it would not charge anymore. What a piece of junk.

There's a factory charge when I opened the package so I was able to test drive the product right away. I had the iron on high setting. It did straighten my hair. Tamed all the frizz. I would like to give this 5 stars but I need to revisit this after a few weeks.

When I bought this it worked great and it is the perfect size for travel. However, I just took it on a trip and it no longer works. I tried charging it again for half the day, then turned it on and it doesn't heat up at all. The lights flash and then it turns off. What a waste of money if it just dies in 6 months.

Not worth the money. I had high hopes for this product, but it never really got hot enough to do anything for my hair. I wanted it to smooth the ends of my hair, but it just can’t do it. Don’t waste your money.

The hair straightener did not work at all. I charged it as the instructions indicated, but when I went to use it, the plates never heated up. But I want to save people the hassle and money. Do not buy this hair straightener. It does not work at all.

I've used this about 3 times, and it's already completely stopped working :( Fully charged, has stayed in my room (hasn't been tossed around for travelling), but won't even heat up. Really disappointing (especially because it's pricey for what it is). Better luck with a different product!

they were easy to hold.. but they didn’t get the hairs like a normal tweezer should. i’ve purchased some really cheap tweezers before and these sucked. i’d rather just go to the store and pick up a pair for 99 cents. i was really bummed.

Was not expecting these to be feel solid, but they are. I tend to misplace tweezers or they fall behind something. The case is great to store them and makes them easier to find. No regrets on this product. My nose hair, ear hair and eyebrows are now kept at bay.

It wonderful I've used it in my 75 gallon fresh and my 40 gallon reef tank. topic: Loop Earplugs for Noise Reduction (2 Ear Plugs) High Fidelity Ear Protection for Concerts, Work Noise Reduction, Studying, Musicians, Motorcycles,
texts: This thing just doesn’t work at all. I can hear EVERYTHING as loud as without it. I really wanted to like it cuz the design looks so good. Too bad.

It's 2 little plastic loops with changeable ear tips. I should have read the reviews before spending this much money! Not much better than foam or silicone ear plugs I am issued when working loud rock concerts. Pouch was NOT included; only a tiny plastic container the size of dental floss. The cardboard box it came in was cool though....wait a second...the packaging explains why it costs so much!

The product comes with no instructions. It is virtually impossible to swap the ear tips. I anted to try one of the included foam ear tips. Managed to get the standard silicone one off, and put the foam one on. It was then impossible to remove the foam tip without tearing it to shreds. It was as if it have nee glued on. Overdesigned product with crappy instructions.

Though properly fitted to my ears, they were knocked out in the very first song I wore them for. They sounded great for the two minutes I was able to use them, but given the ease of loss, I cannot recommend. A strap or cord would go a long way to helping.

Pros: - Very easy to insert. - Comfortable to wear. Cons: - The ear tips barely have any hold on the loop and so the tips come off the loop at the slightest pressure. Often just taking them out the loop would come off leaving the tip stuck in my ear. Wearing them under a helmet they dislodge just from touching the helmet lining. Wasn't long before a loop fell off and became lost.

Package came with 7 foam covers, only 1 was the small size. Also came with the appropriate (6) rubber covers, which are not nearly as comfortable. Im assuming this was a packaging error. Blocked out way too much sound for my liking. I honestly cant recommend these after having Eargasms, Etymotics, and Earasers.

Most consistent and best feeling earplugs I have worn and it comes with a bunch of tips so I could find the perfect comfort. I bought ear peace plugs a while ago and I could never get them to feel the same or feel like they were in right. The loop plugs go in just like earbuds for listening to music. Super easy and comfy.

iv always been a bit sensitive to high pitch sounds so i use these to reduce things down and while they work for basic life if your going to do something with any real sound dont rely on these go to something stronger.

This would not stay on my leg at all. As soon as I stood up it would slide down. I could only use it lying down. I should have returned it but waited too long

a great product for normal sized people. I am big and it fits and attaches well enough for stationary therapy. I have not tried the hot therapy, just the cold.

This product does not hold up to use. It was used regularly for one month on my husband's knee replacement twice a day. Now we have to throw it away because all the gel is seeping out through the edges. I would not recommend buying this product.

topic: Dixigear First Responder On Call Trauma Bag W/ Reflectors - Red
texts: So I have this bag.. it is flimsy. stuff falls out on a regular basis. As an EMT-A, I would not suggest a working EMT to get this bag. If it is a first aid kit for ur house.. go for it. That would be fine.
Bag is small and good for a vehicle, however your gear doesnt stay secure in this bag and if you needed it in an emergency your gear may fall out in a collision or while running, needs zippers.

You can't fully close and secure the top cover. It closes with 2 buckles but the sides are wide open so anything small inside can easily fall out. I have 0 interest in having all my items fall out and get lost everytime I move the bag around.
This bag has a significant gap between the fold over flap and the sides of the case thus allowing loose times to fall out. Don’t know why anyone would think this that is a good idea.

Fits gear, standard flap enclosure. Some commented that it feels like things will fall out, this bag is fast access so trade off in design. Only real Improvement would be foam insert pockets to stiffen bag.

There is no inside zipper or velcro closure. When closed with the two front straps you see pictured, it leaves gap openings on each end since it just flaps over. This leaves smaller items able to fall out the gaps. The picture is misleading because it looks like you can fully close the bag securely, but you cannot at all. Not recommended.

The only thing I didn't like about the bag is that the top is not very secure so if you have to run with the bag in your hand things seem to fall out of the top of it no matter how tight you strap it down

Its an alright bag. Doesn't actually have much space and actually isn't even that big. And not only that, it was supposed to be red... The whole reason why i bought it. I guess its a nice bag tho, but this bag looked alot bigger than what i expected from every source i looked at for it. If you expect a semi big bag, don't get this. If your expecting red, don't get this. if you want a small bag with two spaces that are only snug tight by two clips and it seems like everything could fall out, then you should probably get this bag.

topic: Camay International Softly Scented Bath Bar Classic Soap, 125 G / 4.5 Oz Each 3 Count (Pack of 4) 12

I was expecting the original scent and these bars do not have it. I have a bar of Camay that is 20 years old that sits on the upper shelf in the bathroom and it still has a lovely scent, and i thoroughly enjoy it, but these new bars give me a headache.

Smells good, looks good, but it is definitely not the same Camay that used to be around. It will get you clean, but you will have to scrub harder to get the soap on your washcloth. My advice? If it looks like a duck and quacks like a duck--it isn't necessarily a duck.
